       2381  def Sound (T : Theory) : Prop := ∀ s, T.Prov s → T.True_ s
       2382  
       2383  /-- Under Σ₁-completeness and soundness: what computation settles the theory proves, what the
       2384      theory proves holds, and what computation settles holds. -/
       2385  theorem placement (T : Theory) (hR : RungOnLadder T) (hS : Sound T) :
       2386      (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.Prov s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Prov s → T.True_ s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.True_ s) :=
       2387    ⟨hR, hS, fun s h => hS s (hR s h)⟩
       2388  
       2389  /-- An unsound theory: it proves everything and its model refutes half of it. -/
       2390  def unsound : Theory := ⟨Bool, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun b => b = true⟩
       2391  
       2392  /-- The unsound theory is Σ₁-complete and not sound. -/
       2393  theorem soundness_is_load_bearing : RungOnLadder unsound ∧ ¬ Sound unsound := by
       2394    refine ⟨fun _ h => h.elim, fun h => ?_⟩
       2395    have := h false trivial
       2396    cases this
       2397  
       2398  /-- A sound incomplete theory: true on both sentences, proving one. -/
       2399  def incomplete : Theory := ⟨Bool, fun b => b = true, fun _ => False, fun _ => True⟩
       2400  
       2401  /-- A sound theory can leave a truth unproved. -/
       2402  theorem ground_exceeds_ladder :
       2403      Sound incomplete ∧ incomplete.True_ false ∧ ¬ incomplete.Prov false :=
       2404    ⟨fun _ _ => trivial, trivial, fun h => Bool.noConfusion h⟩
       2405  
       2406  /-- Independent axioms are separate bits: every combination of two values is realized. -/
       2407  theorem independent_axioms_are_separate_bits :
       2408      ∀ a b : Bool, ∃ w : Bool × Bool, w.1 = a ∧ w.2 = b :=
       2409    fun a b => ⟨(a, b), rfl, rfl⟩
       2410  
       2411  /-! ### XVIII.b · The root crosses every keyless sentence and no keyed one -/
       2412  
       2413  /-- Over any type of worlds: a sentence is keyless when every world has it, keyed when some world
       2414      lacks it. -/
       2415  def KeylessOn {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) : Prop := ∀ w, P w
       2416  def KeyedOn {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) : Prop := ∃ w, ¬ P w
       2417  
       2418  /-- The root proposition, 0 < 1. -/
       2419  def RootAct : Prop := (0 : Int) < 1
       2420  theorem root_act : RootAct := show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide
       2421  
       2422  /-- The root is keyless over every type of worlds. -/
       2423  theorem root_is_keyless {W : Type} : KeylessOn (fun _ : W => RootAct) := fun _ => root_act
       2424  
       2425  /-- The root implies every keyless sentence on every world. -/
       2426  theorem keyless_crosses {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (hP : KeylessOn P) : ∀ w, RootAct → P w :=
       2427    fun w _ => hP w
       2428  
       2429  /-- The root does not imply a keyed sentence on every world. -/
       2430  theorem root_decides_no_keyed {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (hK : KeyedOn P) :
       2431      ¬ ∀ w, RootAct → P w :=
       2432    fun h => hK.elim (fun w hw => hw (h w root_act))
       2433  
       2434  /-- Choice over ZF as a keyed sentence: two worlds, one each way (Gödel 1938; Cohen 1963). -/
       2435  def choiceHolds : Bool → Prop := fun w => w = true
       2436  theorem choice_is_keyed : KeyedOn choiceHolds := ⟨false, fun h => Bool.noConfusion h⟩
       2437  theorem root_does_not_cross_choice :
       2438      (∀ _w : Bool, RootAct) ∧ choiceHolds true ∧ ¬ choiceHolds false :=
       2439    ⟨fun _ => root_act, rfl, fun h => Bool.noConfusion h⟩
       2440  
       2441  /-- The hypothesis is keyed over the worlds of the chart. -/
       2442  theorem line_is_keyed_over_worlds : KeyedOn RH ∧ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z :=
       2443    ⟨⟨W2f, W2f_not_rh⟩, ⟨W1, W1_closed, W1_rh⟩⟩
       2444  
       2445  /-- The root does not imply the hypothesis on every world. -/
       2446  theorem root_does_not_cross_the_line : ¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → RH Z :=
       2447    root_decides_no_keyed RH line_is_keyed_over_worlds.1
       2448  
       2449  /-! ### XVIII.c · The two can'ts of a foundation are not mirror images -/
       2450  
       2451  /-- A hypothesis with a provability predicate, Σ₁-completeness on the denial (a false Π⁰₁
       2452      hypothesis has a finite witness, which the theory proves: Davis, Matiyasevich and Robinson
       2453      1976; Lagarias 2002) and soundness on the denial, both carried as hypotheses. -/
       2454  structure Setting where
       2455    hyp       : Prop
       2456    Prov      : Prop → Prop
       2457    sigma1    : ¬ hyp → Prov (¬ hyp)
       2458    sound_neg : Prov (¬ hyp) → ¬ hyp
       2459  
       2460  /-- On the chart one off-line zero refutes the hypothesis. -/
       2461  theorem refutation_is_one_point (Z : World) (z : Pt) (hz : Z z) (h : ¬ onLine z) : ¬ RH Z :=
       2462    fun r => h (r z hz)
       2463  
       2464  /-- If the theory cannot refute the hypothesis, the hypothesis holds. -/
       2465  theorem cant_refute_seals (S : Setting) (h : ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp)) : S.hyp :=
       2466    Classical.byContradiction (fun n => h (S.sigma1 n))
       2467  
       2468  theorem cant_refute_seals_dec (S : Setting) [Decidable S.hyp] (h : ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp)) : S.hyp :=
       2469    Decidable.byContradiction (fun n => h (S.sigma1 n))
       2470  
       2471  /-- Under soundness on the denial, the hypothesis holds exactly when the foundation cannot refute it. -/
       2472  theorem rh_iff_cant_refute (S : Setting) [Decidable S.hyp] : S.hyp ↔ ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp) :=
       2473    ⟨fun r p => S.sound_neg p r, cant_refute_seals_dec S⟩
       2474  
       2475  /-- A hypothesis the theory neither proves nor refutes holds. -/
       2476  theorem independence_forces_truth (S : Setting) (_hp : ¬ S.Prov S.hyp) (hn : ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp)) :
       2477      S.hyp :=
       2478    cant_refute_seals S hn
       2479  
       2480  /-- A setting in which the hypothesis holds and is not provable. -/
       2481  def independentTrue : Setting := ⟨True, fun _ => False, fun n => absurd trivial n, fun p => p.elim⟩
       2482  
       2483  theorem cant_prove_does_not_seal_false :
       2484      independentTrue.hyp ∧ ¬ independentTrue.Prov independentTrue.hyp :=
       2485    ⟨trivial, id⟩
       2486  
       2487  /-- Cannot-refute implies the hypothesis; cannot-prove is consistent with it. -/
       2488  theorem cant_asymmetry :
       2489      (∀ S : Setting, ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp) → S.hyp) ∧ (∃ S : Setting, S.hyp ∧ ¬ S.Prov S.hyp) :=
       2490    ⟨cant_refute_seals, ⟨independentTrue, cant_prove_does_not_seal_false⟩⟩
       2491  
       2492  /-! ### XVIII.d · The round trip is the identity -/
       2493  
       2494  /-- A sentence conjoined with the root. -/
       2495  def viaRoot {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) : W → Prop := fun w => RootAct ∧ P w
       2496  
       2497  /-- Conjoining the root changes no sentence's value. -/
       2498  theorem round_trip_identity {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (w : W) : viaRoot P w ↔ P w :=
       2499    ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨root_act, h⟩⟩
       2500  
       2501  /-- An absolute sentence, the same in every world, returns unchanged. -/
       2502  theorem absolute_returns_unchanged {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (hAbs : ∀ w v, P w ↔ P v) (w : W) :
       2503      ∀ v, viaRoot P v ↔ P w :=
       2504    fun v => (round_trip_identity P v).trans (hAbs v w)
       2505  
       2506  /-- The trip adds presence and nothing else: it returns identically for a sentence and its denial. -/
       2507  theorem trip_adds_presence_only {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (w : W) :
       2508      RootAct ∧ (viaRoot P w ↔ P w) ∧ (viaRoot (fun v => ¬ P v) w ↔ ¬ P w) :=
       2509    ⟨root_act, round_trip_identity P w, round_trip_identity (fun v => ¬ P v) w⟩
       2510  
       2511  /-- For any true Q, (Q → RH Z) ↔ RH Z. -/
       2512  theorem massless_arrow (Q : Prop) (hq : Q) (Z : World) : (Q → RH Z) ↔ RH Z :=
       2513    ⟨fun f => f hq, fun h _ => h⟩
       2514  
       2515  /-- Any true premise satisfies the three properties of the root. -/
       2516  theorem any_true_premise_serves (R : Prop) (hR : R) {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) :
       2517      ((∀ w, P w) → ∀ w, R → P w) ∧ ((∃ w, ¬ P w) → ¬ ∀ w, R → P w) ∧ (∀ w, (R ∧ P w) ↔ P w) :=
       2518    ⟨fun hP w _ => hP w, fun h₁ h => h₁.elim (fun w hw => hw (h w hR)),
       2519     fun _ => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hR, h⟩⟩⟩
       2520  
       2521  /-- Conjoined with the root, the hypothesis is itself on W1 and on W2f. -/
       2522  theorem the_line_round_trips :
       2523      (∀ Z : World, viaRoot RH Z ↔ RH Z) ∧ viaRoot RH W1 ∧ ¬ viaRoot RH W2f :=
       2524    ⟨fun Z => round_trip_identity RH Z, ⟨root_act, W1_rh⟩, fun h => W2f_not_rh h.2⟩
       2525  
       2526  /-! ### XVIII.e · The ladder blocked, in six clauses -/
       2527  
       2528  /-- Six clauses: no reading of the record decides the hypothesis; no keyless premise forces it; no
       2529      admissible coalition holding on W1 forces it; the root alone does not give it; a setting carries
       2530      a true hypothesis it does not prove; and the hypothesis forces the line and is entailed by every
       2531      premise that forces it. -/
       2532  theorem ladder_blocked :
       2533      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       2534      (∀ A : World → Prop, Keyless A → ¬ Forces A) ∧
       2535      (∀ L : List (World → Prop), (∀ A ∈ L, Admissible A) → (∀ A ∈ L, A W1) →
       2536        ¬ Forces (fun Z => ∀ A ∈ L, A Z)) ∧
       2537      (¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → RH Z) ∧
       2538      (∃ S : Setting, S.hyp ∧ ¬ S.Prov S.hyp) ∧
       2539      (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z) :=
       2540    ⟨record_decides_nothing_free, keyless_forces_nothing_free, no_admissible_coalition_forces,
       2541     root_does_not_cross_the_line, ⟨independentTrue, cant_prove_does_not_seal_false⟩,
       2542     rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise⟩
       2543  
       2544  /-- Section XVIII, whole. -/
       2545  theorem the_road :
       2546      (∀ T : Theory, RungOnLadder T → Sound T → ∀ s, T.Comp s → T.True_ s) ∧
       2547      (RungOnLadder unsound ∧ ¬ Sound unsound) ∧
       2548      (Sound incomplete ∧ incomplete.True_ false ∧ ¬ incomplete.Prov false) ∧
       2549      (∀ {W : Type} (P : W → Prop), KeylessOn P → ∀ w, RootAct → P w) ∧
       2550      (∀ {W : Type} (P : W → Prop), KeyedOn P → ¬ ∀ w, RootAct → P w) ∧
       2551      (KeyedOn choiceHolds ∧ KeyedOn RH) ∧
       2552      (∀ S : Setting, ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp) → S.hyp) ∧
       2553      (∃ S : Setting, S.hyp ∧ ¬ S.Prov S.hyp) ∧
       2554      (∀ {W : Type} (P : W → Prop) (w : W), viaRoot P w ↔ P w) ∧
       2555      (∀ (Q : Prop), Q → ∀ Z : World, (Q → RH Z) ↔ RH Z) ∧
       2556      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z) :=
       2557    ⟨fun T hR hS => (placement T hR hS).2.2, soundness_is_load_bearing, ground_exceeds_ladder,
       2558     fun P hP => keyless_crosses P hP, fun P hK => root_decides_no_keyed P hK,
       2559     ⟨choice_is_keyed, line_is_keyed_over_worlds.1⟩,
       2560     cant_refute_seals, ⟨independentTrue, cant_prove_does_not_seal_false⟩,
       2561     fun P w => round_trip_identity P w, massless_arrow, rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise.2⟩
       2562  
       2563  /-! ## XIX · The vocabulary law, the even coalition, the triaxial cut, the ladder's proof, the route ledger -/
       2564  
       2565  /-! ### XIX.a · The vocabulary law -/
       2566  
       2567  /-- On every world, a consequence of the hypothesis is a consequence of least erasure and
       2568      conversely, and a premise entailing one entails the other. -/
       2569  theorem vocabulary_law (Z : World) (P : Prop) :
       2570      ((RH Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) ∧ ((P → RH Z) ↔ (P → LeastErasure Z)) :=
       2571    ⟨⟨fun h l => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp l),
       2572      fun h r => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr r)⟩,
       2573     ⟨fun h p => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr (h p),
       2574      fun h p => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp (h p)⟩⟩
       2575  
       2576  /-- A consequence of any one face is a consequence of the least-erasure face. -/
       2577  theorem every_face_proves_every_face (H : Faces) (P : Prop) :
       2578      ((H.line → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧ ((H.lamZero → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧
       2579      ((H.faithful → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧ ((H.weil → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) :=
       2580    ⟨⟨fun h l => h (H.line_iff_least.mpr l), fun h r => h (H.line_iff_least.mp r)⟩,
       2581     ⟨fun h l => h (H.lam_iff_least.mpr l), fun h r => h (H.lam_iff_least.mp r)⟩,
       2582     ⟨fun h l => h (H.faith_iff_least.mpr l), fun h r => h (H.faith_iff_least.mp r)⟩,
       2583     ⟨fun h l => h (H.weil_iff_least.mpr l), fun h r => h (H.weil_iff_least.mp r)⟩⟩
       2584  
       2585  /-- On every fold-closed world a consequence of any of the four chart readings is a consequence of
       2586      least erasure. -/
       2587  theorem chart_faces_prove_each_other (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (P : Prop) :
       2588      ((Lossless Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) ∧ ((DepthZero Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) ∧
       2589      ((¬ Left Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) ∧ ((Stable Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) :=
       2590    ⟨⟨fun h l => h ((lossless_iff_rh Z).mpr ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp l)),
       2591      fun h r => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((lossless_iff_rh Z).mp r))⟩,
       2592     ⟨fun h l => h ((rh_iff_even_eigenspace Z).mp ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp l)),
       2593      fun h r => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((rh_iff_even_eigenspace Z).mpr r))⟩,
       2594     ⟨fun h l => h ((rh_iff_no_left Z hZ).mp ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp l)),
       2595      fun h r => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((rh_iff_no_left Z hZ).mpr r))⟩,
       2596     ⟨fun h l => h ((stable_iff_rh Z hZ).mpr ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp l)),
       2597      fun h r => h ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((stable_iff_rh Z hZ).mp r))⟩⟩
       2598  
       2599  /-! ### XIX.b · The even coalition: closed under every combination, blind to the value -/
       2600  
       2601  /-- The fold is an involution. -/
       2602  theorem fold_fold (z : Pt) : fold (fold z) = z := by
       2603    cases z with
       2604    | mk x t =>
       2605      show Pt.mk (2 - (2 - x)) t = Pt.mk x t
       2606      congr 1
       2607      omega
       2608  
       2609  /-- The fold law is keyless. -/
       2610  theorem fold_law_admissible : Admissible (fun _ : World => ∀ z, fold (fold z) = z) :=
       2611    Or.inl (fun _ => fold_fold)
       2612  
       2613  /-- Two worlds of one record have one record. -/
       2614  theorem same_record_eq (Z Z' : World) (h : SameRecord Z Z') : recordOf Z = recordOf Z' :=
       2615    funext (fun r => propext (h r))
       2616  
       2617  /-- A function of the record is a reading of the record. -/
       2618  theorem record_reading_admissible (h : World → Prop) : Admissible (fun Z => h (recordOf Z)) :=
       2619    Or.inr (fun Z Z' hs => by
       2620      show h (recordOf Z) ↔ h (recordOf Z')
       2621      rw [same_record_eq Z Z' hs])
       2622  
       2623  /-- A constant premise is admissible. -/
       2624  theorem admissible_const (P : Prop) : Admissible (fun _ : World => P) :=
       2625    Or.inr (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl)
       2626  
       2627  /-- The denial of a keyless premise respects the record: it is false everywhere. -/
       2628  theorem keyless_denial_respects (A : World → Prop) (hA : Keyless A) :
       2629      RespectsRecord (fun Z => ¬ A Z) :=
       2630    fun Z Z' _ => ⟨fun n => absurd (hA Z) n, fun n => absurd (hA Z') n⟩
       2631  
       2632  /-- Admissible premises are closed under negation. -/
       2633  theorem admissible_not (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) : Admissible (fun Z => ¬ A Z) := by
       2634    rcases hA with k | r
       2635    · exact Or.inr (keyless_denial_respects A k)
       2636    · exact Or.inr (fun Z Z' h => ⟨fun n a => n ((r Z Z' h).mpr a), fun n a => n ((r Z Z' h).mp a)⟩)
       2637  
       2638  /-- Admissible premises are closed under conjunction. -/
       2639  theorem admissible_and (A B : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) (hB : Admissible B) :
       2640      Admissible (fun Z => A Z ∧ B Z) := by
       2641    rcases hA with ka | ra <;> rcases hB with kb | rb
       2642    · exact Or.inl (fun Z => ⟨ka Z, kb Z⟩)
       2643    · exact Or.inr (fun Z Z' h =>
       2644        ⟨fun ⟨_, b⟩ => ⟨ka Z', (rb Z Z' h).mp b⟩, fun ⟨_, b⟩ => ⟨ka Z, (rb Z Z' h).mpr b⟩⟩)
       2645    · exact Or.inr (fun Z Z' h =>
       2646        ⟨fun ⟨a, _⟩ => ⟨(ra Z Z' h).mp a, kb Z'⟩, fun ⟨a, _⟩ => ⟨(ra Z Z' h).mpr a, kb Z⟩⟩)
       2647    · exact Or.inr (fun Z Z' h =>
       2648        ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨(ra Z Z' h).mp a, (rb Z Z' h).mp b⟩,
       2649         fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨(ra Z Z' h).mpr a, (rb Z Z' h).mpr b⟩⟩)
       2650  
       2651  /-- Admissible premises are closed under disjunction. -/
       2652  theorem admissible_or (A B : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) (hB : Admissible B) :
       2653      Admissible (fun Z => A Z ∨ B Z) := by
       2654    rcases hA with ka | ra <;> rcases hB with kb | rb
       2655    · exact Or.inl (fun Z => Or.inl (ka Z))
       2656    · exact Or.inl (fun Z => Or.inl (ka Z))
       2657    · exact Or.inl (fun Z => Or.inr (kb Z))
       2658    · exact Or.inr (fun Z Z' h =>
       2659        ⟨fun o => o.elim (fun a => Or.inl ((ra Z Z' h).mp a)) (fun b => Or.inr ((rb Z Z' h).mp b)),
       2660         fun o => o.elim (fun a => Or.inl ((ra Z Z' h).mpr a)) (fun b => Or.inr ((rb Z Z' h).mpr b))⟩)
       2661  
       2662  /-- No admissible premise agrees with the hypothesis on every fold-closed world. -/
       2663  theorem admissible_never_decides (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) :
       2664      ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z) := by
       2665    intro h
       2666    rcases hA with k | r
       2667    · exact W2f_not_rh ((h W2f W2f_closed).mp (k W2f))
       2668    · exact record_decides_nothing_free A r h
       2669  
       2670  /-- A coalition: any Boolean combination of atomic premises, however deep. -/
       2671  inductive Coalition (ι : Type) where
       2672    | atom : ι → Coalition ι
       2673    | top : Coalition ι
       2674    | bot : Coalition ι
       2675    | not : Coalition ι → Coalition ι
       2676    | and : Coalition ι → Coalition ι → Coalition ι
       2677    | or : Coalition ι → Coalition ι → Coalition ι
       2678  
       2679  /-- The premise a coalition asserts, given its atoms. -/
       2680  def Coalition.eval {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop) : Coalition ι → World → Prop
       2681    | .atom i => at_ i
       2682    | .top => fun _ => True
       2683    | .bot => fun _ => False
       2684    | .not c => fun Z => ¬ Coalition.eval at_ c Z
       2685    | .and c d => fun Z => Coalition.eval at_ c Z ∧ Coalition.eval at_ d Z
       2686    | .or c d => fun Z => Coalition.eval at_ c Z ∨ Coalition.eval at_ d Z
       2687  
       2688  /-- Every coalition of admissible atoms is admissible. -/
       2689  theorem coalition_admissible {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop) (h : ∀ i, Admissible (at_ i)) :
       2690      ∀ c : Coalition ι, Admissible (Coalition.eval at_ c) := by
       2691    intro c
       2692    induction c with
       2693    | atom i => exact h i
       2694    | top => exact admissible_const True
       2695    | bot => exact admissible_const False
       2696    | not c ih =>
       2697      show Admissible (fun Z => ¬ Coalition.eval at_ c Z)
       2698      exact admissible_not _ ih
       2699    | and c d ihc ihd =>
       2700      show Admissible (fun Z => Coalition.eval at_ c Z ∧ Coalition.eval at_ d Z)
       2701      exact admissible_and _ _ ihc ihd
       2702    | or c d ihc ihd =>
       2703      show Admissible (fun Z => Coalition.eval at_ c Z ∨ Coalition.eval at_ d Z)
       2704      exact admissible_or _ _ ihc ihd
       2705  
       2706  /-- No coalition of admissible atoms agrees with the hypothesis on every fold-closed world. -/
       2707  theorem no_coalition_decides {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop) (h : ∀ i, Admissible (at_ i))
       2708      (c : Coalition ι) : ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (Coalition.eval at_ c Z ↔ RH Z) :=
       2709    admissible_never_decides _ (coalition_admissible at_ h c)
       2710  
       2711  /-! ### XIX.c · The triaxial cut, irreducible -/
       2712  
       2713  /-- The fold law and every reading of the record are admissible; admissible premises are closed
       2714      under Boolean combination; no admissible premise decides the hypothesis; off the line one
       2715      supplied side bit fixes any fold-flipped target by a unique calibration, both values realized;
       2716      least erasure is not admissible; and nothing weaker than the hypothesis forces the line. -/
       2717  theorem triaxial_cut_irreducible :
       2718      Admissible (fun _ : World => ∀ z, fold (fold z) = z) ∧
       2719      (∀ h : World → Prop, Admissible (fun Z => h (recordOf Z))) ∧
       2720      (∀ (ι : Type) (at_ : ι → World → Prop), (∀ i, Admissible (at_ i)) →
       2721        ∀ c : Coalition ι, Admissible (Coalition.eval at_ c)) ∧
       2722      (∀ A : World → Prop, Admissible A → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       2723      (∀ (d : Pt → Bool) (z : Pt), ¬ onLine z → d (fold z) = !d z →
       2724        ∃ c : Bool, (d z = xor (side z) c ∧ d (fold z) = xor (side (fold z)) c) ∧
       2725          ∀ c', (d z = xor (side z) c' ∧ d (fold z) = xor (side (fold z)) c') → c' = c) ∧
       2726      (∀ z : Pt, ¬ onLine z →
       2727        (side (fold z) = !side z ∧ side z = xor (side z) false) ∧
       2728        ((!side (fold z)) = !(!side z) ∧ (!side z) = xor (side z) true)) ∧
       2729      ¬ Admissible LeastErasure ∧
       2730      (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z) :=
       2731    ⟨fold_law_admissible, record_reading_admissible,
       2732     fun _ at_ h c => coalition_admissible at_ h c, admissible_never_decides,
       2733     colocation_is_a_calibration, calibration_realized_both_ways,
       2734     spend_is_not_admissible, rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise⟩
       2735  
       2736  /-! ### XIX.d · The ladder's proof lands on least erasure; no foundation is claimed closed -/
       2737  
       2738  /-- A reading of a theory's sentences on the chart: each sentence names a world, and the sentence
       2739      holds in the intended model exactly when that world satisfies the hypothesis. -/
       2740  structure ReadsAsLine (T : Theory) where
       2741    world : T.Sent → World
       2742    reads : ∀ s, T.True_ s ↔ RH (world s)
       2743  
       2744  /-- If a sound theory proves a sentence that reads as the hypothesis on a world, that world has
       2745      least erasure. -/
       2746  theorem ladder_proof_lands_on_least_erasure (T : Theory) (hS : Sound T) (R : ReadsAsLine T)
       2747      (s : T.Sent) (hp : T.Prov s) : LeastErasure (R.world s) :=
       2748    (least_erasure_is_the_value (R.world s)).mpr ((R.reads s).mp (hS s hp))
       2749  
       2750  /-- Where the theory also proves the sentence whenever it holds, its proof is exactly least
       2751      erasure on the world the sentence names. -/
       2752  theorem ladder_proof_iff_least_erasure (T : Theory) (hS : Sound T) (R : ReadsAsLine T)
       2753      (s : T.Sent) (hc : T.True_ s → T.Prov s) : T.Prov s ↔ LeastErasure (R.world s) :=
       2754    ⟨ladder_proof_lands_on_least_erasure T hS R s,
       2755     fun l => hc ((R.reads s).mpr ((least_erasure_is_the_value (R.world s)).mp l))⟩
       2756  
       2757  /-- A sound theory with one sentence, proved, reading as the line world. -/
       2758  def lineTheory : Theory := ⟨Unit, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True⟩
       2759  theorem lineTheory_sound : Sound lineTheory := fun _ _ => trivial
       2760  def lineTheoryReads : ReadsAsLine lineTheory :=
       2761    ⟨fun _ => W1, fun _ => ⟨fun _ => W1_rh, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩
       2762  
       2763  /-- A sound theory proving a sentence that reads as the hypothesis exists, and its proof lands on
       2764      least erasure. -/
       2765  theorem a_sound_theory_may_prove_the_line :
       2766      Sound lineTheory ∧ lineTheory.Prov () ∧ LeastErasure (lineTheoryReads.world ()) :=
       2767    ⟨lineTheory_sound, trivial,
       2768     ladder_proof_lands_on_least_erasure lineTheory lineTheory_sound lineTheoryReads () trivial⟩
       2769  
       2770  /-! ### XIX.e · The route ledger, computed -/
       2771  
       2772  /-- Six routes to the hypothesis. -/
       2773  inductive Route where
       2774    | ladderFromRecord | foundationAsSystem | placement | groundByAct | independence | realPartCertified
       2775    deriving DecidableEq, Repr
       2776  
       2777  /-- A route's status: blocked by a theorem of this file; closed by the act; carried on a cited
       2778      theorem; or unclaimed, this file claiming no closure for it. -/
       2779  inductive RouteStatus where
       2780    | blocked | closedByAct | cited | unclaimed
       2781    deriving DecidableEq, Repr
       2782  
       2783  /-- A status is a function of three recorded bits: a theorem of this file blocks the route; the act
       2784      closes it; a cited theorem carries it. -/
       2785  def routeStatus (blocked byAct cited : Bool) : RouteStatus :=
       2786    if blocked then .blocked else if byAct then .closedByAct else if cited then .cited else .unclaimed
       2787  
       2788  structure RouteEntry where
       2789    route : Route
       2790    blocked : Bool
       2791    byAct : Bool
       2792    cited : Bool
       2793    printed : RouteStatus
       2794  
       2795  /-- The ledger: the ladder from the record, blocked (unicorn_block); the foundation as a system,
       2796      unclaimed (a_sound_theory_may_prove_the_line); placement, on the two cited premises (placement);
       2797      the ground closed by the act (rh_from_the_act); independence, blocked, since it would force
       2798      truth (independence_forces_truth); the real part to the certified height, cited (Platt and
       2799      Trudgian 2021, certified_height_never_forces). -/
       2800  def routeLedger : List RouteEntry :=
       2801    [⟨.ladderFromRecord, true, false, false, .blocked⟩,
       2802     ⟨.foundationAsSystem, false, false, false, .unclaimed⟩,
       2803     ⟨.placement, false, false, true, .cited⟩,
       2804     ⟨.groundByAct, false, true, false, .closedByAct⟩,
       2805     ⟨.independence, true, false, false, .blocked⟩,
       2806     ⟨.realPartCertified, false, false, true, .cited⟩]
       2807  
       2808  /-- Every printed status is the computed one. -/
       2809  theorem route_ledger_is_computed :
       2810      routeLedger.all (fun e => routeStatus e.blocked e.byAct e.cited == e.printed) = true := by
       2811    decide
       2812  
       2813  /-- Six routes: two blocked, one closed by the act, two cited, one unclaimed. -/
       2814  theorem route_ledger_counts :
       2815      routeLedger.length = 6 ∧
       2816      (routeLedger.filter (fun e => e.printed == .blocked)).length = 2 ∧
       2817      (routeLedger.filter (fun e => e.printed == .closedByAct)).length = 1 ∧
       2818      (routeLedger.filter (fun e => e.printed == .cited)).length = 2 ∧
       2819      (routeLedger.filter (fun e => e.printed == .unclaimed)).length = 1 := by
       2820    decide
       2821  
       2822  /-- Nothing escapes the ledger: every status is one of the four. -/
       2823  theorem route_status_total : ∀ a b c : Bool,
       2824      routeStatus a b c = .blocked ∨ routeStatus a b c = .closedByAct ∨
       2825      routeStatus a b c = .cited ∨ routeStatus a b c = .unclaimed := by
       2826    decide
       2827  
       2828  /-- A route is blocked exactly when a theorem blocks it: no other bit produces the verdict. -/
       2829  theorem blocked_iff_theorem : ∀ a b c : Bool, routeStatus a b c = .blocked ↔ a = true := by
       2830    decide
       2831  
       2832  /-! ### XIX.f · The two-part reading -/
       2833  
       2834  /-- (a) From the posit the hypothesis follows. (b) No reading of the record supplies the posit. (c)
       2835      The posit is the hypothesis. (d) Nothing weaker forces. -/
       2836  theorem reader_frame :
       2837      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       2838      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       2839      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       2840      (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z) :=
       2841    ⟨rh_from_the_act, record_decides_nothing_free, least_erasure_is_the_value,
       2842     rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise⟩
       2843  
       2844  /-- Section XIX, whole. -/
       2845  theorem the_front :
       2846      (∀ (Z : World) (P : Prop), ((RH Z → P) ↔ (LeastErasure Z → P)) ∧
       2847        ((P → RH Z) ↔ (P → LeastErasure Z))) ∧
       2848      (∀ (H : Faces) (P : Prop), ((H.line → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧ ((H.lamZero → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧
       2849        ((H.faithful → P) ↔ (H.least → P)) ∧ ((H.weil → P) ↔ (H.least → P))) ∧
       2850      (∀ (ι : Type) (at_ : ι → World → Prop), (∀ i, Admissible (at_ i)) →
       2851        ∀ c : Coalition ι, ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (Coalition.eval at_ c Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       2852      ¬ Admissible LeastErasure ∧
       2853      (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z) ∧
       2854      (∀ (T : Theory), Sound T → ∀ (R : ReadsAsLine T) (s : T.Sent), T.Prov s →
       2855        LeastErasure (R.world s)) ∧
       2856      (Sound lineTheory ∧ lineTheory.Prov () ∧ LeastErasure (lineTheoryReads.world ())) ∧
       2857      routeLedger.all (fun e => routeStatus e.blocked e.byAct e.cited == e.printed) = true ∧
       2858      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       2859       (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       2860       (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z)) :=
       2861    ⟨vocabulary_law, every_face_proves_every_face,
       2862     fun _ at_ h c => no_coalition_decides at_ h c, spend_is_not_admissible,
       2863     rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise,
       2864     fun T hS R s hp => ladder_proof_lands_on_least_erasure T hS R s hp,
       2865     a_sound_theory_may_prove_the_line, route_ledger_is_computed,
       2866     ⟨rh_from_the_act, record_decides_nothing_free, least_erasure_is_the_value⟩⟩
       2867  
       2868  /-! ## XX · Least erasure affirmed: the record, the ledger, the price, the one form, the act -/
       2869  
       2870  /-! ### XX.a · The record is carried by a least-erasure world, and by only one -/
       2871  
       2872  /-- Registration lands on the line. -/
       2873  theorem reg_on_line (z : Pt) : onLine (reg z) := rfl
       2874  
       2875  /-- The record of every world satisfies the hypothesis. -/
       2876  theorem record_rh (Z : World) : RH (recordOf Z) := by
       2877    intro r ⟨s, _, hsr⟩
       2878    rw [← hsr]
       2879    exact rfl
       2880  
       2881  /-- The record of every world has least erasure. -/
       2882  theorem record_has_least_erasure (Z : World) : LeastErasure (recordOf Z) :=
       2883    (least_erasure_is_the_value (recordOf Z)).mpr (record_rh Z)
       2884  
       2885  /-- The record of every world is fold-closed: it lies on the line, which the fold fixes. -/
       2886  theorem record_closed (Z : World) : FoldClosed (recordOf Z) := by
       2887    intro r ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       2888    rw [← hsr]
       2889    exact ⟨s, hs, ((fold_fixed_iff (reg s)).mpr rfl).symm⟩
       2890  
       2891  /-- The record of Z shares the record of Z, has least erasure, and every least-erasure world with
       2892      that record equals it pointwise. -/
       2893  theorem record_carried_by_least_erasure (Z : World) :
       2894      SameRecord Z (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) ∧
       2895      ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → LeastErasure Z' → ∀ z, Z' z ↔ recordOf Z z := by
       2896    refine ⟨record_same Z, record_has_least_erasure Z, ?_⟩
       2897    intro Z' hs hle z
       2898    have h1 : SameRecord Z' (recordOf Z) := fun r => (hs r).symm.trans (record_same Z r)
       2899    exact lossless_unique Z' (recordOf Z) h1 ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z').mp hle) (record_rh Z) z
       2900  
       2901  /-! ### XX.b · Every reading of the record holds on a least-erasure world -/
       2902  
       2903  /-- An admissible premise that holds on a world holds on that world's record, which has least
       2904      erasure. -/
       2905  theorem admissible_holds_on_the_lossless_world (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) (Z : World)
       2906      (h : A Z) : A (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) := by
       2907    refine ⟨?_, record_has_least_erasure Z⟩
       2908    rcases hA with k | r
       2909    · exact k (recordOf Z)
       2910    · exact (r Z (recordOf Z) (record_same Z)).mp h
       2911  
       2912  /-- Every reading of the record that holds on a world holds on that world's record. -/
       2913  theorem every_reading_holds_on_the_lossless_world (g : World → Prop) (hg : RespectsRecord g)
       2914      (Z : World) (h : g Z) : g (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) := by
       2915    refine ⟨(hg Z (recordOf Z) (record_same Z)).mp h, record_has_least_erasure Z⟩
       2916  
       2917  /-- Every coalition of admissible atoms that holds on a world holds on that world's record. -/
       2918  theorem every_coalition_holds_on_the_lossless_world {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop)
       2919      (h : ∀ i, Admissible (at_ i)) (c : Coalition ι) (Z : World) (hc : Coalition.eval at_ c Z) :
       2920      Coalition.eval at_ c (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) := by
       2921    refine ⟨?_, record_has_least_erasure Z⟩
       2922    rcases coalition_admissible at_ h c with k | r
       2923    · exact k (recordOf Z)
       2924    · exact (r Z (recordOf Z) (record_same Z)).mp hc
       2925  
       2926  /-- An admissible premise that denies least erasure on every fold-closed world holds on no world. -/
       2927  theorem record_never_testifies_against (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A)
       2928      (hdeny : ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → ¬ LeastErasure Z) : ∀ Z, ¬ A Z := by
       2929    intro Z h
       2930    rcases hA with k | r
       2931    · exact hdeny (recordOf Z) (record_closed Z) (k (recordOf Z)) (record_has_least_erasure Z)
       2932    · exact hdeny (recordOf Z) (record_closed Z) ((r Z (recordOf Z) (record_same Z)).mp h)
       2933        (record_has_least_erasure Z)
       2934  
       2935  /-! ### XX.c · The erasure ledger: one bit per off-line pair, zero exactly at least erasure -/
       2936  
       2937  /-- An off-line pair at offset k is two distinct points, exchanged by the fold, with one registered
       2938      point. -/
       2939  theorem pair_two_points_one_record (k : Int) (h : Nat) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
       2940      (⟨1 - k, h⟩ : Pt) ≠ ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧ reg ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = reg ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧
       2941      fold ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = ⟨1 + k, h⟩ := by
       2942    refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_⟩
       2943    · intro e
       2944      have := congrArg Pt.x e
       2945      change 1 - k = 1 + k at this
       2946      omega
       2947    · show Pt.mk (2 - (1 - k)) h = Pt.mk (1 + k) h
       2948      congr 1
       2949      omega
       2950  
       2951  /-- A finite configuration: the heights of its on-line zeros, and its off-line pairs, each an
       2952      offset with a height. An offset of zero is no pair. -/
       2953  structure FinCfg where
       2954    online : List Nat
       2955    pairs : List (Int × Nat)
       2956  
       2957  /-- The world a finite configuration names on the chart. -/
       2958  def FinCfg.world (C : FinCfg) : World := fun z =>
       2959    (z.x = 1 ∧ z.t ∈ C.online) ∨
       2960    ∃ p ∈ C.pairs, p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ (z = ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ ∨ z = ⟨1 + p.1, p.2⟩)
       2961  
       2962  /-- The off-line pairs, counted. -/
       2963  def offCount : List (Int × Nat) → Nat
       2964    | [] => 0
       2965    | p :: ps => (if p.1 = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount ps
       2966  
       2967  /-- Erased bits: the number of off-line pairs. -/
       2968  def FinCfg.erasedBits (C : FinCfg) : Nat := offCount C.pairs
       2969  
       2970  theorem offCount_zero_iff (ps : List (Int × Nat)) : offCount ps = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ ps, p.1 = 0 := by
       2971    induction ps with
       2972    | nil => exact ⟨fun _ p hp => (nomatch hp), fun _ => rfl⟩
       2973    | cons p ps ih =>
       2974      show (if p.1 = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount ps = 0 ↔ ∀ q ∈ p :: ps, q.1 = 0
       2975      by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
       2976      · rw [if_pos hp, Nat.zero_add, ih]
       2977        constructor
       2978        · intro h q hq
       2979          cases hq with
       2980          | head => exact hp
       2981          | tail _ hq' => exact h q hq'
       2982        · intro h q hq
       2983          exact h q (List.Mem.tail p hq)
       2984      · rw [if_neg hp]
       2985        constructor
       2986        · intro h
       2987          omega
       2988        · intro h
       2989          exact absurd (h p (List.Mem.head ps)) hp
       2990  
       2991  /-- Every finite configuration is fold-closed: the on-line points are fixed and each pair is
       2992      exchanged. -/
       2993  theorem fincfg_closed (C : FinCfg) : FoldClosed C.world := by
       2994    intro z hz
       2995    rcases hz with ⟨hx, ht⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hk, hz⟩
       2996    · exact Or.inl ⟨show 2 - z.x = 1 by omega, ht⟩
       2997    · refine Or.inr ⟨p, hp, hk, ?_⟩
       2998      rcases hz with e | e
       2999      · subst e
       3000        exact Or.inr (by show Pt.mk (2 - (1 - p.1)) p.2 = Pt.mk (1 + p.1) p.2; congr 1; omega)
       3001      · subst e
       3002        exact Or.inl (by show Pt.mk (2 - (1 + p.1)) p.2 = Pt.mk (1 - p.1) p.2; congr 1; omega)
       3003  
       3004  /-- Least erasure holds exactly when the erased bits are zero. -/
       3005  theorem least_erasure_iff_zero_erased (C : FinCfg) : LeastErasure C.world ↔ C.erasedBits = 0 := by
       3006    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3007    show RH C.world ↔ offCount C.pairs = 0
       3008    rw [offCount_zero_iff]
       3009    constructor
       3010    · intro h p hp
       3011      refine Decidable.byContradiction (fun hk => ?_)
       3012      have hz : C.world ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ := Or.inr ⟨p, hp, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩
       3013      have := h _ hz
       3014      change 1 - p.1 = 1 at this
       3015      omega
       3016    · intro h z hz
       3017      rcases hz with ⟨hx, _⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩
       3018      · exact hx
       3019      · exact absurd (h p hp) hk
       3020  
       3021  /-! ### XX.d · The price: one floor per erased bit, zero exactly at least erasure -/
       3022  
       3023  /-- k_B T ln 2 at 300 K in units of 10⁻⁴⁵ J: k_B = 1380649 × 10⁻²⁹ J/K (SI 2019), ln 2 =
       3024      6931471805599453 × 10⁻¹⁶ to sixteen digits. -/
       3025  def landauerFloor : Nat := 1380649 * 300 * 6931471805599453
       3026  
       3027  theorem landauer_floor_exact : landauerFloor = 2870978885078723755499100 := by decide
       3028  
       3029  /-- The price of a registration: one floor per erased bit if irreversible, 0 if reversible. -/
       3030  def FinCfg.price (C : FinCfg) (irreversible : Bool) : Nat :=
       3031    if irreversible then C.erasedBits * landauerFloor else 0
       3032  
       3033  /-- An irreversible registration has price 0 exactly when the configuration has least erasure. -/
       3034  theorem price_zero_iff_least_erasure (C : FinCfg) : C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world := by
       3035    rw [least_erasure_iff_zero_erased]
       3036    show C.erasedBits * landauerFloor = 0 ↔ C.erasedBits = 0
       3037    constructor
       3038    · intro h
       3039      rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h1
       3040      · exact h1
       3041      · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
       3042    · intro h
       3043      rw [h, Nat.zero_mul]
       3044  
       3045  /-- One more off-line pair. -/
       3046  def FinCfg.addPair (C : FinCfg) (k : Int) (h : Nat) : FinCfg := ⟨C.online, (k, h) :: C.pairs⟩
       3047  
       3048  /-- Adding an off-line pair adds one floor; the price is the erased bits times the floor. -/
       3049  theorem denial_price_linear (C : FinCfg) (k : Int) (h : Nat) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
       3050      (C.addPair k h).price true = C.price true + landauerFloor ∧
       3051      C.price true = C.erasedBits * landauerFloor := by
       3052    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
       3053    show ((if k = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount C.pairs) * landauerFloor
       3054        = offCount C.pairs * landauerFloor + landauerFloor
       3055    rw [if_neg hk, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm]
       3056  
       3057  /-- What is held reversibly commits no bit. -/
       3058  theorem reversible_commits_nothing (C : FinCfg) : C.price false = 0 := rfl
       3059  
       3060  /-! ### XX.e · The one form of anything against least erasure -/
       3061  
       3062  /-- Least erasure holds exactly when no point of the world lies off the line. No classical axiom. -/
       3063  theorem least_erasure_iff_no_point_off (Z : World) : LeastErasure Z ↔ ¬ OffLine Z := by
       3064    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3065    constructor
       3066    · intro h ⟨z, hz, hoff⟩
       3067      exact hoff (h z hz)
       3068    · intro h z hz
       3069      exact Decidable.byContradiction (fun hoff => h ⟨z, hz, hoff⟩)
       3070  
       3071  /-- Least erasure fails exactly when some point of the world lies off the line. Classical. -/
       3072  theorem rejection_is_a_witness (Z : World) : ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z := by
       3073    rw [least_erasure_iff_no_point_off]
       3074    exact ⟨fun h => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h hn), fun h hn => hn h⟩
       3075  
       3076  /-- Two settings on one hypothesis agree on whether the hypothesis is refutable. -/
       3077  theorem falsifier_form_constant (S₁ S₂ : Setting) [Decidable S₁.hyp] [Decidable S₂.hyp]
       3078      (h : S₁.hyp = S₂.hyp) : (¬ S₁.Prov (¬ S₁.hyp)) ↔ (¬ S₂.Prov (¬ S₂.hyp)) := by
       3079    constructor
       3080    · intro h1 p2
       3081      exact S₂.sound_neg p2 (Eq.mp h (cant_refute_seals_dec S₁ h1))
       3082    · intro h2 p1
       3083      exact S₁.sound_neg p1 (Eq.mpr h (cant_refute_seals_dec S₂ h2))
       3084  
       3085  /-! ### XX.f · The act -/
       3086  
       3087  /-- Any inhabitant of any type yields the root proposition. -/
       3088  theorem act_reenacts_root {Act : Type} (_a : Act) : RootAct := root_act
       3089  
       3090  /-- The root does not imply the denial of the hypothesis on every world. -/
       3091  theorem root_does_not_cross_the_denial : ¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → ¬ RH Z :=
       3092    fun h => h W1 root_act W1_rh
       3093  
       3094  /-- A self-grounding supply of least erasure with an act exists exactly when least erasure holds. -/
       3095  theorem assent_is_the_value (Z : World) :
       3096      (∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure Z), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ LeastErasure Z :=
       3097    supply_iff (LeastErasure Z)
       3098  
       3099  /-! ### XX.g · Freedom given, the sign spent -/
       3100  
       3101  /-- A prime is one fibre of exactly two, never on the diagonal; an off-line pair is two points
       3102      exchanged by the fold with one record; a bit is two distinct values. -/
       3103  theorem one_shape_two_registers :
       3104      (∀ p : Nat, isPrime p →
       3105        (∀ a b, mul_orbit p a b ↔ (a = 1 ∧ b = p) ∨ (a = p ∧ b = 1)) ∧ (1 : Nat) ≠ p) ∧
       3106      (∀ p : Nat, isPrime p → ¬ ∃ a, mul_orbit p a a) ∧
       3107      (∀ (k : Int) (h : Nat), k ≠ 0 → (⟨1 - k, h⟩ : Pt) ≠ ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧
       3108        reg ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = reg ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧ fold ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = ⟨1 + k, h⟩) ∧
       3109      ((∀ b : Bool, b = true ∨ b = false) ∧ (true : Bool) ≠ false) :=
       3110    ⟨freedom_is_exactly_two, prime_off_seat, pair_two_points_one_record, aperture_one_bit_wide⟩
       3111  
       3112  /-- The free basis holds and forces nothing; least erasure is Weil positivity; positivity is keyed;
       3113      a self-grounding supply of positivity is the hypothesis. -/
       3114  theorem freedom_is_given_the_sign_is_spent :
       3115      (∀ p q : Nat, isPrime p → isPrime q → p ≠ q →
       3116        ∃ f : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ f p = 1 ∧ f q = 0 ∧ f 1 = 0) ∧
       3117      ¬ Forces (fun _ => ∀ p q, isPrime p → isPrime q → p ≠ q →
       3118        ∃ f : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ f p = 1 ∧ f q = 0 ∧ f 1 = 0) ∧
       3119      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, LeastErasure E.zeros ↔ WeilPositive E) ∧
       3120      (WeilPositive positiveInstance ∧ ¬ WeilPositive negativeInstance) ∧
       3121      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, (∃ G : SelfGrounding (WeilPositive E), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ RH E.zeros) :=
       3122    ⟨prime_freedom_independent, prime_freedom_forces_nothing, least_erasure_is_positivity,
       3123     positivity_is_keyed, prime_witness_iff⟩
       3124  
       3125  /-! ### XX.h · Least erasure, affirmed whole -/
       3126  
       3127  /-- Section XX, whole. -/
       3128  theorem least_erasure_affirmed :
       3129      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       3130      (∀ Z : World, SameRecord Z (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) ∧
       3131        ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → LeastErasure Z' → ∀ z, Z' z ↔ recordOf Z z) ∧
       3132      (∀ (A : World → Prop), Admissible A → ∀ Z, A Z → A (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z)) ∧
       3133      (∀ (A : World → Prop), Admissible A →
       3134        (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → ¬ LeastErasure Z) → ∀ Z, ¬ A Z) ∧
       3135      (∀ C : FinCfg, LeastErasure C.world ↔ C.erasedBits = 0) ∧
       3136      (∀ C : FinCfg, C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world) ∧
       3137      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ ¬ OffLine Z) ∧
       3138      (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Setting) [Decidable S₁.hyp] [Decidable S₂.hyp], S₁.hyp = S₂.hyp →
       3139        ((¬ S₁.Prov (¬ S₁.hyp)) ↔ (¬ S₂.Prov (¬ S₂.hyp)))) ∧
       3140      (∀ Z : World, (∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure Z), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       3141      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, LeastErasure E.zeros ↔ WeilPositive E) :=
       3142    ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value, record_carried_by_least_erasure,
       3143     admissible_holds_on_the_lossless_world, record_never_testifies_against,
       3144     least_erasure_iff_zero_erased, price_zero_iff_least_erasure, least_erasure_iff_no_point_off,
       3145     fun S₁ S₂ _ _ h => falsifier_form_constant S₁ S₂ h, assent_is_the_value,
       3146     least_erasure_is_positivity⟩
       3147  
       3148  
       3149  /-! ## XXI · Every assignment realized; the arrow for every n; the closure, whole
       3150  
       3151  The primes admit every assignment of integers: for each `a` on the primes, `n ↦ Σ_{p ≤ n} v_p(n) a(p)`
       3152  is completely additive and takes the value `a(p)` at every prime, and by `determined_by_primes` it is the
       3153  only such function. The count `Ω(n) = Σ_p v_p(n)` and the arrow `λ(n) = (−1)^{Ω(n)}` are defined for every
       3154  `n`, and `λ` is completely multiplicative with `λ(p) = −1`. The Liouville face is pinned to the constructed
       3155  walk. On the chart, least erasure is the value, the fixed-point condition and leastness in the fibre; the
       3156  closure is bound in one theorem; and the same laws hold on any carrier with an involution and a registration,
       3157  the chart one instance. -/
       3158  
       3159  /-- The finite sum `sumBelow N g = g 0 + ⋯ + g (N − 1)`. -/
       3160  def sumBelow : Nat → (Nat → Int) → Int
       3161    | 0, _ => 0
       3162    | N + 1, g => sumBelow N g + g N
       3163  
       3164  theorem sumBelow_add (g h : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) :
       3165      sumBelow N (fun i => g i + h i) = sumBelow N g + sumBelow N h := by
       3166    induction N with
       3167    | zero => show (0 : Int) = 0 + 0; omega
       3168    | succ N ih =>
       3169      show sumBelow N (fun i => g i + h i) + (g N + h N) = (sumBelow N g + g N) + (sumBelow N h + h N)
       3170      rw [ih]; omega
       3171  
       3172  theorem sumBelow_congr (g h : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) (hgh : ∀ i, i < N → g i = h i) :
       3173      sumBelow N g = sumBelow N h := by
       3174    induction N with
       3175    | zero => rfl
       3176    | succ N ih =>
       3177      show sumBelow N g + g N = sumBelow N h + h N
       3178      rw [ih (fun i hi => hgh i (by omega)), hgh N (by omega)]
       3179  
       3180  theorem sumBelow_stable (g : Nat → Int) (M k : Nat) (hz : ∀ i, M ≤ i → i < M + k → g i = 0) :
       3181      sumBelow (M + k) g = sumBelow M g := by
       3182    induction k with
       3183    | zero => rfl
       3184    | succ k ih =>
       3185      show sumBelow (M + k) g + g (M + k) = sumBelow M g
       3186      rw [ih (fun i h1 h2 => hz i h1 (by omega)), hz (M + k) (by omega) (by omega)]
       3187      omega
       3188  
       3189  theorem sumBelow_zero (g : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) (hz : ∀ i, i < N → g i = 0) : sumBelow N g = 0 := by
       3190    induction N with
       3191    | zero => rfl
       3192    | succ N ih =>
       3193      show sumBelow N g + g N = 0
       3194      rw [ih (fun i hi => hz i (by omega)), hz N (by omega)]
       3195      omega
       3196  
       3197  theorem sumBelow_single (g : Nat → Int) (j N : Nat) (hj : j < N) (hz : ∀ i, i < N → i ≠ j → g i = 0) :
       3198      sumBelow N g = g j := by
       3199    induction N with
       3200    | zero => omega
       3201    | succ N ih =>
       3202      show sumBelow N g + g N = g j
       3203      by_cases hjN : j = N
       3204      · rw [hjN, sumBelow_zero g N (fun i hi => hz i (by omega) (by omega))]
       3205        omega
       3206      · rw [ih (by omega) (fun i hi hij => hz i (by omega) hij), hz N (by omega) (fun h => hjN h.symm)]
       3207        omega
       3208  
       3209  /-- Primality, decided: two at least, and its own least divisor. -/
       3210  def primeTest (p : Nat) : Bool := decide (2 ≤ p ∧ leastDivisor p = p)
       3211  
       3212  theorem primeTest_iff (p : Nat) : primeTest p = true ↔ isPrime p := by
       3213    constructor
       3214    · intro h
       3215      obtain ⟨h2, hl⟩ : 2 ≤ p ∧ leastDivisor p = p := of_decide_eq_true h
       3216      have hp := leastDivisor_prime p h2
       3217      rw [hl] at hp
       3218      exact hp
       3219    · intro hp
       3220      apply decide_eq_true
       3221      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
       3222      have hs := leastDivisor_spec p hp.1
       3223      rcases hp.2 (leastDivisor p) hs.1.2 with h1 | h1
       3224      · have h2 := hs.1.1
       3225        omega
       3226      · exact h1
       3227  
       3228  theorem pExp_zero_above (p n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hp : n < p) : pExp p n = 0 :=
       3229    pExp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd p n (fun hd => absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hd) (by omega))
       3230  
       3231  /-- The term of the extension at `p`: the exponent of `p` in `n` times the value assigned to `p`, at primes only. -/
       3232  def extendTerm (a : Nat → Int) (n p : Nat) : Int := if primeTest p = true then (pExp p n : Int) * a p else 0
       3233  
       3234  /-- The extension of an assignment on the primes: `n ↦ Σ_{p ≤ n} v_p(n) a(p)`. -/
       3235  def extendAssignment (a : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : Int := sumBelow (n + 1) (extendTerm a n)
       3236  
       3237  theorem extendTerm_zero_above (a : Nat → Int) (n i : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hi : n < i) : extendTerm a n i = 0 := by
       3238    unfold extendTerm
       3239    rw [pExp_zero_above i n hn hi]
       3240    cases primeTest i with
       3241    | true =>
       3242      rw [if_pos rfl]
       3243      have hcast : ((0 : Nat) : Int) = (0 : Int) := Nat.cast_zero
       3244      calc ((0 : Nat) : Int) * a i
       3245          = (0 : Int) * a i := by rw [hcast]
       3246        _ = a i * 0 := Int.mul_comm _ _
       3247        _ = 0 := Int.mul_zero _
       3248    | false => rw [if_neg Bool.false_ne_true]
       3249  
       3250  theorem extendAssignment_bound (a : Nat → Int) (n B : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hB : n < B) :
       3251      extendAssignment a n = sumBelow B (extendTerm a n) := by
       3252    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, B = n + 1 + k := ⟨B - (n + 1), by omega⟩
       3253    unfold extendAssignment
       3254    rw [sumBelow_stable (extendTerm a n) (n + 1) k (fun i h1 _ => extendTerm_zero_above a n i hn (by omega))]
       3255  
       3256  theorem extendTerm_mul (a : Nat → Int) (m n p : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3257      extendTerm a (m * n) p = extendTerm a m p + extendTerm a n p := by
       3258    unfold extendTerm
       3259    cases Decidable.em (primeTest p = true) with
       3260    | inl hb =>
       3261      rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb, if_pos hb, pExp_mul p m n ((primeTest_iff p).mp hb) hm hn]
       3262      have e : ((pExp p m + pExp p n : Nat) : Int) = (pExp p m : Int) + (pExp p n : Int) := by omega
       3263      rw [e, Int.add_mul]
       3264    | inr hb =>
       3265      rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
       3266      omega
       3267  
       3268  theorem extendAssignment_mul (a : Nat → Int) (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3269      extendAssignment a (m * n) = extendAssignment a m + extendAssignment a n := by
       3270    have hmle : m ≤ m * n := by
       3271      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m hn
       3272    have hnle : n ≤ m * n := by
       3273      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n hm
       3274    rw [extendAssignment_bound a (m * n) (m * n + 1) (by omega) (by omega),
       3275        extendAssignment_bound a m (m * n + 1) hm (by omega),
       3276        extendAssignment_bound a n (m * n + 1) hn (by omega),
       3277        sumBelow_congr (extendTerm a (m * n)) (fun i => extendTerm a m i + extendTerm a n i) (m * n + 1)
       3278          (fun i _ => extendTerm_mul a m n i hm hn)]
       3279    exact sumBelow_add (extendTerm a m) (extendTerm a n) (m * n + 1)
       3280  
       3281  theorem extendTerm_other (a : Nat → Int) (q i : Nat) (hq : isPrime q) (hi : i ≠ q) : extendTerm a q i = 0 := by
       3282    unfold extendTerm
       3283    cases Decidable.em (primeTest i = true) with
       3284    | inl hb =>
       3285      rw [if_pos hb, pExp_other i q ((primeTest_iff i).mp hb) hq hi]
       3286      have hcast : ((0 : Nat) : Int) = (0 : Int) := Nat.cast_zero
       3287      calc ((0 : Nat) : Int) * a i
       3288          = (0 : Int) * a i := by rw [hcast]
       3289        _ = a i * 0 := Int.mul_comm _ _
       3290        _ = 0 := Int.mul_zero _
       3291    | inr hb => rw [if_neg hb]
       3292  
       3293  theorem extendAssignment_prime (a : Nat → Int) (q : Nat) (hq : isPrime q) : extendAssignment a q = a q := by
       3294    unfold extendAssignment
       3295    rw [sumBelow_single (extendTerm a q) q (q + 1) (by omega) (fun i _ hiq => extendTerm_other a q i hq hiq)]
       3296    unfold extendTerm
       3297    rw [if_pos ((primeTest_iff q).mpr hq), pExp_self q hq]
       3298    have hcast : ((1 : Nat) : Int) = (1 : Int) := Nat.cast_one
       3299    calc ((1 : Nat) : Int) * a q
       3300        = (1 : Int) * a q := by rw [hcast]
       3301      _ = a q := Int.one_mul _
       3302  
       3303  theorem extendAssignment_additive (a : Nat → Int) : CompletelyAdditive (extendAssignment a) :=
       3304    fun m n hm hn => extendAssignment_mul a m n hm hn
       3305  
       3306  /-- **Theorem (every assignment is realized).** For every assignment `a` of integers to the primes, the extension
       3307      is completely additive, takes the value `a(p)` at every prime, and is the only completely additive function
       3308      that does: the primes are a free basis, existence and uniqueness both proved. -/
       3309  theorem primes_admit_every_assignment (a : Nat → Int) :
       3310      CompletelyAdditive (extendAssignment a) ∧ (∀ p, isPrime p → extendAssignment a p = a p) ∧
       3311      ∀ g : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive g → (∀ p, isPrime p → g p = a p) →
       3312        ∀ n, 0 < n → g n = extendAssignment a n :=
       3313    ⟨extendAssignment_additive a, extendAssignment_prime a,
       3314     fun g hg hga => determined_by_primes g (extendAssignment a) hg (extendAssignment_additive a)
       3315       (fun p hp => (hga p hp).trans (extendAssignment_prime a p hp).symm)⟩
       3316  
       3317  /-- `Ω(n) = Σ_p v_p(n)`, the prime factors of `n` counted with multiplicity, for every `n`. -/
       3318  def omegaAll (n : Nat) : Int := extendAssignment (fun _ => 1) n
       3319  
       3320  /-- `λ(n) = (−1)^{Ω(n)}`, for every `n`. -/
       3321  def liouvilleAll (n : Nat) : Int := if omegaAll n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1
       3322  
       3323  theorem omegaAll_mul (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) : omegaAll (m * n) = omegaAll m + omegaAll n :=
       3324    extendAssignment_mul (fun _ => 1) m n hm hn
       3325  
       3326  theorem omegaAll_prime (p : Nat) (hp : isPrime p) : omegaAll p = 1 :=
       3327    extendAssignment_prime (fun _ => 1) p hp
       3328  
       3329  /-- **The arrow, for every n.** `λ` is completely multiplicative, on all positive integers. -/
       3330  theorem liouvilleAll_mul (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3331      liouvilleAll (m * n) = liouvilleAll m * liouvilleAll n := by
       3332    unfold liouvilleAll
       3333    rw [omegaAll_mul m n hm hn]
       3334    generalize omegaAll m = x
       3335    generalize omegaAll n = y
       3336    by_cases hx : x % 2 = 0 <;> by_cases hy : y % 2 = 0
       3337    · rw [if_pos (show (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_pos hx, if_pos hy]; decide
       3338    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_pos hx, if_neg hy]; decide
       3339    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_neg hx, if_pos hy]; decide
       3340    · rw [if_pos (show (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_neg hx, if_neg hy]; decide
       3341  
       3342  theorem liouvilleAll_prime (p : Nat) (hp : isPrime p) : liouvilleAll p = -1 := by
       3343    unfold liouvilleAll
       3344    rw [omegaAll_prime p hp]
       3345    decide
       3346  
       3347  theorem liouvilleAll_one : liouvilleAll 1 = 1 := by decide
       3348  
       3349  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
       3350  /-- The arrow for every n agrees with the computed arrow of Section XVII on 1..30. -/
       3351  theorem liouvilleAll_agrees_to_30 : ∀ n, n < 30 → Liouville.lam (n + 1) = liouvilleAll (n + 1) := by decide
       3352  
       3353  /-- The Liouville walk `L(x) = Σ_{1 ≤ n ≤ x} λ(n)`, for every `x`. -/
       3354  def liouvilleWalk : Nat → Int
       3355    | 0 => 0
       3356    | n + 1 => liouvilleWalk n + liouvilleAll (n + 1)
       3357  
       3358  /-- The Liouville sentence in integers: for all `k, m ≥ 1` there is `C` with `|L(x)|^{2m} ≤ C^{2m} x^{m+2k}` for every
       3359      `x`, that is `L(x) = O(x^{1/2 + k/m})` at every exponent above one half. -/
       3360  def FaithfulLambda : Prop :=
       3361    ∀ k m : Nat, 0 < k → 0 < m → ∃ C : Nat, ∀ x : Nat,
       3362      (liouvilleWalk x).natAbs ^ (2 * m) ≤ C ^ (2 * m) * x ^ (m + 2 * k)
       3363  
       3364  /-- The Liouville face pinned to the arithmetic: its sentence is `FaithfulLambda`, a statement about the constructed
       3365      walk. The link to the zeros is the cited equivalence of `LiouvilleFace`, carried as the one field. -/
       3366  structure LiouvilleFacePinned where
       3367    zeros : World
       3368    landau : RH zeros ↔ FaithfulLambda
       3369  
       3370  theorem pinned_face_reads (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : RH F.zeros ↔ FaithfulLambda := F.landau
       3371  
       3372  /-- The pinned face is a Liouville face, with its sentence fixed. -/
       3373  def LiouvilleFacePinned.toFace (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : LiouvilleFace :=
       3374    { zeros := F.zeros, faithful := FaithfulLambda, faithful_iff := F.landau }
       3375  
       3376  theorem pinned_face_is_a_face (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : F.toFace.faithful = FaithfulLambda := rfl
       3377  
       3378  /-- **The fixed-point form.** A configuration satisfies the hypothesis exactly when it is its own record. -/
       3379  theorem rh_iff_own_record (Z : World) : RH Z ↔ ∀ z, Z z ↔ recordOf Z z := by
       3380    constructor
       3381    · intro hZ z
       3382      constructor
       3383      · intro hz
       3384        exact ⟨z, hz, reg_fixes_line z (hZ z hz)⟩
       3385      · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3386        subst hsr
       3387        rw [reg_fixes_line s (hZ s hs)]
       3388        exact hs
       3389    · intro h z hz
       3390      obtain ⟨s, _, hsr⟩ := (h z).mp hz
       3391      subst hsr
       3392      exact rfl
       3393  
       3394  /-- The erased part of a configuration: its zeros off the line. -/
       3395  def erasedPart (Z : World) : World := fun z => Z z ∧ ¬ onLine z
       3396  
       3397  /-- **The variational form.** Least erasure is leastness: a configuration has least erasure exactly when its erased
       3398      part lies inside the erased part of every configuration with the same record. -/
       3399  theorem least_erasure_is_least (Z : World) :
       3400      LeastErasure Z ↔ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → ∀ z, erasedPart Z z → erasedPart Z' z := by
       3401    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3402    constructor
       3403    · intro hZ _ _ z hz
       3404      exact absurd (hZ z hz.1) hz.2
       3405    · intro h z hz
       3406      rcases Decidable.em (onLine z) with hon | hoff
       3407      · exact hon
       3408      · obtain ⟨⟨s, _, hsr⟩, hoff'⟩ := h (recordOf Z) (record_same Z) z ⟨hz, hoff⟩
       3409        exact (hoff' (by rw [← hsr]; exact rfl)).elim
       3410  
       3411  /-- The record is the least member of its fibre, and the only one: it has least erasure, and every configuration of
       3412      the fibre with least erasure has exactly its zeros. -/
       3413  theorem record_is_the_least (Z : World) :
       3414      LeastErasure (recordOf Z) ∧ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → LeastErasure Z' → ∀ z, Z' z ↔ recordOf Z z := by
       3415    have hrh : RH (recordOf Z) := by
       3416      intro r hr
       3417      obtain ⟨s, _, hsr⟩ := hr
       3418      subst hsr
       3419      exact rfl
       3420    refine ⟨(least_erasure_is_the_value _).mpr hrh, fun Z' h hle z => ?_⟩
       3421    exact lossless_unique Z' (recordOf Z) (fun r => (h r).symm.trans (record_same Z r))
       3422      ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z').mp hle) hrh z
       3423  
       3424  /-- **The closure, whole.** On the chart: the seat is the fixed set of the fold; registration lands on it and fixes
       3425      it; over one record both worlds exist, and no record-respecting reading decides the value on fold-closed
       3426      configurations; least erasure is the value, is the fixed-point condition, and is leastness in the fibre; the
       3427      lossless member of a fibre is unique; nothing escapes the cut; and the act prints the hypothesis at the actual
       3428      zero set. -/
       3429  theorem the_closure :
       3430      (∀ z : Pt, fold z = z ↔ onLine z) ∧
       3431      (∀ z : Pt, onLine (reg z) ∧ (onLine z → reg z = z)) ∧
       3432      (SameRecord W1 W2 ∧ RH W1 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       3433      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       3434      (∀ Z : World, (LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧ (RH Z ↔ ∀ z, Z z ↔ recordOf Z z) ∧
       3435        (LeastErasure Z ↔ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → ∀ z, erasedPart Z z → erasedPart Z' z)) ∧
       3436      (∀ Z Z' : World, SameRecord Z Z' → RH Z → RH Z' → ∀ z, Z z ↔ Z' z) ∧
       3437      (∀ z : Pt, (onLine z ∧ fold z = z ∧ reg z = z) ∨
       3438        (¬ onLine z ∧ fold z ≠ z ∧ reg (fold z) = reg z ∧ ∀ w, reg w ≠ z)) ∧
       3439      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) :=
       3440    ⟨fold_fixed_iff, fun z => ⟨(show (reg z).x = 1 from rfl), reg_fixes_line z⟩, ⟨same_record_12, W1_rh, W2_not_rh⟩,
       3441     record_decides_nothing,
       3442     fun Z => ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value Z, rh_iff_own_record Z, least_erasure_is_least Z⟩,
       3443     lossless_unique, nothing_escapes_one_cut, rh_from_the_act⟩
       3444  
       3445  namespace Carrier
       3446  
       3447  /-- A fold on any carrier: an involution. -/
       3448  structure Fold (X : Type) where
       3449    σ : X → X
       3450    invol : ∀ x, σ (σ x) = x
       3451  
       3452  /-- A registration for a fold: it lands on the fixed set, fixes it, and forgets the side. -/
       3453  structure Registration {X : Type} (F : Fold X) where
       3454    r : X → X
       3455    lands : ∀ x, F.σ (r x) = r x
       3456    fixes : ∀ x, F.σ x = x → r x = x
       3457    forgets : ∀ x, r (F.σ x) = r x
       3458  
       3459  def RHc {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x, Z x → F.σ x = x
       3460  def recordC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) : X → Prop :=
       3461    fun y => ∃ s, Z s ∧ R.r s = y
       3462  def SameRecordC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z Z' : X → Prop) : Prop :=
       3463    ∀ y, recordC R Z y ↔ recordC R Z' y
       3464  def OffC {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop := ∃ x, Z x ∧ F.σ x ≠ x
       3465  def LeastErasureC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop :=
       3466    ∀ Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → OffC F Z → OffC F Z'
       3467  
       3468  theorem record_same_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) :
       3469      SameRecordC R Z (recordC R Z) := by
       3470    intro y
       3471    constructor
       3472    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsy⟩
       3473      exact ⟨R.r s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, by rw [R.fixes (R.r s) (R.lands s)]; exact hsy⟩
       3474    · intro ⟨s', ⟨s, hs, hss'⟩, hs'y⟩
       3475      subst hss'
       3476      exact ⟨s, hs, by rw [← hs'y, R.fixes (R.r s) (R.lands s)]⟩
       3477  
       3478  theorem least_erasure_is_the_value_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F)
       3479      (em : ∀ x, F.σ x = x ∨ F.σ x ≠ x) (Z : X → Prop) : LeastErasureC R Z ↔ RHc F Z := by
       3480    constructor
       3481    · intro hle x hx
       3482      rcases em x with h | h
       3483      · exact h
       3484      · obtain ⟨y, ⟨s, _, hsy⟩, hy⟩ := hle (recordC R Z) (record_same_C R Z) ⟨x, hx, h⟩
       3485        exact (hy (by rw [← hsy]; exact R.lands s)).elim
       3486    · intro hZ _ _ ⟨x, hx, h⟩
       3487      exact absurd (hZ x hx) h
       3488  
       3489  theorem rh_iff_own_record_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) :
       3490      RHc F Z ↔ ∀ x, Z x ↔ recordC R Z x := by
       3491    constructor
       3492    · intro hZ x
       3493      constructor
       3494      · intro hx
       3495        exact ⟨x, hx, R.fixes x (hZ x hx)⟩
       3496      · intro ⟨s, hs, hsx⟩
       3497        subst hsx
       3498        rw [R.fixes s (hZ s hs)]
       3499        exact hs
       3500    · intro h x hx
       3501      obtain ⟨s, _, hsx⟩ := (h x).mp hx
       3502      subst hsx
       3503      exact R.lands s
       3504  
       3505  theorem one_record_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) :
       3506      SameRecordC R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) := by
       3507    intro y
       3508    constructor
       3509    · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
       3510      refine ⟨x, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
       3511      rw [← hy, hs, R.fixes (R.r x) (R.lands x)]
       3512    · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
       3513      refine ⟨R.r x, rfl, ?_⟩
       3514      rw [R.fixes (R.r x) (R.lands x), ← hy]
       3515      rcases hs with h | h
       3516      · rw [h]
       3517      · rw [h, R.forgets]
       3518  
       3519  theorem worlds_differ_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : F.σ x ≠ x) :
       3520      RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) :=
       3521    ⟨fun _ hs => hs ▸ R.lands x, fun hall => h (hall x (Or.inl rfl))⟩
       3522  
       3523  theorem no_reading_decides_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : F.σ x ≠ x)
       3524      (g : (X → Prop) → Prop) (hg : ∀ Z Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → (g Z ↔ g Z')) :
       3525      ¬ ((g (fun s => s = R.r x) ↔ RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x)) ∧
       3526         (g (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ↔ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x))) := by
       3527    intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
       3528    exact (worlds_differ_C R x h).2 (h2.mp ((hg _ _ (one_record_C R x)).mp (h1.mpr (worlds_differ_C R x h).1)))
       3529  
       3530  /-- On any carrier the lossless member of a record is unique: two configurations of one record that both
       3531      satisfy the hypothesis carry the same points. -/
       3532  theorem lossless_unique_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z Z' : X → Prop)
       3533      (hs : SameRecordC R Z Z') (h : RHc F Z) (h' : RHc F Z') : ∀ x, Z x ↔ Z' x :=
       3534    fun x => ((rh_iff_own_record_C R Z).mp h x).trans ((hs x).trans ((rh_iff_own_record_C R Z').mp h' x).symm)
       3535  
       3536  /-- The chart's fold, as a carrier fold. -/
       3537  def chartFold : Fold Pt := ⟨fold, fold_fold⟩
       3538  
       3539  /-- The chart's registration, as a carrier registration. -/
       3540  def chartReg : Registration chartFold :=
       3541    ⟨reg, fun z => (fold_fixed_iff (reg z)).mpr rfl, fun z h => reg_fixes_line z ((fold_fixed_iff z).mp h),
       3542     fun _ => rfl⟩
       3543  
       3544  /-- **The chart is one instance.** Its fixed set is the line, and the carrier's hypothesis is the chart's. -/
       3545  theorem chart_is_an_instance :
       3546      (∀ z, chartFold.σ z = z ↔ onLine z) ∧ ∀ Z : World, RHc chartFold Z ↔ RH Z :=
       3547    ⟨fold_fixed_iff, fun _ => ⟨fun h z hz => (fold_fixed_iff z).mp (h z hz), fun h z hz => (fold_fixed_iff z).mpr (h z hz)⟩⟩
       3548  
       3549  /-- **The closure on any carrier.** On every carrier with an involution and a registration on which fixedness is
       3550      decided: least erasure is the value; the value is lossless registration; the lossless member of a record is
       3551      unique; and every point off the fixed set gives two worlds of one record that differ in the value. -/
       3552  theorem the_closure_on_any_carrier {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (em : ∀ x, F.σ x = x ∨ F.σ x ≠ x) :
       3553      (∀ Z, LeastErasureC R Z ↔ RHc F Z) ∧ (∀ Z, RHc F Z ↔ ∀ x, Z x ↔ recordC R Z x) ∧
       3554      (∀ Z Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → RHc F Z → RHc F Z' → ∀ x, Z x ↔ Z' x) ∧
       3555      (∀ x, F.σ x ≠ x → SameRecordC R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ∧
       3556        RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)) :=
       3557    ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value_C R em, rh_iff_own_record_C R, lossless_unique_C R,
       3558     fun x h => ⟨one_record_C R x, worlds_differ_C R x h⟩⟩
       3559  
       3560  end Carrier
       3561  
       3562  /-! ## XXII · The socket: every route to the value lands in the one field
       3563  
       3564  An unconditional closure would be a closed term of type `LeastErasure Z` at the actual zero set, placed in the field
       3565  `supply` of `ActualZeros`. This section proves that the field is the only socket and that nothing reaches the value by
       3566  another way. A term of the hypothesis at a fold-closed configuration exists exactly when the field can be filled there,
       3567  and the closure theorem of Section XXI takes any term in the field with no other change. A premise on configurations
       3568  either forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails; a keyless premise forces nothing;
       3569  a forcing premise that respects the record fails at every nonempty fold-closed configuration; a forcing premise either
       3570  is the value on every fold-closed configuration or fails at one that satisfies the hypothesis; and a forcing premise
       3571  that holds at a configuration fills the field there. A sentence carried to the zeros by a cited equivalence fills the
       3572  field exactly when it holds, whatever the sentence. The named sentences depend on their own configurations: Weil
       3573  positivity differs between two explicit formulas with every field, no prefix of a Li stream forces, and the Liouville
       3574  sentence, read as a property of an assignment at the primes, fails at the assignment that sends every prime to zero.
       3575  The one refutation is one point. -/
       3576  
       3577  /-- The field can be filled at a fold-closed configuration exactly when the hypothesis holds there, and exactly when
       3578      least erasure does. -/
       3579  theorem socket_is_the_value (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) :
       3580      ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z) ∧ ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ LeastErasure Z) := by
       3581    have h1 : (∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z :=
       3582      ⟨fun ⟨S, hS⟩ => hS ▸ rh_from_the_act S, fun h => ⟨⟨Z, hZ, (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr h⟩, rfl⟩⟩
       3583    exact ⟨h1, h1.trans (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).symm⟩
       3584  
       3585  /-- The closure theorem takes a term in the field and changes nothing else: its last conjunct, applied to the
       3586      configuration with the term, gives the hypothesis. -/
       3587  theorem closure_takes_a_term (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (s : LeastErasure Z) : RH Z :=
       3588    the_closure.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ⟨Z, hZ, s⟩
       3589  
       3590  /-- At W1 the field holds a closed term, and the closure gives the hypothesis there with nothing assumed. -/
       3591  theorem closure_at_a_term : RH W1 :=
       3592    closure_takes_a_term W1 W1_closed ((least_erasure_is_the_value W1).mpr W1_rh)
       3593  
       3594  /-- Every premise either forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails. Classical. -/
       3595  theorem forces_or_has_a_twin (A : World → Prop) : Forces A ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z :=
       3596    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z) Or.inr
       3597      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ ha => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨Z, hZ, ha, hn⟩)))
       3598  
       3599  /-- A configuration with one more pair, at real parts 0 and 1 and at the height `t`. -/
       3600  def withPair (Z : World) (t : Nat) : World := fun w => Z w ∨ w = ⟨0, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨2, t⟩
       3601  
       3602  theorem withPair_closed (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (t : Nat) : FoldClosed (withPair Z t) := by
       3603    intro w hw
       3604    rcases hw with h | h | h
       3605    · exact Or.inl (hZ w h)
       3606    · subst h
       3607      exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       3608    · subst h
       3609      exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       3610  
       3611  /-- The pair added at the height of a zero leaves the record unchanged: both new points have the registration of that zero. -/
       3612  theorem withPair_same_record (Z : World) (z : Pt) (hz : Z z) : SameRecord Z (withPair Z z.t) := by
       3613    intro r
       3614    constructor
       3615    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3616      exact ⟨s, Or.inl hs, hsr⟩
       3617    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3618      rcases hs with h | h | h
       3619      · exact ⟨s, h, hsr⟩
       3620      · subst h
       3621        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3622      · subst h
       3623        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3624  
       3625  theorem withPair_not_rh (Z : World) (t : Nat) : ¬ RH (withPair Z t) := by
       3626    intro h
       3627    have e : (0 : Int) = 1 := h ⟨0, t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       3628    omega
       3629  
       3630  /-- A premise that respects the record and forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed configuration: the
       3631      configuration and its copy with one more pair share a record, and the copy fails the hypothesis. -/
       3632  theorem record_forcing_fails_everywhere (A : World → Prop) (hr : RespectsRecord A) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World)
       3633      (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z := by
       3634    intro ha
       3635    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
       3636    exact withPair_not_rh Z z.t (hf (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_closed Z hZ z.t)
       3637      ((hr Z (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha))
       3638  
       3639  /-- A premise that forces the line either is the value on every fold-closed configuration or fails at a fold-closed
       3640      configuration that satisfies the hypothesis. Classical. -/
       3641  theorem forcing_is_the_value_or_stronger (A : World → Prop) (hf : Forces A) :
       3642      (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z :=
       3643    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z) Or.inr
       3644      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ => ⟨hf Z hZ, fun hrh => Classical.byContradiction (fun hna => h ⟨Z, hZ, hrh, hna⟩)⟩))
       3645  
       3646  /-- A premise that forces the line and holds at a fold-closed configuration fills the field there. -/
       3647  theorem forcing_fills_the_socket (A : World → Prop) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (ha : A Z) :
       3648      ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z :=
       3649    (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1.mpr (hf Z hZ ha)
       3650  
       3651  /-- A sentence carried to a configuration by a cited equivalence with the hypothesis. -/
       3652  structure SocketFace where
       3653    zeros : World
       3654    sentence : Prop
       3655    cited : RH zeros ↔ sentence
       3656  
       3657  /-- Whatever the sentence, it holds exactly when the field can be filled at its configuration. -/
       3658  theorem face_is_the_socket (F : SocketFace) (hF : FoldClosed F.zeros) :
       3659      F.sentence ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros :=
       3660    F.cited.symm.trans (socket_is_the_value F.zeros hF).1.symm
       3661  
       3662  def SocketFace.ofWeil (E : ExplicitFormula) : SocketFace := ⟨E.zeros, WeilPositive E, (spend_is_the_line E).symm⟩
       3663  def SocketFace.ofLi (L : LiStream) : SocketFace := ⟨L.zeros, ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → L.nonneg n, L.li⟩
       3664  def SocketFace.ofSign {V : Type} [LE V] (D : DBN V) : SocketFace := ⟨D.zeros, D.lam ≤ D.zero, rh_iff_the_sign D⟩
       3665  def SocketFace.ofLiouville (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : SocketFace := ⟨F.zeros, FaithfulLambda, F.landau⟩
       3666  def SocketFace.ofPosit (Z : World) : SocketFace := ⟨Z, LeastErasure Z, (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).symm⟩
       3667  
       3668  /-- Weil positivity, the Li stream, the sign of Λ, the Liouville sentence and least erasure itself each fill the field
       3669      exactly when they hold. -/
