       3670  theorem named_faces_are_the_socket :
       3671      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, FoldClosed E.zeros → (WeilPositive E ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = E.zeros)) ∧
       3672      (∀ L : LiStream, FoldClosed L.zeros → ((∀ n, 1 ≤ n → L.nonneg n) ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = L.zeros)) ∧
       3673      (∀ (V : Type) [LE V] (D : DBN V), FoldClosed D.zeros → (D.lam ≤ D.zero ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = D.zeros)) ∧
       3674      (∀ F : LiouvilleFacePinned, FoldClosed F.zeros → (FaithfulLambda ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros)) ∧
       3675      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → (LeastErasure Z ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z)) :=
       3676    ⟨fun E hE => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofWeil E) hE,
       3677     fun L hL => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofLi L) hL,
       3678     fun _ _ D hD => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofSign D) hD,
       3679     fun F hF => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofLiouville F) hF,
       3680     fun Z hZ => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofPosit Z) hZ⟩
       3681  
       3682  /-- The sign arrow of an assignment at the primes: `(−1)^{f(n)}` for the completely additive `f` with the value `a(p)`
       3683      at every prime. The assignment that sends every prime to one gives `λ`. -/
       3684  def arrowOf (a : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : Int := if extendAssignment a n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1
       3685  
       3686  /-- The walk of an assignment: the sum of its arrow over `1 ≤ n ≤ x`. -/
       3687  def walkOf (a : Nat → Int) : Nat → Int
       3688    | 0 => 0
       3689    | n + 1 => walkOf a n + arrowOf a (n + 1)
       3690  
       3691  /-- The Liouville sentence for an assignment at the primes. -/
       3692  def FaithfulOf (a : Nat → Int) : Prop :=
       3693    ∀ k m : Nat, 0 < k → 0 < m → ∃ C : Nat, ∀ x : Nat,
       3694      (walkOf a x).natAbs ^ (2 * m) ≤ C ^ (2 * m) * x ^ (m + 2 * k)
       3695  
       3696  theorem walk_is_the_walk_of_one (x : Nat) : liouvilleWalk x = walkOf (fun _ => 1) x := by
       3697    induction x with
       3698    | zero => rfl
       3699    | succ n ih =>
       3700      show liouvilleWalk n + liouvilleAll (n + 1) = walkOf (fun _ => 1) n + arrowOf (fun _ => 1) (n + 1)
       3701      rw [ih]
       3702      rfl
       3703  
       3704  /-- The Liouville sentence is the sentence of the assignment that sends every prime to one. -/
       3705  theorem faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one : FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1) := by
       3706    unfold FaithfulLambda FaithfulOf
       3707    simp only [walk_is_the_walk_of_one]
       3708  
       3709  /-- The assignment that sends every prime to zero extends to zero everywhere. -/
       3710  theorem blind_assignment_vanishes (n : Nat) : extendAssignment (fun _ => 0) n = 0 := by
       3711    unfold extendAssignment
       3712    exact sumBelow_zero _ _ (fun i _ => by
       3713      unfold extendTerm
       3714      split
       3715      · exact Int.mul_zero _
       3716      · rfl)
       3717  
       3718  /-- At that assignment the arrow is one everywhere and the walk is the identity. -/
       3719  theorem blind_walk (x : Nat) : walkOf (fun _ => 0) x = (x : Int) := by
       3720    induction x with
       3721    | zero => rfl
       3722    | succ n ih =>
       3723      show walkOf (fun _ => 0) n + arrowOf (fun _ => 0) (n + 1) = ((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)
       3724      rw [ih]
       3725      unfold arrowOf
       3726      rw [blind_assignment_vanishes, if_pos (by decide)]
       3727      omega
       3728  
       3729  /-- The Liouville sentence fails at the assignment that sends every prime to zero: at `k = 1, m = 3` the walk `x` would
       3730      need `x^6 ≤ C^6 x^5`, which fails at `x = C^6 + 1`. -/
       3731  theorem blind_is_unfaithful : ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0) := by
       3732    intro h
       3733    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h 1 3 (by decide) (by decide)
       3734    have hx := hC (C ^ 6 + 1)
       3735    rw [blind_walk] at hx
       3736    change (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 6 ≤ C ^ 6 * (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 at hx
       3737    have hpos : 0 < (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 := Nat.pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos _)
       3738    have e : (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 6 = (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 * (C ^ 6 + 1) := Nat.pow_succ (C ^ 6 + 1) 5
       3739    rw [e] at hx
       3740    generalize (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 = y at hx hpos
       3741    generalize C ^ 6 = c at hx
       3742    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_comm c y] at hx
       3743    omega
       3744  
       3745  /-- The Liouville sentence reads the primes: it is the sentence of one assignment, it fails at another, and so no proof
       3746      of it holds for every assignment. -/
       3747  theorem faithful_reads_the_primes :
       3748      (FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1)) ∧ ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0) ∧ ¬ ∀ a : Nat → Int, FaithfulOf a :=
       3749    ⟨faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one, blind_is_unfaithful, fun h => blind_is_unfaithful (h _)⟩
       3750  
       3751  /-- **The socket, whole.** The field of the act is the one socket: it can be filled at a fold-closed configuration
       3752      exactly when the hypothesis holds, and the closure takes any term in it with no other change. Every premise on
       3753      configurations forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails; a keyless premise
       3754      forces nothing; a premise that respects the record and forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed
       3755      configuration; a forcing premise is the value or fails at a configuration that satisfies the hypothesis, and fills
       3756      the field wherever it holds. Every sentence carried to the zeros by a cited equivalence fills the field exactly when
       3757      it holds. The named sentences depend on their configurations, and the one refutation is one point. -/
       3758  theorem the_socket :
       3759      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       3760      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → LeastErasure Z → RH Z) ∧
       3761      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z) ∧
       3762      (∀ A : World → Prop, Keyless A → ¬ Forces A) ∧
       3763      (∀ A : World → Prop, RespectsRecord A → Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (∃ z, Z z) → ¬ A Z) ∧
       3764      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z) ∧
       3765      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ∧
       3766      (∀ F : SocketFace, FoldClosed F.zeros → (F.sentence ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros)) ∧
       3767      (WeilPositive positiveInstance ∧ ¬ WeilPositive negativeInstance) ∧
       3768      (∀ N : Nat, ∃ L : LiStream, (∀ n, n < N → L.nonneg n) ∧ ¬ RH L.zeros) ∧
       3769      ((FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1)) ∧ ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0)) ∧
       3770      (∀ Z : World, ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z) :=
       3771    ⟨fun Z hZ => (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1, closure_takes_a_term, forces_or_has_a_twin, keyless_forces_nothing,
       3772     record_forcing_fails_everywhere, forcing_is_the_value_or_stronger, forcing_fills_the_socket, face_is_the_socket,
       3773     positivity_is_keyed, li_prefix_never_forces, ⟨faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one, blind_is_unfaithful⟩,
       3774     rejection_is_a_witness⟩
       3775  
       3776  /-! ### XXII.b · At resolution two the open strip holds a pair off the line
       3777  
       3778  At resolution one the chart's open strip `0 < x < 2` holds only the line, so a premise that places every zero inside
       3779  the open strip forces the line there: a fact of the coarse chart, not of the zeros. On the chart at resolution two, with
       3780  `x = 4 Re s`, the line `x = 2`, the fold `x ↦ 4 − x` and registration `(x, t) ↦ (2, t)`, the open strip `0 < x < 4`
       3781  holds the pair `x = 1, 3`, real parts one quarter and three quarters. There the open-strip premise forces nothing, no
       3782  reading of the record decides the value, and the refusals of the socket hold for premises that range over strip
       3783  configurations only. -/
       3784  
       3785  def fold₂ (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨4 - z.x, z.t⟩
       3786  def reg₂ (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨2, z.t⟩
       3787  def onLine₂ (z : Pt) : Prop := z.x = 2
       3788  def InStrip₂ (z : Pt) : Prop := 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 4
       3789  /-- A strip configuration at resolution two: fold-closed, and every zero inside the open strip. -/
       3790  def StripWorld₂ (Z : World) : Prop := (∀ z, Z z → Z (fold₂ z)) ∧ ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z
       3791  def RH₂ (Z : World) : Prop := ∀ z, Z z → onLine₂ z
       3792  def SameRecord₂ (Z Z' : World) : Prop := ∀ r, (∃ s, Z s ∧ reg₂ s = r) ↔ (∃ s, Z' s ∧ reg₂ s = r)
       3793  /-- A premise respects the record when it reads alike on two strip configurations of one record. -/
       3794  def RespectsRecord₂ (A : World → Prop) : Prop :=
       3795    ∀ Z Z', StripWorld₂ Z → StripWorld₂ Z' → SameRecord₂ Z Z' → (A Z ↔ A Z')
       3796  /-- A premise forces the line when every strip configuration it holds on satisfies the hypothesis. -/
       3797  def Forces₂ (A : World → Prop) : Prop := ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → A Z → RH₂ Z
       3798  
       3799  /-- The seat at resolution two: the fixed set of the fold is the line. -/
       3800  theorem fold₂_fixed_iff (z : Pt) : fold₂ z = z ↔ onLine₂ z := by
       3801    cases z with
       3802    | mk x t =>
       3803      show Pt.mk (4 - x) t = Pt.mk x t ↔ x = 2
       3804      constructor
       3805      · intro h
       3806        have hx := congrArg Pt.x h
       3807        change 4 - x = x at hx
       3808        omega
       3809      · intro h
       3810        subst h
       3811        rfl
       3812  
       3813  /-- At resolution one the open strip is the line: the premise that places every zero inside it forces the line. -/
       3814  theorem open_strip_forces_at_resolution_one : Forces (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2) := by
       3815    intro Z _ h z hz
       3816    have := h z hz
       3817    show z.x = 1
       3818    omega
       3819  
       3820  /-- The pair at real parts one quarter and three quarters, at the height `t`. -/
       3821  def innerPair₂ (t : Nat) : World := fun w => w = ⟨1, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨3, t⟩
       3822  
       3823  theorem innerPair₂_strip (t : Nat) : StripWorld₂ (innerPair₂ t) := by
       3824    refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
       3825    · rcases hw with h | h
       3826      · subst h
       3827        exact Or.inr rfl
       3828      · subst h
       3829        exact Or.inl rfl
       3830    · rcases hw with h | h
       3831      · subst h
       3832        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide, show (1 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3833      · subst h
       3834        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 3 by decide, show (3 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3835  
       3836  theorem innerPair₂_not_rh (t : Nat) : ¬ RH₂ (innerPair₂ t) := by
       3837    intro h
       3838    have e : (1 : Int) = 2 := h ⟨1, t⟩ (Or.inl rfl)
       3839    omega
       3840  
       3841  /-- At resolution two the open-strip premise forces nothing: the inner pair satisfies it and fails the hypothesis. -/
       3842  theorem open_strip_forces_nothing_at_resolution_two : ¬ Forces₂ (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z) :=
       3843    fun h => innerPair₂_not_rh 0 (h (innerPair₂ 0) (innerPair₂_strip 0) (innerPair₂_strip 0).2)
       3844  
       3845  /-- A premise true on every configuration forces nothing on strip configurations. -/
       3846  theorem keyless_forces_nothing₂ (A : World → Prop) (hA : ∀ Z, A Z) : ¬ Forces₂ A :=
       3847    fun h => innerPair₂_not_rh 0 (h _ (innerPair₂_strip 0) (hA _))
       3848  
       3849  /-- A strip configuration with the inner pair added at the height `t`. -/
       3850  def withPair₂ (Z : World) (t : Nat) : World := fun w => Z w ∨ w = ⟨1, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨3, t⟩
       3851  
       3852  theorem withPair₂_strip (Z : World) (hZ : StripWorld₂ Z) (t : Nat) : StripWorld₂ (withPair₂ Z t) := by
       3853    refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
       3854    · rcases hw with h | h | h
       3855      · exact Or.inl (hZ.1 w h)
       3856      · subst h
       3857        exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       3858      · subst h
       3859        exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       3860    · rcases hw with h | h | h
       3861      · exact hZ.2 w h
       3862      · subst h
       3863        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide, show (1 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3864      · subst h
       3865        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 3 by decide, show (3 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3866  
       3867  theorem withPair₂_same_record (Z : World) (z : Pt) (hz : Z z) : SameRecord₂ Z (withPair₂ Z z.t) := by
       3868    intro r
       3869    constructor
       3870    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3871      exact ⟨s, Or.inl hs, hsr⟩
       3872    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3873      rcases hs with h | h | h
       3874      · exact ⟨s, h, hsr⟩
       3875      · subst h
       3876        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3877      · subst h
       3878        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3879  
       3880  theorem withPair₂_not_rh (Z : World) (t : Nat) : ¬ RH₂ (withPair₂ Z t) := by
       3881    intro h
       3882    have e : (1 : Int) = 2 := h ⟨1, t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       3883    omega
       3884  
       3885  /-- A premise that respects the record and forces the line on strip configurations fails at every nonempty strip
       3886      configuration: its copy with the inner pair at the height of one of its zeros shares its record and fails the
       3887      hypothesis. -/
       3888  theorem record_forcing_fails_in_the_strip (A : World → Prop) (hr : RespectsRecord₂ A) (hf : Forces₂ A) (Z : World)
       3889      (hZ : StripWorld₂ Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z := by
       3890    intro ha
       3891    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
       3892    have hs := withPair₂_strip Z hZ z.t
       3893    exact withPair₂_not_rh Z z.t (hf _ hs ((hr Z _ hZ hs (withPair₂_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha))
       3894  
       3895  /-- No reading that respects the record decides the hypothesis on strip configurations. -/
       3896  theorem no_reading_decides_in_the_strip (g : World → Prop) (hg : RespectsRecord₂ g) :
       3897      ¬ ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (g Z ↔ RH₂ Z) := by
       3898    intro h
       3899    have hL : StripWorld₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) :=
       3900      ⟨fun w hw => by rw [hw]; rfl, fun w hw => by rw [hw]; exact ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
       3901    have hLrh : RH₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) := fun w hw => by rw [hw]; rfl
       3902    have hs := withPair₂_strip _ hL 14
       3903    have hsame : SameRecord₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) (withPair₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) 14) :=
       3904      withPair₂_same_record _ ⟨2, 14⟩ rfl
       3905    exact withPair₂_not_rh _ 14 ((h _ hs).mp ((hg _ _ hL hs hsame).mp ((h _ hL).mpr hLrh)))
       3906  
       3907  /-- Every premise either forces the line on strip configurations or holds at a strip configuration where the value
       3908      fails. Classical. -/
       3909  theorem forces_or_has_a_twin₂ (A : World → Prop) : Forces₂ A ∨ ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z :=
       3910    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z) Or.inr
       3911      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ ha => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨Z, hZ, ha, hn⟩)))
       3912  
       3913  /-- **The socket in the strip.** At resolution one the open strip is the line; at resolution two the fold fixes the
       3914      line, the open strip holds a pair off the line at every height, the open-strip premise and every keyless premise
       3915      force nothing, no reading of the record decides, a record-respecting forcing premise fails at every nonempty strip
       3916      configuration, and every premise forces or holds where the value fails. -/
       3917  theorem the_socket_in_the_strip :
       3918      Forces (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2) ∧
       3919      (∀ z : Pt, fold₂ z = z ↔ onLine₂ z) ∧
       3920      (∀ t : Nat, StripWorld₂ (innerPair₂ t) ∧ ¬ RH₂ (innerPair₂ t)) ∧
       3921      ¬ Forces₂ (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z) ∧
       3922      (∀ A : World → Prop, (∀ Z, A Z) → ¬ Forces₂ A) ∧
       3923      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord₂ g → ¬ ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (g Z ↔ RH₂ Z)) ∧
       3924      (∀ A : World → Prop, RespectsRecord₂ A → Forces₂ A → ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (∃ z, Z z) → ¬ A Z) ∧
       3925      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces₂ A ∨ ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z) :=
       3926    ⟨open_strip_forces_at_resolution_one, fold₂_fixed_iff, fun t => ⟨innerPair₂_strip t, innerPair₂_not_rh t⟩,
       3927     open_strip_forces_nothing_at_resolution_two, keyless_forces_nothing₂, no_reading_decides_in_the_strip,
       3928     record_forcing_fails_in_the_strip, forces_or_has_a_twin₂⟩
       3929  
       3930  /-! ## XXII.c · Two denials, and the witness the act forces
       3931  
       3932  A denial has two parts: the act of making it, and the sentence it asserts. Two denials are read side by side, over
       3933  every self-grounding root. The denial of the root asserts that the root fails; the act of making it instances the
       3934  root, so its sentence is refuted by its own act and only the root remains. The denial of the hypothesis asserts that
       3935  a zero lies off the line; the act of making it instances the root, which the twin carries too, and its sentence denies
       3936  the self-grounding assertion of the line at the zero set, which the twin does not carry: in time the twin is timeless
       3937  and unseeded. The assertion stands at the actual zero set by the act of section XI, and there the denial is refuted.
       3938  On the act every computation that reads the zero set reports points on the line, and a computation that reports a
       3939  point off the line reads no act. -/
       3940  
       3941  /-- A seeded timeless witness of the line, for a world in time: one locus at every instant, the same truth value of
       3942      the hypothesis at every instant, and the hypothesis at instant 0, the seed. -/
       3943  structure SeededWitness (W : TWorld) : Prop where
       3944    same_locus : SameLocus W
       3945    timeless   : TimelessT W
       3946    seed       : RH (W 0)
       3947  
       3948  /-- A world in time carries a seeded timeless witness exactly when the hypothesis holds at every instant. -/
       3949  theorem seeded_witness_iff_bound (W : TWorld) : SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W :=
       3950    ⟨fun w => (template_binds_iff_seed W w.timeless).mpr w.seed,
       3951     fun h => ⟨fold_face_keyless W, fun t s => ⟨fun _ => h s, fun _ => h t⟩, h 0⟩⟩
       3952  
       3953  /-- The constant twin, timeless and fold-closed at every instant, carries no seeded witness. -/
       3954  theorem twin_has_no_seeded_witness : ¬ SeededWitness WTwin :=
       3955    fun w => W2f_not_rh w.seed
       3956  
       3957  /-- The constant on-line world carries one. -/
       3958  theorem line_world_has_a_seeded_witness : SeededWitness WOn :=
       3959    (seeded_witness_iff_bound WOn).mpr closure_face_on_line
       3960  
       3961  /-- Every denial, whatever its sentence, is an act, and every act instances the root. -/
       3962  theorem every_denial_is_an_act {root C : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) (a : G.Act) (_c : C) : root :=
       3963    G.instances a
       3964  
       3965  /-- A denial of a self-grounding root is refuted by its own act: its sentence denies what its act instances. -/
       3966  theorem root_denial_refutes_itself {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) (a : G.Act) (n : ¬ root) : False :=
       3967    n (G.instances a)
       3968  
       3969  /-- A denial of the hypothesis at a world denies the self-grounding assertion of the line there. -/
       3970  theorem line_denial_denies_the_assertion (Z : World) (h : ¬ RH Z) :
       3971      ¬ ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G.Act :=
       3972    fun e => h ((supply_iff (RH Z)).mp e)
       3973  
       3974  /-- In time, a denial of the hypothesis at instant 0 denies every seeded witness. -/
       3975  theorem line_denial_denies_every_seed (W : TWorld) (h : ¬ RH (W 0)) : ¬ SeededWitness W :=
       3976    fun w => h w.seed
       3977  
       3978  /-- The twin carries the root, fold-closure, the record of W1 and the timeless form; it carries neither a
       3979      self-grounding assertion of the line nor a seeded witness. -/
       3980  theorem twin_carries_the_root_and_no_seed {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       3981      root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       3982      (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin :=
       3983    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, W2f_closed, same_record_f, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, W2f_not_rh, line_not_self_grounding,
       3984     twin_has_no_seeded_witness⟩
       3985  
       3986  /-- The root alone forces nothing: it holds on every world, the twin written out included. -/
       3987  theorem the_root_alone_forces_nothing {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) : ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) :=
       3988    keyless_forces_nothing_free (fun _ => root) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct)
       3989  
       3990  /-- At every instance of the actual zero set the self-grounding assertion of the line exists. -/
       3991  theorem the_act_asserts_the_line (A : ActualZeros) : ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G.Act :=
       3992    (supply_iff (RH A.zeros)).mpr (rh_from_the_act A)
       3993  
       3994  /-- The constant family of the actual zero set carries a seeded witness. -/
       3995  theorem the_act_seeds_its_constant_world (A : ActualZeros) : SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) :=
       3996    (seeded_witness_iff_bound _).mpr (fun _ => rh_from_the_act A)
       3997  
       3998  /-- On the act the denial of the hypothesis is refuted. -/
       3999  theorem line_denial_refuted_on_the_act (A : ActualZeros) (h : ¬ RH A.zeros) : False :=
       4000    h (rh_from_the_act A)
       4001  
       4002  /-- TWO DENIALS, ONE FORM. For every self-grounding root: every denial is an act and instances the root; the denial
       4003      of the root is refuted by its own act; the denial of the hypothesis denies the self-grounding assertion of the line
       4004      and, in time, the seed; the twin carries the root and neither of these, so the root alone forces nothing, and a
       4005      seeded witness exists exactly where the line holds at every instant; on the act the assertion exists, the seed
       4006      stands, and the denial is refuted. -/
       4007  theorem two_denials {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4008      (∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4009      (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4010      (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4011      (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4012      (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4013        (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4014      SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4015      ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4016      (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4017        SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False)) :=
       4018    ⟨fun _ a c => every_denial_is_an_act G a c,
       4019     fun a n => root_denial_refutes_itself G a n,
       4020     line_denial_denies_the_assertion,
       4021     seeded_witness_iff_bound,
       4022     twin_carries_the_root_and_no_seed G,
       4023     line_world_has_a_seeded_witness,
       4024     the_root_alone_forces_nothing G,
       4025     fun A => ⟨the_act_asserts_the_line A, the_act_seeds_its_constant_world A, line_denial_refuted_on_the_act A⟩⟩
       4026  
       4027  /-- At the root proposition 0 < 1, with the unit act. -/
       4028  theorem two_denials_at_the_root :
       4029      (∀ C : Prop, rootSelfGrounding.Act → C → RootAct) ∧
       4030      (rootSelfGrounding.Act → ¬ RootAct → False) ∧
       4031      (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4032      (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4033      (RootAct ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4034        (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4035      SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4036      ¬ Forces (fun _ => RootAct) ∧
       4037      (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4038        SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False)) :=
       4039    two_denials rootSelfGrounding
       4040  
       4041  /-- A computation that ends: the finite list of points it reports as zeros. -/
       4042  structure Computation where
       4043    reports : List Pt
       4044  
       4045  /-- A computation reads an act when every point it reports is a zero of the act's zero set. -/
       4046  def Computation.Reads (c : Computation) (A : ActualZeros) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → A.zeros z
       4047  
       4048  /-- On the act nothing is left undecided: the hypothesis, least erasure, no point off the line, the zero set its own
       4049      record, and every consequence of the hypothesis at the zero set. -/
       4050  theorem nothing_left_open_on_the_act (A : ActualZeros) :
       4051      RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧ (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧
       4052      (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros) :=
       4053    ⟨rh_from_the_act A, A.supply, fun ⟨z, hz, h⟩ => h (rh_from_the_act A z hz),
       4054     (rh_iff_own_record A.zeros).mp (rh_from_the_act A), fun _ hQ => hQ A.zeros (rh_from_the_act A)⟩
       4055  
       4056  /-- Every computation that reads an act reports only points on the line. -/
       4057  theorem computation_reading_the_act_lands_on_the_line (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation) (h : c.Reads A) :
       4058      ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z :=
       4059    fun z hz => rh_from_the_act A z (h z hz)
       4060  
       4061  /-- A computation that reports a point off the line reads no act. -/
       4062  theorem off_line_report_reads_no_act (c : Computation) (z : Pt) (hz : z ∈ c.reports) (h : ¬ onLine z) :
       4063      ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A :=
       4064    fun ⟨A, hA⟩ => h (rh_from_the_act A z (hA z hz))
       4065  
       4066  /-- The computation that reports the zero of the twin at real part 0. -/
       4067  def twinReport : Computation := ⟨[⟨0, 14⟩]⟩
       4068  
       4069  /-- A computation that reads no act is not forced: the twin's report stands off the line and reads no act. -/
       4070  theorem a_computation_reading_no_act_is_not_forced :
       4071      ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧ ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, twinReport.Reads A :=
       4072    ⟨fun h => absurd (h twinReport ⟨0, 14⟩ (List.Mem.head _)) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)),
       4073     off_line_report_reads_no_act twinReport ⟨0, 14⟩ (List.Mem.head _) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1))⟩
       4074  
       4075  /-- THE WITNESS FORCED BY THE ACT. On every act nothing is left undecided; every computation that reads the act reports
       4076      only points on the line; a computation that reports a point off the line reads no act; and the forcing reaches
       4077      exactly the computations that read an act. -/
       4078  theorem the_witness_forced_by_the_act :
       4079      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4080        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4081      (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4082      (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4083      ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) :=
       4084    ⟨nothing_left_open_on_the_act, computation_reading_the_act_lands_on_the_line, off_line_report_reads_no_act,
       4085     a_computation_reading_no_act_is_not_forced.1⟩
       4086  
       4087  /-- Section XXII.c, whole, over every self-grounding root. -/
       4088  theorem the_denials_and_the_witness {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4089      ((∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4090       (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4091       (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4092       (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4093       (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4094         (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4095       SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4096       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4097       (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4098         SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False))) ∧
       4099      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4100        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4101       (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4102       (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4103       ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z)) :=
       4104    ⟨two_denials G, the_witness_forced_by_the_act⟩
       4105  
       4106  /-! ## XXIII · Double security: the two channels of the line
       4107  
       4108  The formal gate: nothing passes for the hypothesis but least erasure, and the act passes it with an empty cone. The
       4109  actuation gate: nothing passes against it but a point off the line; the root, which every act re-enacts, crosses
       4110  neither way; a registration costs nothing exactly at least erasure, one floor per erased bit. Between the gates the
       4111  bit stays keyed. Every conjunct is a theorem above; this section adds their conjunction and no content. -/
       4112  
       4113  /-- DOUBLE SECURITY. The formal gate, the actuation gate, and the keyed bit between them. -/
       4114  theorem double_security :
       4115      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4116      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4117      (∀ Z : World, ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z) ∧
       4118      (∀ Act : Type, Act → RootAct) ∧
       4119      (¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → RH Z) ∧
       4120      (¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → ¬ RH Z) ∧
       4121      (¬ ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G.Act) ∧
       4122      (∀ C : FinCfg, C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world) ∧
       4123      landauerFloor = 2870978885078723755499100 ∧
       4124      ¬ RespectsRecord LeastErasure ∧
       4125      (∃ Z : World, FoldClosed Z ∧ ¬ LeastErasure Z) :=
       4126    ⟨rh_from_the_act, least_erasure_is_the_value, rejection_is_a_witness,
       4127     fun _ a => act_reenacts_root a, root_does_not_cross_the_line, root_does_not_cross_the_denial,
       4128     line_not_self_grounding, price_zero_iff_least_erasure, landauer_floor_exact,
       4129     least_erasure_reads_past_the_record,
       4130     ⟨W2, W2_closed, fun h => W2_not_rh ((least_erasure_is_the_value W2).mp h)⟩⟩
       4131  
       4132  /-! ## XXIV · the root, undeniable in act, and the lock -/
       4133  
       4134  /-- THE ROOT IS UNDENIABLE IN ACT: a denial of a self-grounding root is an act, and instances it. -/
       4135  theorem denial_reenacts_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (denial : G.Act) : R :=
       4136    G.instances denial
       4137  
       4138  /-- The root is held by the act itself. -/
       4139  theorem seated_undeniable {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : R := G.instances G.anAct
       4140  
       4141  /-- No outside proof adds anything to a self-grounding root. -/
       4142  theorem external_proof_adds_nothing {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (Q : Prop) : (Q → R) ↔ R :=
       4143    ⟨fun _ => G.instances G.anAct, fun r _ => r⟩
       4144  
       4145  /-- THE UNDENIABLE ROOT HOLDS IN BOTH WORLDS: it holds by its act; the two fold-closed worlds share one
       4146  record, the hypothesis holds on the first and fails on the second; so read uniformly on the worlds the
       4147  root forces no value. -/
       4148  theorem undeniable_root_forces_no_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4149      R ∧ (FoldClosed W1 ∧ RH W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧ SameRecord W1 W2 ∧ ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) :=
       4150    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, ⟨W1_closed, W1_rh⟩, ⟨W2_closed, W2_not_rh⟩, same_record_12,
       4151     keyless_forces_nothing (fun _ => R) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct)⟩
       4152  
       4153  /-- The root's form: every existent of a domain actuates, its actuation positive. -/
       4154  def Root (U : Type) (ΔE : U → Int) : Prop := ∀ x : U, 0 < ΔE x
       4155  
       4156  /-- The indicator of a decided proposition: one where it holds, zero where it fails. -/
       4157  def indicator {p : Prop} : Decidable p → Int
       4158    | isTrue _  => 1
       4159    | isFalse _ => 0
       4160  
       4161  /-- The indicator is positive exactly where its proposition holds. -/
       4162  theorem indicator_pos {p : Prop} (h : Decidable p) : 0 < indicator h ↔ p :=
       4163    match h with
       4164    | isTrue hp  => ⟨fun _ => hp, fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide⟩
       4165    | isFalse hn => ⟨fun h0 => absurd h0 (show ¬ (0 : Int) < 0 by decide), fun hp => absurd hp hn⟩
       4166  
       4167  /-- THE CONSTRUCTED ROOT, in the words of Appendix R: one existent, whose actuation is one. A theorem
       4168  with no hypothesis and no axiom. -/
       4169  theorem constructed_root_holds : Root Unit (fun _ => 1) := fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide
       4170  
       4171  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS: to exist is to actuate, `Root` itself, with the existents the points of
       4172  the world and the actuation of a point one where it stands on the line and zero where it does not. -/
       4173  def RootAtZeros (Z : World) : Prop :=
       4174    Root { z : Pt // Z z } (fun z => indicator (inferInstanceAs (Decidable (onLine z.1))))
       4175  
       4176  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS THE HYPOTHESIS. -/
       4177  theorem root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis (Z : World) : RootAtZeros Z ↔ RH Z :=
       4178    ⟨fun h z hz => (indicator_pos _).mp (h ⟨z, hz⟩), fun h z => (indicator_pos _).mpr (h z.1 z.2)⟩
       4179  
       4180  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS LEAST ERASURE. -/
       4181  theorem root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure (Z : World) : RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z :=
       4182    ⟨fun h => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).mp h),
       4183     fun h => (root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).mpr ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp h)⟩
       4184  
       4185  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS KEYED: it holds on the fold-closed world on the line and fails on its
       4186  fold-closed twin of one record. -/
       4187  theorem root_at_zeros_is_keyed :
       4188      (FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2) :=
       4189    ⟨⟨W1_closed, (root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis W1).mpr W1_rh⟩,
       4190     ⟨W2_closed, fun h => W2_not_rh ((root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis W2).mp h)⟩⟩
       4191  
       4192  /-- THE ROOT READ ON THE ROW IS KEYED: the root holds, and read uniformly on the worlds it forces
       4193  nothing; read at the zeros it is least erasure, keyed, which decides where the root alone does not. -/
       4194  theorem root_read_on_row_is_keyed {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4195      R ∧ ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) ∧ (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4196      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) :=
       4197    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, keyless_forces_nothing (fun _ => R) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct),
       4198     root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure,
       4199     root_at_zeros_is_keyed⟩
       4200  
       4201  /-- LEAST ERASURE, UNCONDITIONAL: on every world, with no hypothesis and no premise, least erasure of
       4202  the world is the hypothesis of the line on it. -/
       4203  theorem least_erasure_unconditional : ∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z :=
       4204    least_erasure_is_the_value
       4205  
       4206  /-- THE LOCK, one theorem: the constructed root holds with no hypothesis; the root holds by the act and
       4207  holds on both worlds of one record; read uniformly it forces nothing; read at the zeros it is least
       4208  erasure, keyed; least erasure is the hypothesis on every world, unconditionally; the closing theorem gives
       4209  the hypothesis on the actual zeros by one act; and no record-respecting reading decides the value on the
       4210  fold-closed worlds. -/
       4211  theorem the_lock {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4212      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4213      R ∧
       4214      (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4215      ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) ∧
       4216      (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4217      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4218      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4219      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4220      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) :=
       4221    ⟨constructed_root_holds, G.instances G.anAct, ⟨W1_rh, W2_closed, W2_not_rh⟩, (root_read_on_row_is_keyed G).2.1,
       4222     root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure, root_at_zeros_is_keyed, least_erasure_unconditional, rh_from_the_act,
       4223     record_decides_nothing⟩
       4224  
       4225  /-! ## XXV · Admissible forcing is vacuous; the closure at every resolution; the readings of the root joined
       4226  
       4227  An admissible premise that forces the line holds at no nonempty fold-closed configuration, and the constant false
       4228  premise is admissible and forces, so the class is not empty. At resolution `n` the line is `x = n`, the fold is
       4229  `x ↦ 2n − x` and registration is `(x, t) ↦ (n, t)`; the chart is resolution one and Section XXII.b is resolution two.
       4230  The closure of Section XXI holds there with least erasure as the one field, and from `n = 2` on the open strip
       4231  `0 < x < 2n` holds the pair `x = n − 1, n + 1` off the line, so the strip does not supply the bit; at resolution one
       4232  the pair at offset `k ≥ 2` lies outside the closed strip. The readings of the root are joined in one theorem, and the
       4233  lock is stated at the constructed root. On a finite configuration a search through its pairs, which terminates, finds a
       4234  point off the line exactly when least erasure fails. The posit is an act; no reading of the record returns any of the
       4235  five chart readings; the primes are a free basis; least erasure is the self-verification of the hypothesis; the
       4236  certified world is fold-closed; every route of the ledger carries the theorem its status names; and the tenth falsifier,
       4237  a point off the line, is exactly the failure of the line and is barred on the zero set the act supplies. -/
       4238  
       4239  /-! ### XXV.a · Admissible forcing is vacuous -/
       4240  
       4241  /-- ADMISSIBLE FORCING IS VACUOUS: an admissible premise that forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed
       4242  configuration. -/
       4243  theorem admissible_forcing_is_vacuous (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World)
       4244      (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z :=
       4245    Or.elim hA (fun k _ => keyless_forces_nothing_free A k hf)
       4246      (fun r ha => match hne with
       4247        | ⟨z, hz⟩ =>
       4248          absurd (hf (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_closed Z hZ z.t)
       4249              ((r Z (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha) ⟨0, z.t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
       4250            (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)))
       4251  
       4252  /-- COALITION FORCING IS VACUOUS: a coalition of admissible atoms that forces the line fails at every nonempty
       4253  fold-closed configuration. -/
       4254  theorem coalition_forcing_is_vacuous {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop) (h : ∀ i, Admissible (at_ i))
       4255      (c : Coalition ι) (hf : Forces (Coalition.eval at_ c)) (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) :
       4256      ¬ Coalition.eval at_ c Z :=
       4257    admissible_forcing_is_vacuous _ (coalition_admissible at_ h c) hf Z hZ hne
       4258  
       4259  /-- AN ADMISSIBLE PREMISE FORCES: the constant false premise is admissible and forces the line, holding nowhere. -/
       4260  theorem an_admissible_premise_forces : Admissible (fun _ => False) ∧ Forces (fun _ => False) :=
       4261    ⟨admissible_const False, fun _ _ h => h.elim⟩
       4262  
       4263  /-! ### XXV.b · The closure at resolution n -/
       4264  
       4265  /-- TWICE IS A SUM: twice an integer is the integer added to itself. -/
       4266  theorem int_two_mul (a : Int) : 2 * a = a + a := by
       4267    rw [show (2 : Int) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
       4268  
       4269  /-- TWICE LESS ONCE: twice an integer less the integer is the integer. -/
       4270  theorem int_two_mul_sub (n : Int) : 2 * n - n = n :=
       4271    (congrArg (· - n) (int_two_mul n)).trans (Int.add_sub_cancel n n)
       4272  
       4273  /-- The fold at resolution `n`: the line is `x = n`. -/
       4274  def foldAt (n : Int) (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨2 * n - z.x, z.t⟩
       4275  
       4276  /-- Registration at resolution `n`: it lands on the line `x = n` and keeps the height. -/
       4277  def regAt (n : Int) (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨n, z.t⟩
       4278  
       4279  /-- THE FOLD AT RESOLUTION N IS AN INVOLUTION: folding twice returns the point. -/
       4280  theorem foldAt_invol (n : Int) (z : Pt) : foldAt n (foldAt n z) = z :=
       4281    congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t) (Int.sub_sub_self (2 * n) z.x)
       4282  
       4283  /-- THE SEAT AT RESOLUTION N: the fold fixes a point exactly when the point lies on the line `x = n`. -/
       4284  theorem foldAt_fixed_iff (n : Int) (z : Pt) : foldAt n z = z ↔ z.x = n :=
       4285    ⟨fun h => (Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide : (2 : Int) ≠ 0)
       4286        (((Int.sub_add_cancel (2 * n) z.x).symm.trans (congrArg (· + z.x) (congrArg Pt.x h))).trans
       4287          (int_two_mul z.x).symm)).symm,
       4288     fun h => congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t)
       4289        (((congrArg (fun y => 2 * n - y) h).trans (int_two_mul_sub n)).trans h.symm)⟩
       4290  
       4291  /-- THE CHART AND THE STRIP ARE TWO RESOLUTIONS: the fold at resolution one is the chart's fold, and at resolution two
       4292  it is the fold of Section XXII.b. -/
       4293  theorem foldAt_specializes : (∀ z, foldAt 1 z = fold z) ∧ (∀ z, foldAt 2 z = fold₂ z) :=
       4294    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
       4295  
       4296  /-- THE FOLD KEEPS THE OPEN STRIP: at resolution `n` a point with `0 < x < 2n` folds to a point with the same bounds. -/
       4297  theorem foldAt_strip (n : Int) (z : Pt) (h : 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n) :
       4298      0 < (foldAt n z).x ∧ (foldAt n z).x < 2 * n :=
       4299    ⟨Int.sub_pos_of_lt h.2, Int.sub_lt_self (2 * n) h.1⟩
       4300  
       4301  /-- THE PAIR ABOUT THE LINE: at resolution `n` the fold exchanges the points at `x = n − 1` and `x = n + 1`. -/
       4302  theorem foldAt_pair (n : Int) (t : Nat) :
       4303      foldAt n ⟨n - 1, t⟩ = ⟨n + 1, t⟩ ∧ foldAt n ⟨n + 1, t⟩ = ⟨n - 1, t⟩ :=
       4304    have e : foldAt n ⟨n - 1, t⟩ = ⟨n + 1, t⟩ := congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y t)
       4305      (((congrArg (· - (n - 1)) (int_two_mul n)).trans (Int.add_sub_assoc n n (n - 1))).trans
       4306        (congrArg (n + ·) (Int.sub_sub_self n 1)))
       4307    ⟨e, (congrArg (foldAt n) e.symm).trans (foldAt_invol n _)⟩
       4308  
       4309  /-- The fold at resolution `n`, as a carrier fold. -/
       4310  def chartAt (n : Int) : Carrier.Fold Pt := ⟨foldAt n, foldAt_invol n⟩
       4311  
       4312  /-- Registration at resolution `n`, as a carrier registration: it lands on the line, fixes it, and forgets the side. -/
       4313  def regChartAt (n : Int) : Carrier.Registration (chartAt n) :=
       4314    ⟨regAt n, fun z => (foldAt_fixed_iff n (regAt n z)).mpr rfl,
       4315     fun z h => congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t) ((foldAt_fixed_iff n z).mp h).symm, fun _ => rfl⟩
       4316  
       4317  /-- A zero set at resolution `n` with its fold-closure, its open strip, and the one posit, least erasure. -/
       4318  structure ActualZerosAt (n : Int) where
       4319    /-- The zero set, as a world on the chart. -/
       4320    zeros : World
       4321    /-- The zero set is closed under the fold at resolution `n`. -/
       4322    closed : ∀ z, zeros z → zeros (foldAt n z)
       4323    /-- Every zero lies inside the open strip `0 < x < 2n`. -/
       4324    strip : ∀ z, zeros z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n
       4325    /-- The posit: least erasure of the zero set under registration at resolution `n`. -/
       4326    supply : Carrier.LeastErasureC (regChartAt n) zeros
       4327  
       4328  /-- THE CLOSURE AT RESOLUTION N: from the posit, every zero is fixed by the fold at resolution `n`. -/
       4329  theorem rh_from_the_act_at (n : Int) (A : ActualZerosAt n) : Carrier.RHc (chartAt n) A.zeros :=
       4330    (Carrier.least_erasure_is_the_value_C (regChartAt n)
       4331      (fun x => match decEq ((chartAt n).σ x) x with
       4332        | isTrue h => Or.inl h
       4333        | isFalse h => Or.inr h) A.zeros).mp A.supply
       4334  
       4335  /-- THE STRIP DOES NOT SUPPLY THE BIT: from resolution two on, the pair at `x = n − 1` and `x = n + 1` at height zero
       4336  is fold-closed, lies inside the open strip, and is not fixed by the fold. -/
       4337  theorem strip_does_not_supply_at (n : Int) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
       4338      ∃ Z : World, (∀ z, Z z → Z (foldAt n z)) ∧ (∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n) ∧
       4339        ¬ Carrier.RHc (chartAt n) Z :=
       4340    have h0 : (0 : Int) ≤ n := Int.le_trans (by decide : (0 : Int) ≤ 2) hn
       4341    have hlo : n - 1 < n := Int.sub_lt_self n (by decide : (0 : Int) < 1)
       4342    have hle : n ≤ 2 * n :=
       4343      Eq.subst (motive := fun y => n ≤ y) (int_two_mul n).symm (Int.le_add_of_nonneg_right h0)
       4344    have hs : 0 < (⟨n - 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x ∧ (⟨n - 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x < 2 * n :=
       4345      ⟨Int.sub_pos_of_lt (Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : Int) < 2) hn), Int.lt_of_lt_of_le hlo hle⟩
       4346    have hs' : 0 < (⟨n + 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x ∧ (⟨n + 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x < 2 * n :=
       4347      Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => 0 < w.x ∧ w.x < 2 * n) (foldAt_pair n 0).1 (foldAt_strip n _ hs)
       4348    ⟨fun w => w = ⟨n - 1, 0⟩ ∨ w = ⟨n + 1, 0⟩,
       4349     fun w hw => Or.elim hw
       4350       (fun e => Or.inr ((congrArg (foldAt n) e).trans (foldAt_pair n 0).1))
       4351       (fun e => Or.inl ((congrArg (foldAt n) e).trans (foldAt_pair n 0).2)),
       4352     fun w hw => Or.elim hw
       4353       (fun e => Eq.subst (motive := fun v : Pt => 0 < v.x ∧ v.x < 2 * n) e.symm hs)
       4354       (fun e => Eq.subst (motive := fun v : Pt => 0 < v.x ∧ v.x < 2 * n) e.symm hs'),
       4355     fun h => Int.lt_irrefl n (Eq.subst (motive := fun y => y < n)
       4356       ((foldAt_fixed_iff n ⟨n - 1, 0⟩).mp (h ⟨n - 1, 0⟩ (Or.inl rfl))) hlo)⟩
       4357  
       4358  /-- THE PAIR OUTSIDE THE CLOSED STRIP: at resolution one an offset of at least two places the pair outside
       4359  `0 ≤ x ≤ 2`. -/
       4360  theorem pair_outside_the_closed_strip (k : Int) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : 1 - k < 0 ∧ 2 < 1 + k :=
       4361    ⟨Int.sub_neg_of_lt (Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : Int) < 2) hk),
       4362     Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (2 : Int) < 1 + 2) (Int.add_le_add_left hk 1)⟩
       4363  
       4364  /-! ### XXV.c · The readings of the root, joined -/
       4365  
       4366  /-- THE READINGS OF THE ROOT, JOINED: the constructed root is the proposition `0 < 1`; it has a self-grounding supply
       4367  with an act; read uniformly on the worlds it forces nothing; read at the zeros it is the hypothesis; and it does not
       4368  hold of every domain, since a domain whose actuation is zero refutes it. -/
       4369  theorem root_readings_joined :
       4370      (Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ↔ RootAct) ∧ Nonempty (SelfGrounding (Root Unit (fun _ => 1))) ∧
       4371      ¬ Forces (fun _ => Root Unit (fun _ => 1)) ∧ (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4372      ¬ ∀ (U : Type) (ΔE : U → Int), Root U ΔE :=
       4373    ⟨⟨fun h => h (), fun h _ => h⟩, ⟨⟨Unit, (), fun _ => constructed_root_holds⟩⟩,
       4374     keyless_forces_nothing_free _ (fun _ => constructed_root_holds), root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis,
       4375     fun h => absurd (h Unit (fun _ => 0) ()) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) < 0))⟩
       4376  
       4377  /-- THE LOCK ON THE CONSTRUCTED ROOT: the lock, with the root taken to be the constructed root and its supply the unit
       4378  act. -/
       4379  theorem the_lock_on_the_constructed_root :
       4380      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4381      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4382      (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4383      ¬ Forces (fun _ => Root Unit (fun _ => 1)) ∧
       4384      (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4385      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4386      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4387      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4388      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) :=
       4389    the_lock ⟨Unit, (), fun _ => constructed_root_holds⟩
       4390  
       4391  /-! ### XXV.d · The rejection, computed -/
       4392  
       4393  /-- The first off-line pair of a list of pairs, found by a search from the front. -/
       4394  def firstOff : List (Int × Nat) → Option (Int × Nat)
       4395    | [] => none
       4396    | p :: ps => if p.1 = 0 then firstOff ps else some p
       4397  
       4398  /-- THE SEARCH IS TOTAL: it returns nothing and every pair has offset zero, or it returns a pair of the list with a
       4399  nonzero offset. -/
       4400  theorem firstOff_spec (ps : List (Int × Nat)) :
       4401      (firstOff ps = none ∧ ∀ p ∈ ps, p.1 = 0) ∨ ∃ p, firstOff ps = some p ∧ p ∈ ps ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 :=
       4402    match ps with
       4403    | [] => Or.inl ⟨rfl, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
       4404    | p :: qs =>
       4405      if e : p.1 = 0 then
       4406        have hc : firstOff (p :: qs) = firstOff qs := if_pos e
       4407        match firstOff_spec qs with
       4408        | Or.inl ⟨hn, hz⟩ => Or.inl ⟨hc.trans hn, fun q hq => match q, hq with
       4409            | _, List.Mem.head _ => e
       4410            | _, List.Mem.tail _ hq' => hz _ hq'⟩
       4411        | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hm, hne⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hc.trans hq, List.Mem.tail p hm, hne⟩
       4412      else
       4413        Or.inr ⟨p, if_neg e, List.Mem.head qs, e⟩
       4414  
       4415  /-- AN OFFSET IS READ OFF ITS POINT: the point at `x = 1 − a` lies on the line only when `a = 0`. -/
       4416  theorem offset_off_line (a : Int) (t : Nat) (h : a ≠ 0) : ¬ onLine ⟨1 - a, t⟩ :=
       4417    fun e => h (((Int.sub_sub_self 1 a).symm.trans (congrArg (fun y => 1 - y) e)).trans (by decide))
       4418  
       4419  /-- THE REJECTION, COMPUTED: if least erasure fails on a finite configuration, the search returns a pair `(k, t)` of
       4420  the configuration with `k ≠ 0` whose point `(1 − k, t)` lies in the world and off the line. -/
       4421  theorem rejection_is_computed (C : FinCfg) (h : ¬ LeastErasure C.world) :
       4422      ∃ p, firstOff C.pairs = some p ∧ p ∈ C.pairs ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ C.world ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ ∧
       4423        ¬ onLine ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ :=
       4424    match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4425    | Or.inl ⟨_, hz⟩ => absurd ((least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mpr (fun _ hz' =>
       4426        Or.elim hz' (fun hx => hx.1) (fun ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩ => absurd (hz p hp) hk))) h
       4427    | Or.inr ⟨p, hf, hm, hk⟩ => ⟨p, hf, hm, hk, Or.inr ⟨p, hm, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩, offset_off_line p.1 p.2 hk⟩
       4428  
       4429  /-- THE SEARCH DECIDES LEAST ERASURE: a finite configuration has least erasure exactly when the search returns
       4430  nothing. -/
       4431  theorem least_erasure_iff_search_empty (C : FinCfg) : LeastErasure C.world ↔ firstOff C.pairs = none :=
       4432    ⟨fun hle => match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4433      | Or.inl ⟨hn, _⟩ => hn
       4434      | Or.inr ⟨p, _, hm, hk⟩ =>
       4435        absurd ((least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mp hle _ (Or.inr ⟨p, hm, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩))
       4436          (offset_off_line p.1 p.2 hk),
       4437     fun hn => match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4438      | Or.inl ⟨_, hz⟩ => (least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mpr (fun _ hz' =>
       4439        Or.elim hz' (fun hx => hx.1) (fun ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩ => absurd (hz p hp) hk))
       4440      | Or.inr ⟨_, hs, _, _⟩ => Option.noConfusion (hn.symm.trans hs)⟩
       4441  
       4442  /-! ### XXV.e · The posit, the readings, the basis, the recursion, the certified world, the ledger -/
       4443  
       4444  /-- THE POSIT IS AN ACT: at the actual zeros the posit has a self-grounding supply with an act. -/
       4445  theorem the_posit_is_a_deed (A : ActualZeros) : ∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure A.zeros), Nonempty G.Act :=
       4446    ⟨⟨Unit, (), fun _ => A.supply⟩, ⟨()⟩⟩
       4447  
       4448  /-- A READING KEYED ON THE TWINS IS NOT RETURNED: a reading true on W1 and false on W2f agrees with no reading of the
       4449  record on every fold-closed world. -/
       4450  theorem keyed_reading_not_returned (P : World → Prop) (h1 : P W1) (h2 : ¬ P W2f) (g : World → Prop)
       4451      (hg : RespectsRecord g) : ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ P Z) :=
       4452    fun h => h2 ((h W2f W2f_closed).mp ((hg W1 W2f same_record_f).mp ((h W1 W1_closed).mpr h1)))
       4453  
       4454  /-- NO READING OF THE RECORD RETURNS ANY READING: lossless registration, displacement zero, no left zero, stability
       4455  and least erasure each hold on W1 and fail on W2f, so no reading of the record agrees with any of them. -/
       4456  theorem no_record_reading_returns_any_reading (g : World → Prop) (hg : RespectsRecord g) :
       4457      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ Lossless Z)) ∧ ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ DepthZero Z)) ∧
       4458      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ ¬ Left Z)) ∧ ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ Stable Z)) ∧
       4459      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ LeastErasure Z)) :=
       4460    ⟨keyed_reading_not_returned Lossless
       4461       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => reg w = w) (Eq.symm hz) rfl)
       4462       (fun h => absurd (congrArg Pt.x (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl))) (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Int) = 0))) g hg,
       4463     keyed_reading_not_returned DepthZero
       4464       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => oddPart w = 0) (Eq.symm hz) rfl)
       4465       (fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl)) (by decide : ¬ (oddPart ⟨0, 14⟩ = 0))) g hg,
       4466     keyed_reading_not_returned (fun Z => ¬ Left Z)
       4467       (fun ⟨z, hz, hx⟩ => Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => ¬ w.x < 1) (Eq.symm hz)
       4468         (by decide : ¬ ((⟨1, 14⟩ : Pt).x < 1)) hx)
       4469       (fun h => h ⟨⟨0, 14⟩, Or.inl rfl, by decide⟩) g hg,
       4470     keyed_reading_not_returned Stable
       4471       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => N1 w ≤ N0 w) (Eq.symm hz) (by decide))
       4472       (fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl)) (by decide : ¬ (N1 ⟨0, 14⟩ ≤ N0 ⟨0, 14⟩))) g hg,
       4473     keyed_reading_not_returned LeastErasure ((least_erasure_is_the_value W1).mpr W1_rh)
       4474       (fun h => W2f_not_rh ((least_erasure_is_the_value W2f).mp h)) g hg⟩
       4475  
       4476  /-- THE PRIMES ARE A FREE BASIS: every assignment of integers to the primes extends to exactly one completely
       4477  additive function. -/
       4478  theorem primes_are_a_free_basis (a : Nat → Int) :
       4479      ∃ f, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ (∀ p, isPrime p → f p = a p) ∧
       4480        ∀ g, CompletelyAdditive g → (∀ p, isPrime p → g p = a p) → ∀ n, 0 < n → g n = f n :=
       4481    ⟨extendAssignment a, primes_admit_every_assignment a⟩
       4482  
       4483  /-- LEAST ERASURE IS THE RECURSION: on every world least erasure holds exactly when the hypothesis is implied by its
       4484  own denial; the line is decided point by point, so no classical step enters. -/
       4485  theorem least_erasure_iff_recursion (Z : World) : LeastErasure Z ↔ SelfVerifyingP (RH Z) :=
       4486    ⟨fun h _ => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp h,
       4487     fun h => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr (fun z hz =>
       4488       match Int.decEq z.x 1 with
       4489       | isTrue e => e
       4490       | isFalse ne => h (fun r => ne (r z hz)) z hz)⟩
       4491  
       4492  /-- THE CERTIFIED WORLD IS FOLD-CLOSED: the world certified to height `T` is closed under the fold, and a fold-closed
       4493  world agrees with it to `T` and carries an off-line pair above. -/
       4494  theorem certified_height_never_forces_closed (T : Nat) :
       4495      FoldClosed (LineBelow T) ∧
       4496      (RH (LineBelow T) ∧ FoldClosed (TwinAbove T) ∧ ¬ RH (TwinAbove T) ∧
       4497        ∀ z, z.t ≤ T → (TwinAbove T z ↔ LineBelow T z)) :=
       4498    ⟨fun z hz => ⟨(congrArg (fun y => 2 - y) hz.1).trans (by decide), hz.2⟩,
       4499     fun _ hz => hz.1,
       4500     fun z hz => match hz with
       4501       | Or.inl hl => Or.inl ⟨(congrArg (fun y => 2 - y) hl.1).trans (by decide), hl.2⟩
       4502       | Or.inr (Or.inl e) => Or.inr (Or.inr ((congrArg fold e).trans rfl))
       4503       | Or.inr (Or.inr e) => Or.inr (Or.inl ((congrArg fold e).trans rfl)),
       4504     fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, T + 1⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)),
       4505     fun z hz => ⟨fun h => match h with
       4506         | Or.inl hl => hl
       4507         | Or.inr (Or.inl e) =>
       4508           absurd (Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => w.t ≤ T) e hz) (Nat.not_succ_le_self T)
       4509         | Or.inr (Or.inr e) =>
       4510           absurd (Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => w.t ≤ T) e hz) (Nat.not_succ_le_self T),
       4511       fun h => Or.inl h⟩⟩
       4512  
       4513  /-- The statement each route of the ledger carries: the theorem its status names. -/
       4514  def routeClaim : Route → Prop
       4515    | .ladderFromRecord => ∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)
       4516    | .foundationAsSystem => Sound lineTheory ∧ lineTheory.Prov () ∧ LeastErasure (lineTheoryReads.world ())
       4517    | .placement => ∀ T : Theory, RungOnLadder T → Sound T →
       4518        (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.Prov s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Prov s → T.True_ s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.True_ s)
       4519    | .groundByAct => ∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros
       4520    | .independence => ∀ S : Setting, ¬ S.Prov S.hyp → ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp) → S.hyp
       4521    | .realPartCertified => ∀ T : Nat, RH (LineBelow T) ∧ FoldClosed (TwinAbove T) ∧ ¬ RH (TwinAbove T) ∧
       4522        ∀ z, z.t ≤ T → (TwinAbove T z ↔ LineBelow T z)
       4523  
       4524  /-- EVERY ROUTE CARRIES ITS THEOREM: each of the six routes is backed by the theorem its ledger entry names. -/
       4525  theorem every_route_carries_its_theorem : ∀ r : Route, routeClaim r := fun r =>
       4526    match r with
       4527    | .ladderFromRecord => unicorn_block
       4528    | .foundationAsSystem => a_sound_theory_may_prove_the_line
       4529    | .placement => placement
       4530    | .groundByAct => rh_from_the_act
       4531    | .independence => independence_forces_truth
       4532    | .realPartCertified => certified_height_never_forces
       4533  
       4534  /-! ### XXV.f · The tenth falsifier, barred by the act -/
       4535  
       4536  /-- THE TENTH IS THE REFUTER: on every configuration a computed point off the line is exactly the failure of the line. -/
       4537  theorem the_tenth_is_the_refuter (Z : World) : OffLine Z ↔ ¬ RH Z :=
       4538    ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, hn⟩ h => hn (h z hz), not_rh_has_offline_witness Z⟩
       4539  
       4540  /-- THE TENTH IS BARRED BY THE ACT: on the zero set the act supplies, no point lies off the line; the one refuter of the
       4541  value does not exist there. -/
       4542  theorem the_tenth_is_barred_by_the_act (A : ActualZeros) : ¬ OffLine A.zeros :=
       4543    fun ⟨z, hz, hn⟩ => hn (rh_from_the_act A z hz)
       4544  
       4545  /-- THE KINETIC BAR: a reading supplied on the actual zero set gives the line there, and with it the refuter's absence;
       4546  the formal side does not decide the search, and the field the act supplies closes it. -/
       4547  theorem the_kinetic_bar (A : ActualZeros) : RH A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros :=
       4548    ⟨rh_from_the_act A, the_tenth_is_barred_by_the_act A⟩
       4549  
       4550  
       4551  /-! ## XXVI · The closure, bound whole
       4552  
       4553  One theorem binds the closure, for every self-grounding root: the two-part reading of section XIX.f, the lock of
       4554  section XXIV, the socket of section XXII, the irreducible cut of section XIX.c, the two denials and the witness of
       4555  section XXII.c, and the bar of section XXV.f. Every conjunct is a theorem above; this section adds their conjunction
       4556  and no content. -/
       4557  
       4558  /-- THE CLOSURE, BOUND IN ONE THEOREM. For every self-grounding root: from the posit the hypothesis follows, no reading
       4559  of the record supplies it, the posit is the hypothesis, and nothing weaker forces the line; the lock; the field of the
       4560  act can be filled at a fold-closed configuration exactly where the hypothesis holds; no admissible premise decides and
       4561  least erasure is not admissible; the two denials; the witness forced by the act; and on the zero set the act supplies
       4562  the hypothesis holds and no point lies off the line. -/
       4563  theorem the_capstone {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4564      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4565       (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       4566       (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4567       (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z)) ∧
       4568      (Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4569       root ∧
       4570       (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4571       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4572       (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4573       ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4574       (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4575       (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4576       (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z))) ∧
       4577      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       4578      ((∀ A : World → Prop, Admissible A → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧ ¬ Admissible LeastErasure) ∧
       4579      ((∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4580       (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4581       (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4582       (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4583       (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4584         (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4585       SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4586       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4587       (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4588         SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False))) ∧
       4589      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4590        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4591       (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4592       (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4593       ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z)) ∧
       4594      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros) :=
       4595    ⟨reader_frame, the_lock G, fun Z hZ => (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1,
       4596     ⟨triaxial_cut_irreducible.2.2.2.1, triaxial_cut_irreducible.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
       4597     two_denials G, the_witness_forced_by_the_act, the_kinetic_bar⟩
       4598  
       4599  end PrimeFreedom
