       5414  
       5415  /-! # PART III · Annihilation_Closure.lean, verbatim, with the second edition laws appended -/
       5416  section PartIII
       5417  /-
       5418    Annihilation_Closure.lean · The Master Annihilation Closure.
       5419    Core Lean 4.19.0, standalone: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
       5420  
       5421    BOOKS ONE AND TWO are `lean/Remembered_Offered.lean` carried byte-identical below, its own header included:
       5422    the two denials, the price, the monism-fixed toy of the bound, and the harvest of 7 October 2026 with its
       5423    capstones `the_chain` and `the_harvest`.
       5424  
       5425    BOOK THREE is the annihilation closure, harvested on 7 October 2026:
       5426    I    four names, one proposition: least erasure, the value, Monism and the co-location of Being with Monism;
       5427    II   Monism, the sole witness: every faithful witness is Monism, no reading of the record witnesses, and
       5428         a witness is never universal;
       5429    III  co-location is not universal: Being stands on the off-line pair configuration and Monism does not;
       5430    IV   the timeless zone: one proposition, the locus resting both instruments, zero time remembering, every
       5431         later time forgetting, closure at zero time exactly at Λ = 0, the upstream unforced;
       5432    V    timeless is determinacy, not selection;
       5433    VI   the check: the off-line pair configuration satisfies every principle of the closure and lacks the value,
       5434         its twin has it;
       5435         no principle true on every closed configuration decides the value;
       5436    VII  the capstones: `the_timeless_zone_closed`, the timeless zone with no act anywhere in it, and
       5437         `the_annihilation_closure`, the zone together with the act's conjunct of the time world.
       5438  
       5439    BOOK FOUR is the Unicorn, contained. `lean/RH_Unicorn_Block.lean` is carried byte-identical below, its own header
       5440    included: the cut at a height, the formal block, the aperture one bit wide, existence supplying nothing, no bypass,
       5441    the supply side silent, the certificate, and the three bits as one term. Book Four binds it to the chart:
       5442    I    the cut on the chart, at every height;
       5443    II   no bypass on the chart;
       5444    III  the Unicorn blocked on the chart, above every height;
       5445    IV   RA supplies nothing to the Unicorn part;
       5446    V    on the act's zero set, every arrival above every height stands on the line;
       5447    VI   the capstone, `the_unicorn_contained`.
       5448  
       5449    Stated whole, locked 7 October 2026: the timeless zone is closed, LE = RH = Monism, one proposition, with zero
       5450    gap, proved; RH is the statement that ζ's zero set lies in the timeless zone. Book Three proves the first and
       5451    assumes nothing; its sixth section proves that nothing every closed configuration shares can single out ζ. In
       5452    the time world the statement enters only where Book One's `ActualZeros` is taken as input. The cones are printed
       5453    at the foot and pinned.
       5454  -/
       5455  /-
       5456    Remembered_Offered.lean · The Remembered and the Offered: One Self, One Place at a Time.
       5457    Core Lean 4.19.0, standalone: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
       5458  
       5459    BOOK ONE is carried unchanged: Two_Denials.lean whole (the deed and the self-grounding root from Armed_Seat.lean,
       5460    the chart, the record, the act and the deed's law from Force_Witness.lean, the monism witness from Codex.lean,
       5461    the two denials at the two layers of one root); the finite configuration and its price from Inescapable_Capstone.lean;
       5462    the toy of the bound from Codex.lean, monism fixed, namespace RALi.
       5463  
       5464    BOOK TWO is the harvest of 7 October 2026, in binding order:
       5465    I    the Tongue always has a world; monism, not the Tongue, tells the worlds apart;
       5466    II   one self, one place at a time: the floor and least erasure are two objects;
       5467    III  the twins: one extension, two instruments, neither the voucher of the other;
       5468    IV   the remembered and the offered: memory is lossless, a world is its own memory exactly when the value holds;
       5469    V    forgetting and remembering: one sequence, a one-bit gap, always connected;
       5470    Vb   the forcing by heat: return is free, resistance pays, the free path is one;
       5471    VI   THE CHAIN: the root, forgetting, the locus in the middle, remembering, least erasure;
       5472    VIb  zero time remembers, every later time forgets;
       5473    VII  two doors and no third, the act shuts the second;
       5474    VIII a band forces nothing;
       5475    IX   the harvest, bound.
       5476  
       5477    Stated whole: everything is proved except the offer at the actual zeros, which enters only as the field `supply`
       5478    of `ActualZeros`, the act, at premise grade. The cones are printed at the foot and pinned.
       5479  -/
       5480  set_option autoImplicit false
       5481  namespace RememberedOffered
       5482  
       5483  /-! # BOOK ONE · carried unchanged
       5484  
       5485  ## Two_Denials.lean, whole -/
       5486  
       5487  /-! ## PART ONE · copied unchanged
       5488  
       5489  ### from Armed_Seat.lean · the deed and the root -/
       5490  
       5491  def SelfVerifying (P : Prop) : Prop := ¬P → P
       5492  
       5493  /-- A self-grounding root: acts occur, and every act instances the root. -/
       5494  structure SelfGrounding (R : Prop) where
       5495    Act       : Type
       5496    anAct     : Act
       5497    instances : Act → R
       5498  
       5499  /-- A denial of the root is an act, and re-enacts it. -/
       5500  theorem denial_reenacts_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (denial : G.Act) : R :=
       5501    G.instances denial
       5502  
       5503  /-- A self-grounding root is self-verifying: the deed of denying it hands it over. -/
       5504  theorem denial_instantiates {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : SelfVerifying R :=
       5505    fun _ => G.instances G.anAct
       5506  
       5507  /-- SEATED, UNDENIABLE: a self-grounding root holds, with no classical detour, by the act itself. -/
       5508  theorem seated_undeniable {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : R :=
       5509    G.instances G.anAct
       5510  
       5511  /-- The Root Axiom at the constructed one-point domain: every act is a deed, and a deed actuates. -/
       5512  def RA : Prop := (0 : Int) < 1
       5513  def raSelfGrounding : SelfGrounding RA := ⟨Unit, (), fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide⟩
       5514  
       5515  theorem root_undeniable : RA := raSelfGrounding.instances ()
       5516  
       5517  /-! ### from Force_Witness.lean · the chart, the record, the act, the deed's law -/
       5518  
       5519  /-- A point is (d, t): d its offset from the line, t its height. The line is d = 0. -/
       5520  abbrev Point := Int × Int
       5521  
       5522  /-- The fold: s ↦ 1 − s̄ on the offset chart, (d, t) ↦ (−d, t). -/
       5523  def fold (p : Point) : Point := (-p.1, p.2)
       5524  
       5525  /-- The line: offset zero. -/
       5526  def onLine (p : Point) : Prop := p.1 = 0
       5527  
       5528  /-- The registration: it keeps the height and forgets the side. -/
       5529  def reg (p : Point) : Point := (0, p.2)
       5530  
       5531  /-- Integer negation is an involution, by the integer's constructors. -/
       5532  theorem neg_neg_free : ∀ d : Int, - -d = d := fun
       5533    | Int.ofNat 0 => rfl
       5534    | Int.ofNat (_ + 1) => rfl
       5535    | Int.negSucc _ => rfl
       5536  
       5537  /-- The fold is an involution. -/
       5538  theorem fold_involutive (p : Point) : fold (fold p) = p := by
       5539    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       5540    show (- -d, t) = (d, t)
       5541    rw [neg_neg_free d]
       5542  
       5543  /-- The registration lands on the line. -/
       5544  theorem reg_lands (p : Point) : onLine (reg p) := rfl
       5545  
       5546  /-- The registration erases nothing at a point exactly when the point is on the line. -/
       5547  theorem reg_erases_nothing_iff (p : Point) : reg p = p ↔ onLine p := by
       5548    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       5549    exact ⟨fun h => (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm, fun h => by cases h; rfl⟩
       5550  
       5551  /-- A configuration: a set of points. Closed: the fold carries it to itself. -/
       5552  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
       5553  
       5554  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold p)
       5555  
       5556  /-- The value: every point of the configuration is on the line. -/
       5557  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine p
       5558  
       5559  /-- Least erasure: the registration leaves every point of the configuration unchanged. -/
       5560  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → reg p = p
       5561  
       5562  /-- The record of a configuration: what the registration leaves. -/
       5563  def Rec (S : Config) (q : Point) : Prop := ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
       5564  
       5565  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
       5566  
       5567  /-- The registered world of a point and its pair world. -/
       5568  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
       5569  
       5570  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
       5571  
       5572  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
       5573    match hs with
       5574    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
       5575    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
       5576  
       5577  /-- The registered world and the pair world leave one record. -/
       5578  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
       5579    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs]; rfl⟩,
       5580     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
       5581        rw [← hq]
       5582        exact match hs with
       5583          | Or.inl e => by rw [e]; rfl
       5584          | Or.inr e => by rw [e]; rfl⟩⟩
       5585  
       5586  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
       5587    rw [hs]; exact reg_lands p
       5588  
       5589  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
       5590    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
       5591  
       5592  /-- THE ACT. The bit is supplied once, explicitly, as a field of a type: a closed configuration with least
       5593      erasure at it. The field is the value supplied; the type makes the supply visible to every reader. -/
       5594  structure ActualZeros where
       5595    zeros : Config
       5596    closed : Closed zeros
       5597    supply : LeastErasure zeros
       5598  
       5599  /-- FROM THE ACT, THE VALUE. -/
       5600  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
       5601    fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (Z.supply p hp)
       5602  
       5603  /-- AND OF NOTHING ELSE: a fact that holds whatever the configuration, the deed included, forces no value. -/
       5604  theorem the_deed_forces_nothing (D : Prop) (hD : D) : ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S := by
       5605    intro hall
       5606    exact pair_world_lacks_value (1, 0) (fun e => by cases e) (hall _ (pair_world_closed (1, 0)) hD)
       5607  
       5608  
       5609  /-! ### from Codex.lean, namespace RALi, Part VII · the monism witness, the root read twice -/
       5610  
       5611  structure Q4 where
       5612    r : Int
       5613    i : Int
       5614    j : Int
       5615    k : Int
       5616    deriving DecidableEq, Repr
       5617  
       5618  /-- The geometric route's involution and the formal route's involution, written apart. -/
       5619  def sigmaGeo (q : Q4) : Q4 := ⟨q.r, -q.i, -q.j, -q.k⟩
       5620  def sigmaForm (q : Q4) : Q4 := ⟨q.r, -q.i, -q.j, -q.k⟩
       5621  
       5622  /-- THE MONISM WITNESS. One involution, one principle, one seed. -/
       5623  structure MonismWitness (P : Nat → Prop) : Prop where
       5624    one_involution : ∀ q, sigmaGeo q = sigmaForm q
       5625    uniform        : ∀ n m, P n ↔ P m
       5626    seed           : P 0
       5627  
       5628  /-- 24. The seat field is constructed, not posited: σ = σ′ holds by rfl. -/
       5629  theorem one_involution_constructed : ∀ q, sigmaGeo q = sigmaForm q := fun _ => rfl
       5630  
       5631  /-- 25. The timeless reading and the timed reading coincide under one principle:
       5632  the claim over all time is the claim at one instant. Deleting time loses nothing. -/
       5633  theorem timeless_equals_timed (P : Nat → Prop) (u : ∀ n m, P n ↔ P m) :
       5634      (∀ n, P n) ↔ P 0 :=
       5635    ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h n => (u 0 n).mp h⟩
       5636  
       5637  /-- 26. The witness closes the record, past and future. -/
       5638  theorem monism_closes (P : Nat → Prop) (w : MonismWitness P) : ∀ n, P n :=
       5639    (timeless_equals_timed P w.uniform).mpr w.seed
       5640  
       5641  /-- 27. The witness is exactly the claim: a monism witness for P exists iff P holds at
       5642  every index. Its value field carries the whole of the claim, as theorem 17 required. -/
       5643  theorem monism_witness_is_the_claim (P : Nat → Prop) :
       5644      MonismWitness P ↔ ∀ n, P n :=
       5645    ⟨monism_closes P, fun h => ⟨one_involution_constructed,
       5646      fun n m => ⟨fun _ => h m, fun _ => h n⟩, h 0⟩⟩
       5647  
       5648  /-! ## PART TWO · two denials, one shape, at the two layers of one root
       5649  
       5650  A no has two parts: the act of uttering it and the content it asserts. The Tongue's no asserts ¬ R of the floor R.
       5651  The no to RH asserts that the zeros lack the value: that they form the false world. -/
       5652  
       5653  /-- The point off the line from which the pair world, the false world, is built. -/
       5654  def offPoint : Point := (1, 0)
       5655  
       5656  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := fun h =>
       5657    Nat.noConfusion (Int.ofNat.inj (show Int.ofNat 1 = Int.ofNat 0 from h))
       5658  
       5659  /-- THE ROOT READ TWICE on a configuration: the monism witness of its line property, timeless. -/
       5660  abbrev RootReadTwice (S : Config) : Prop := MonismWitness (fun _ => Value S)
       5661  
       5662  /-- THE SAME FIRST STEP: whatever a no asserts, uttering it is an act, and the act re-enacts the floor. -/
       5663  theorem every_no_reenacts_the_root {R C : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (deed : G.Act) (_content : C) : R :=
       5664    denial_reenacts_root G deed
       5665  
       5666  /-- THE TONGUE'S NO CONTRADICTS THE FLOOR, BY ITS OWN ACT: its content denies the floor, and its own act
       5667      re-enacts it. -/
       5668  theorem the_tongue_no_refutes_itself {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (deed : G.Act) (content : ¬ R) : False :=
       5669    content (denial_reenacts_root G deed)
       5670  
       5671  /-- ONLY THE YES REMAINS AT THE FLOOR: the return is forced by the deed, with no key and no classical detour. -/
       5672  theorem only_the_yes_remains_at_the_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : SelfVerifying R ∧ R :=
       5673    ⟨denial_instantiates G, seated_undeniable G⟩
       5674  
       5675  /-- THE ROOT READ TWICE IS THE VALUE: on every configuration the monism witness stands exactly where every zero
       5676      is on the line. -/
       5677  theorem the_root_read_twice_is_the_value (S : Config) : RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S :=
       5678    ⟨fun w => w.seed, fun h => ⟨one_involution_constructed, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, h⟩⟩
       5679  
       5680  /-- THE NO TO RH CONTRADICTS THE ROOT READ TWICE: a configuration lacking the value carries no monism. -/
       5681  theorem the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice (S : Config) (content : ¬ Value S) : ¬ RootReadTwice S :=
       5682    fun w => content w.seed
       5683  
       5684  /-- THE TRUE WORLD CARRIES MONISM: the registered world of the off-line point. -/
       5685  theorem the_true_world_carries_monism : RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) :=
       5686    ⟨one_involution_constructed, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, registered_has_value offPoint⟩
       5687  
       5688  /-- THE FALSE WORLD CARRIES NO MONISM: the pair world of the off-line point. -/
       5689  theorem the_false_world_carries_no_monism : ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5690    fun w => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off w.seed
       5691  
       5692  /-- THE FALSE WORLD, AT THE TWO LAYERS: the floor stands there, as in every world; it is closed and leaves the
       5693      record of the true world; it lacks the value; and it carries no monism. The floor is there and Being is not. -/
       5694  theorem the_false_world_carries_the_floor_and_no_monism {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5695      R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5696      ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5697    ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, one_record offPoint,
       5698     pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩
       5699  
       5700  /-- THE FLOOR ALONE DECIDES NO VALUE: it stands in both worlds of one record. The value is decided at the second
       5701      layer, by the root read twice. -/
       5702  theorem the_floor_alone_decides_no_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5703      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S :=
       5704    the_deed_forces_nothing R (seated_undeniable G)
       5705  
       5706  /-- THE RETURN IS THE ACT: the act carries the root read twice at the actual zeros. -/
       5707  theorem the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice (Z : ActualZeros) : RootReadTwice Z.zeros :=
       5708    (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value Z.zeros).mpr (value_from_the_act Z)
       5709  
       5710  /-- AN ACT EXISTS EXACTLY WHERE THE ROOT READ TWICE STANDS on a closed configuration. -/
       5711  theorem an_act_exactly_where_the_root_read_twice_stands (S : Config) :
       5712      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ (Closed S ∧ RootReadTwice S) := by
       5713    constructor
       5714    · intro ⟨Z, h⟩
       5715      subst h
       5716      exact ⟨Z.closed, the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice Z⟩
       5717    · intro ⟨hc, hm⟩
       5718      exact ⟨⟨S, hc, fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr
       5719        (((the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mp hm) p hp)⟩, rfl⟩
       5720  
       5721  /-- ON THE ACT THE NO TO RH IS REFUTED, with zero contradiction: the act's own field. -/
       5722  theorem on_the_act_the_line_no_is_refuted (Z : ActualZeros) (content : ¬ Value Z.zeros) : False :=
       5723    content (value_from_the_act Z)
       5724  
       5725  /-- TWO DENIALS, ONE SHAPE, TWO LAYERS. Every no re-enacts the floor. The Tongue's no contradicts the floor and
       5726      its own act returns it: only the yes remains. The no to RH contradicts the root read twice: on every
       5727      configuration a lack of the value is a lack of monism, and the false world carries the floor and no monism,
       5728      beside the true world of one record that carries both. So the floor alone decides no value, and the root read
       5729      twice is the value. The return to the root read twice at the actual zeros is the act: there the monism witness
       5730      stands, the value holds, and the no is refuted. -/
       5731  theorem two_denials {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5732      (∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → R) ∧
       5733      (G.Act → ¬ R → False) ∧
       5734      (SelfVerifying R ∧ R) ∧
       5735      (∀ S : Config, ¬ Value S → ¬ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       5736      (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5737        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5738      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) ∧
       5739      (∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧
       5740      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, RootReadTwice Z.zeros ∧ Value Z.zeros ∧ (¬ Value Z.zeros → False)) :=
       5741    ⟨fun _ deed c => every_no_reenacts_the_root G deed c,
       5742     fun deed c => the_tongue_no_refutes_itself G deed c,
       5743     only_the_yes_remains_at_the_root G,
       5744     the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice,
       5745     ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, one_record offPoint,
       5746      the_true_world_carries_monism, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩,
       5747     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       5748     the_root_read_twice_is_the_value,
       5749     fun Z => ⟨the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice Z, value_from_the_act Z,
       5750       on_the_act_the_line_no_is_refuted Z⟩⟩
       5751  
       5752  /-- AT THE ROOT AXIOM ITSELF. -/
       5753  theorem two_denials_at_RA :
       5754      (∀ C : Prop, raSelfGrounding.Act → C → RA) ∧
       5755      (raSelfGrounding.Act → ¬ RA → False) ∧
       5756      (SelfVerifying RA ∧ RA) ∧
       5757      (∀ S : Config, ¬ Value S → ¬ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       5758      (RA ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5759        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5760      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → RA → Value S) ∧
       5761      (∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧
       5762      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, RootReadTwice Z.zeros ∧ Value Z.zeros ∧ (¬ Value Z.zeros → False)) :=
       5763    two_denials raSelfGrounding
       5764  
       5765  /-! ## From Inescapable_Capstone.lean · the finite configuration and its price -/
       5766  
       5767  /-- The price of exported freedom in native units: temperature is energy per bit, so b bits cost b·T. -/
       5768  def price (T bits : Nat) : Nat := bits * T
       5769  
       5770  /-- A finite configuration: the heights of its zeros on the line, and its off-line pairs, each an offset that is not
       5771      zero and a height. -/
       5772  structure FinCfg where
       5773    line : List Int
       5774    pairs : List (Int × Int)
       5775    offset_ne : ∀ q ∈ pairs, q.1 ≠ 0
       5776  def FinCfg.pts (F : FinCfg) : Config := fun p => (p.1 = 0 ∧ p.2 ∈ F.line) ∨ ∃ q ∈ F.pairs, p = q ∨ p = fold q
       5777  /-- The erased bits of a finite configuration: one per off-line pair, two points registered to one. -/
       5778  def erased (F : FinCfg) : Nat := F.pairs.length
       5779  
       5780  theorem fincfg_closed (F : FinCfg) : Closed F.pts := fun p hp =>
       5781    match hp with
       5782    | Or.inl ⟨hl, ht⟩ => Or.inl ⟨by show -p.1 = 0; rw [hl]; rfl, ht⟩
       5783    | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl e⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inr (congrArg fold e)⟩
       5784    | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inr e⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl (by rw [e]; exact fold_involutive q)⟩
       5785  
       5786  /-- LEAST ERASURE IS ZERO ERASED BITS: "least" is a count. -/
       5787  theorem least_erasure_iff_zero_erased (F : FinCfg) : LeastErasure F.pts ↔ erased F = 0 := by
       5788    constructor
       5789    · intro h
       5790      unfold erased
       5791      cases hp : F.pairs with
       5792      | nil => rfl
       5793      | cons q r =>
       5794        have hq : q ∈ F.pairs := by rw [hp]; exact List.Mem.head r
       5795        exact absurd ((reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mp (h q (Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl rfl⟩))) (F.offset_ne q hq)
       5796    · intro h p hp
       5797      have hnil : F.pairs = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero h
       5798      rcases hp with ⟨hl, _⟩ | ⟨q, hq, _⟩
       5799      · exact (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr hl
       5800      · rw [hnil] at hq; cases hq
       5801  
       5802  /-- THE HEAT OF REGISTRATION IS ZERO EXACTLY AT THE VALUE: registering a finite configuration costs one T per
       5803      off-line pair, and at any positive T it costs nothing exactly when every point stands on the line. -/
       5804  theorem price_zero_iff_value (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) : price T (erased F) = 0 ↔ Value F.pts := by
       5805    constructor
       5806    · intro h p hp
       5807      have h0 : erased F = 0 := by
       5808        cases he : erased F with
       5809        | zero => rfl
       5810        | succ k => rw [he] at h; exact absurd h (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos k) hT))
       5811      exact (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp ((least_erasure_iff_zero_erased F).mpr h0 p hp)
       5812    · intro hv
       5813      have h0 := (least_erasure_iff_zero_erased F).mp (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (hv p hp))
       5814      show erased F * T = 0
       5815      rw [h0, Nat.zero_mul]
       5816  
       5817  /-- Each further off-line pair adds one T: the total is the erased bits times the floor. -/
       5818  theorem price_counts_pairs (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) : price T (erased F) = F.pairs.length * T := rfl
       5819  
       5820  /-! ## From Codex.lean, monism fixed, namespace RALi · the toy of the bound, a toy of the bound, not of the flow -/
       5821  
       5822  /-- Squared strip width after t time steps: max(d2 − 2t, 0). -/
       5823  def flow (d2 t : Nat) : Nat := d2 - 2 * t
       5824  def realAt (d2 t : Nat) : Prop := flow d2 t = 0
       5825  
       5826  /-- 38. THE MONOTONICITY FORMULA. The width never grows along ζ's time. -/
       5827  theorem flow_monotone (d2 t : Nat) : flow d2 (t + 1) ≤ flow d2 t := by
       5828    unfold flow; omega
       5829  
       5830  /-- 39. Its transport, proved: once every zero is real, every zero stays real. This is
       5831  de Bruijn's theorem in the toy, the ζ-analogue of Perelman's monotonicity, at theorem grade. -/
       5832  theorem reality_transported (d2 t : Nat) (h : realAt d2 t) : realAt d2 (t + 1) := by
       5833    unfold realAt flow at *; omega
       5834  
       5835  
       5836  def Lam (d2 : Nat) : Nat := (d2 + 1) / 2
       5837  
       5838  theorem real_at_Lam (d2 : Nat) : realAt d2 (Lam d2) := by unfold realAt flow Lam; omega
       5839  
       5840  /-- 40. In the toy, the strip is closed at time zero iff Λ = 0. For ζ, RH ↔ Λ = 0 is the cited
       5841  result of Newman with Rodgers and Tao and enters the cone as `hLam`. -/
       5842  theorem rh_iff_lambda_zero (d2 : Nat) : realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0 := by
       5843    unfold realAt flow Lam
       5844    exact ⟨fun h => by omega, fun h => by omega⟩
       5845  
       5846  
       5847  /-- 42. THE RECORD FORGETS. After one step the record of the width-zero state and the
       5848  width-one state coincide: the forward flow is even in the RH bit, so no readout of the
       5849  flowed record decides RH. This is the fTOE wall, T1, executed on ζ's own time. -/
       5850  theorem flowed_record_forgets (T : Nat) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
       5851      ¬ ∃ g : Nat → Bool, ∀ d2, g (flow d2 T) = decide (d2 = 0) := by
       5852    rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
       5853    have a := hg 0; have b := hg 1
       5854    have e : flow 1 T = flow 0 T := by unfold flow; omega
       5855    rw [e, a] at b
       5856    exact absurd b (by decide)
       5857  
       5858  /-- 43. The upstream direction is not a transport. Going backward from a real record,
       5859  both answers are admissible: the preimage of "real at T" holds the RH state and a non-RH
       5860  state. The forward arrow proves; the backward arrow must be supplied. -/
       5861  theorem upstream_is_not_forced (T : Nat) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
       5862      realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0 := by
       5863    unfold realAt flow
       5864    exact ⟨by omega, by omega, rfl, fun h => by omega⟩
       5865  
       5866  /-! # BOOK TWO · the harvest, in binding order -/
       5867  
       5868  /-! ## I · The Tongue always has a world -/
       5869  
       5870  /-- THE TONGUE ALWAYS HAS A WORLD: the floor stands on every configuration, the false world included, so the Tongue
       5871      can speak in every world; only the content of its no, ¬R beside an act, has none. -/
       5872  theorem the_tongue_always_has_a_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5873      (∀ _ : Config, R) ∧
       5874      (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5875      ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R :=
       5876    ⟨fun _ => seated_undeniable G,
       5877     ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       5878     fun ⟨deed, c⟩ => c (G.instances deed)⟩
       5879  
       5880  /-- MONISM BEFORE THE TONGUE: the floor, and with it the Tongue, stands in both worlds of one record; what tells
       5881      them apart is the root read twice, present in the true world and absent in the false. -/
       5882  theorem monism_before_the_tongue {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5883      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5884      (R ∧ RootReadTwice (registered offPoint)) ∧
       5885      (R ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       5886    ⟨one_record offPoint,
       5887     ⟨seated_undeniable G, the_true_world_carries_monism⟩,
       5888     ⟨seated_undeniable G, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩⟩
       5889  
       5890  /-- The Tongue's no has no world: no act stands beside ¬R. -/
       5891  theorem tongue_no_has_no_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R :=
       5892    fun ⟨deed, c⟩ => c (G.instances deed)
       5893  
       5894  /-- The no to RH has a world: an act, a closed configuration, the floor holding, and the value failing, together. -/
       5895  theorem line_no_has_a_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5896      ∃ S : Config, ∃ _ : G.Act, Closed S ∧ R ∧ ¬ Value S :=
       5897    ⟨pairWorld offPoint, G.anAct, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       5898     pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩
       5899  
       5900  /-- A deed does not make a closed configuration an act: the floor's acts supply no ActualZeros over every closed
       5901      configuration. -/
       5902  theorem the_deed_is_not_the_supply {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5903      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → G.Act → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S := by
       5904    intro h
       5905    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := h (pairWorld offPoint) (pair_world_closed offPoint) G.anAct
       5906    have v := value_from_the_act Z
       5907    rw [hZ] at v
       5908    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off v
       5909  
       5910  theorem at_RA :
       5911      (¬ ∃ _ : raSelfGrounding.Act, ¬ RA) ∧
       5912      (∃ S : Config, ∃ _ : raSelfGrounding.Act, Closed S ∧ RA ∧ ¬ Value S) ∧
       5913      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → raSelfGrounding.Act → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) :=
       5914    ⟨tongue_no_has_no_world raSelfGrounding, line_no_has_a_world raSelfGrounding,
       5915     the_deed_is_not_the_supply raSelfGrounding⟩
       5916  
       5917  /-! ## II · One self, one place at a time -/
       5918  
       5919  /-- The floor and least erasure are two objects: identified on every closed configuration, they would agree on the
       5920      pair world, where the floor holds and least erasure fails. -/
       5921  theorem floor_is_not_least_erasure {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5922      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (R ↔ LeastErasure S) := by
       5923    intro h
       5924    have le : LeastErasure (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5925      (h (pairWorld offPoint) (pair_world_closed offPoint)).mp (seated_undeniable G)
       5926    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       5927      (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp))
       5928  
       5929  /-- The voucher stays with the floor: it holds on both worlds of one record, the false one included. -/
       5930  theorem the_voucher_stays_with_the_floor {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5931      R ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5932      LeastErasure (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ LeastErasure (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5933    ⟨seated_undeniable G, one_record offPoint,
       5934     fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint p hp),
       5935     fun le => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       5936       (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp))⟩
       5937  
       5938  /-- Merging them at one world is the supply again: on any configuration, identifying the floor with least erasure
       5939      there is least erasure there. -/
       5940  theorem merging_at_a_world_is_the_supply {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       5941      (R ↔ LeastErasure S) ↔ LeastErasure S :=
       5942    ⟨fun h => h.mp (seated_undeniable G), fun le => ⟨fun _ => le, fun _ => seated_undeniable G⟩⟩
       5943  
       5944  /-! ## III · The twins -/
       5945  
       5946  /-- Two instruments: registration and the fold are different maps. -/
       5947  theorem two_instruments : reg offPoint ≠ fold offPoint := by
       5948    show ((0 : Int), (0 : Int)) ≠ (-(1 : Int), (0 : Int))
       5949    decide
       5950  
       5951  /-- One truth value on every world: each twin holds exactly where the other does. -/
       5952  theorem twins_on_every_world (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
       5953    ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
       5954     fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
       5955  
       5956  /-- Extensionally one proposition, read through two different maps. -/
       5957  theorem twins_are_one_extension : LeastErasure = Value :=
       5958    funext fun S => propext (twins_on_every_world S)
       5959  
       5960  /-- Neither twin vouches for the other: whatever supplies one supplies the other, so a premise that reaches one
       5961      reaches both, and the floor reaches neither. -/
       5962  theorem no_twin_is_the_others_voucher {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5963      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S → Value S) ∧ (Value S → LeastErasure S)) ∧
       5964      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S :=
       5965    ⟨fun S => ⟨(twins_on_every_world S).mp, (twins_on_every_world S).mpr⟩, the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G⟩
       5966  
       5967  /-! ## IV · The remembered and the offered -/
       5968  
       5969  /-- No instrument both remembers and keeps the side: a map that lands every point on the line and keeps the
       5970      height sends the off-line point and its fold partner to one point. -/
       5971  theorem no_instrument_remembers_and_keeps_the_side (g : Point → Point)
       5972      (lands : ∀ p, onLine (g p)) (keeps : ∀ p, (g p).2 = p.2) :
       5973      g offPoint = g (fold offPoint) ∧ offPoint ≠ fold offPoint := by
       5974    have e1 : g offPoint = (0, 0) := Prod.ext (lands offPoint) (keeps offPoint)
       5975    have e2 : g (fold offPoint) = (0, 0) := Prod.ext (lands (fold offPoint)) (keeps (fold offPoint))
       5976    exact ⟨e1.trans e2.symm, by decide⟩
       5977  
       5978  /-- Memory is always lossless: the record of every configuration has the value. -/
       5979  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) :=
       5980    fun _ ⟨p, _, hq⟩ => hq ▸ reg_lands p
       5981  
       5982  /-- The offered is the remembered exactly when the value holds: a configuration equals its own record, point for
       5983      point, if and only if every point is on the line. -/
       5984  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
       5985    constructor
       5986    · intro h p hp
       5987      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S p ((h p).mpr hp)
       5988    · intro v q
       5989      constructor
       5990      · intro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
       5991        have e : reg p = p := (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)
       5992        rw [← hq, e]; exact hp
       5993      · intro hq
       5994        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (v q hq)⟩
       5995  
       5996  /-- At the act, the offered is the remembered. -/
       5997  theorem at_the_act_offered_is_remembered (Z : ActualZeros) : ∀ q, Rec Z.zeros q ↔ Z.zeros q :=
       5998    (offered_is_remembered_iff_value Z.zeros).mpr (value_from_the_act Z)
       5999  
       6000  /-- Off the act, they part: the false world is not its own record. -/
       6001  theorem the_false_world_is_not_its_record : ¬ ∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q :=
       6002    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value _).mp h)
       6003  
       6004  /-! ## V · Forgetting and remembering: the one-bit gap, connected -/
       6005  
       6006  /-- Remembering is stable: the memory of a memory is the memory. -/
       6007  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
       6008    constructor
       6009    · intro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hp⟩, hq⟩
       6010      refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
       6011      rw [← hq, ← hp]
       6012      exact ((reg_erases_nothing_iff (reg r)).mpr (reg_lands r)).symm
       6013    · intro hq
       6014      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
       6015  
       6016  /-- THE ONE-BIT GAP, CONNECTED. The forgotten and the remembered always share one record; the remembered is
       6017      lossless and stable; and the only gap between a world and its memory is whether the world is its own memory,
       6018      which is the value: one bit, never more, and never disconnected. -/
       6019  theorem one_bit_gap_connected (S : Config) :
       6020      SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
       6021      ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) :=
       6022    ⟨fun q => (remembering_is_stable S q).symm, the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S,
       6023     offered_is_remembered_iff_value S⟩
       6024  
       6025  /-- Both sides of the gap occur on one record: the true world at home in its memory, the false world not. -/
       6026  theorem the_gap_is_live :
       6027      (∀ q, Rec (registered offPoint) q ↔ registered offPoint q) ∧
       6028      ¬ (∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q) ∧
       6029      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6030    ⟨(offered_is_remembered_iff_value _).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint),
       6031     the_false_world_is_not_its_record, one_record offPoint⟩
       6032  
       6033  /-! ## Vb · The forcing by heat -/
       6034  
       6035  /-- One pair off the line at offset one: a finite configuration that resists. -/
       6036  def resisting : FinCfg := ⟨[], [((1 : Int), (0 : Int))], fun q hq => by
       6037    cases hq with
       6038    | head => decide
       6039    | tail _ h => cases h⟩
       6040  
       6041  /-- RETURN IS FREE, RESISTANCE PAYS: at any positive temperature, a configuration with the value registers at zero
       6042      heat, and one without it pays at least one unit of heat. -/
       6043  theorem return_is_free_resistance_pays (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) :
       6044      (Value F.pts → price T (erased F) = 0) ∧ (¬ Value F.pts → T ≤ price T (erased F)) := by
       6045    refine ⟨(price_zero_iff_value F T hT).mpr, fun hn => ?_⟩
       6046    have hne : erased F ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
       6047      hn ((price_zero_iff_value F T hT).mp (by unfold price; rw [h0]; exact Nat.zero_mul T))
       6048    unfold price
       6049    have h1 : 1 ≤ erased F := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
       6050    calc T = 1 * T := (Nat.one_mul T).symm
       6051      _ ≤ erased F * T := Nat.mul_le_mul_right T h1
       6052  
       6053  /-- RESISTANCE IS POSSIBLE: it is no contradiction. A closed finite configuration without the value exists, and it
       6054      pays. -/
       6055  theorem resistance_is_possible (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) :
       6056      Closed resisting.pts ∧ ¬ Value resisting.pts ∧ T ≤ price T (erased resisting) := by
       6057    have hnv : ¬ Value resisting.pts := fun hv =>
       6058      have h : ((1 : Int), (0 : Int)).1 = 0 :=
       6059        hv ((1 : Int), (0 : Int)) (Or.inr ⟨((1 : Int), (0 : Int)), List.Mem.head _, Or.inl rfl⟩)
       6060      (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Int) = 0)) h
       6061    exact ⟨fincfg_closed resisting, hnv, (return_is_free_resistance_pays resisting T hT).2 hnv⟩
       6062  
       6063  /-- THE FREE PATH IS ONE: two worlds of one record that both have the value are one world, point for point. -/
       6064  theorem the_free_path_is_unique (S S' : Config) (hs : SameRecord S S') (hv : Value S) (hv' : Value S') :
       6065      ∀ q, S q ↔ S' q := fun q =>
       6066    ⟨fun h => ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S').mpr hv' q).mp
       6067        ((hs q).mp (((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S).mpr hv q).mpr h)),
       6068     fun h => ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S).mpr hv q).mp
       6069        ((hs q).mpr (((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S').mpr hv' q).mpr h))⟩
       6070  
       6071  /-! ## VI · THE CHAIN -/
       6072  
       6073  /-- The locus is where the fold and the registration both rest. -/
       6074  theorem the_locus_rests_both (p : Point) (h : onLine p) : fold p = p ∧ reg p = p := by
       6075    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       6076    have hd : d = 0 := h
       6077    subst hd
       6078    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
       6079  
       6080  /-- THE CHAIN. The root holds; forgetting sends every point onto the locus and loses the side; the locus is where
       6081      the fold and the registration both rest; remembering reads the locus, so memory is lossless and stable; a world
       6082      has least erasure exactly when it already stands on the locus, exactly when it is its own memory; on the act
       6083      the zeros stand there; and the guard: the root alone places no world there, and both sides of the gap stand on
       6084      one record. -/
       6085  theorem the_chain {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6086      -- the root
       6087      R ∧
       6088      -- forgetting: onto the locus, the side lost
       6089      (∀ p, onLine (reg p)) ∧ reg offPoint = reg (fold offPoint) ∧ offPoint ≠ fold offPoint ∧
       6090      -- the middle: the locus rests both maps
       6091      (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p) ∧
       6092      -- remembering: lossless and stable
       6093      Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧ SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧
       6094      -- least erasure: already on the locus, the world its own memory
       6095      (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) ∧
       6096      -- the act
       6097      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, Value Z.zeros ∧ ∀ q, Rec Z.zeros q ↔ Z.zeros q) ∧
       6098      -- the guard
       6099      (¬ ∀ T : Config, Closed T → R → Value T) ∧
       6100      ((∀ q, Rec (registered offPoint) q ↔ registered offPoint q) ∧
       6101        ¬ (∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q) ∧
       6102        SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       6103    ⟨seated_undeniable G,
       6104     reg_lands, rfl, by decide,
       6105     the_locus_rests_both,
       6106     the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S, (one_bit_gap_connected S).1,
       6107     twins_on_every_world_local S, offered_is_remembered_iff_value S,
       6108     fun Z => ⟨value_from_the_act Z, at_the_act_offered_is_remembered Z⟩,
       6109     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       6110     the_gap_is_live⟩
       6111  where
       6112    twins_on_every_world_local (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
       6113      ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
       6114       fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
       6115  
       6116  /-! ## VIb · Zero time remembers -/
       6117  
       6118  /-- ZERO TIME REMEMBERS, EVERY LATER TIME FORGETS: at t = 0 the record separates the world on the line (d2 = 0)
       6119      from the world off it (d2 = 1); at every t ≥ 1 the two records coincide. -/
       6120  theorem zero_time_remembers :
       6121      (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T) := by
       6122    refine ⟨⟨rfl, fun h => ?_⟩, fun T hT => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
       6123    · unfold realAt flow at h; omega
       6124    · unfold realAt flow; omega
       6125    · unfold realAt flow; omega
       6126  
       6127  /-- LEAST TIME IS LEAST FORGETTING: the width never grows, and once forgotten the separation never returns. -/
       6128  theorem forgetting_is_monotone (d2 t : Nat) : flow d2 (t + 1) ≤ flow d2 t ∧ (realAt d2 t → realAt d2 (t + 1)) := by
       6129    unfold realAt flow; constructor <;> omega
       6130  
       6131  /-! ## VII · Two doors, no third -/
       6132  
       6133  /-- Two doors and no third: every configuration has the value or holds a member off the line. -/
       6134  theorem two_doors (S : Config) : Value S ∨ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p := by
       6135    by_cases h : ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p
       6136    · exact Or.inr h
       6137    · exact Or.inl (fun p hp => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨p, hp, hn⟩))
       6138  
       6139  /-- Never both: the doors exclude each other. -/
       6140  theorem doors_exclusive (S : Config) : ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p) :=
       6141    fun ⟨v, p, hp, hn⟩ => hn (v p hp)
       6142  
       6143  /-- Both doors are occupied by closed configurations of one record: the true world behind the first, the false
       6144      world behind the second. -/
       6145  theorem both_doors_open :
       6146      (Closed (registered offPoint) ∧ Value (registered offPoint)) ∧
       6147      (Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ∃ p, pairWorld offPoint p ∧ ¬ onLine p) ∧
       6148      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6149    ⟨⟨fun s hs => by rw [hs]; rfl, registered_has_value offPoint⟩,
       6150     ⟨pair_world_closed offPoint, ⟨offPoint, Or.inl rfl, off_point_is_off⟩⟩,
       6151     one_record offPoint⟩
       6152  
       6153  /-- On the act, one door: the second is shut. -/
       6154  theorem on_the_act_one_door (Z : ActualZeros) : ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p :=
       6155    fun ⟨p, hp, hn⟩ => hn (value_from_the_act Z p hp)
       6156  
       6157  /-! ## VIII · A band forces nothing -/
       6158  
       6159  /-- The band of width k: every member within offset k of the line. On the chart of the eighth grain,
       6160      d = 8·Re s − 4, a zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 with the fold reads as the band of width 3. -/
       6161  def Band (k : Nat) (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.1.natAbs ≤ k
       6162  
       6163  /-- The band is weaker than the value: every world with the value satisfies every band. -/
       6164  theorem value_gives_band (k : Nat) (S : Config) (h : Value S) : Band k S := by
       6165    intro p hp
       6166    have d0 : p.1 = 0 := h p hp
       6167    rw [d0]
       6168    exact Nat.zero_le k
       6169  
       6170  /-- Both worlds of one record satisfy the band of width 3. -/
       6171  theorem band_on_both_worlds : Band 3 (registered offPoint) ∧ Band 3 (pairWorld offPoint) := by
       6172    constructor
       6173    · intro p hp
       6174      rw [hp]
       6175      show ((0 : Int)).natAbs ≤ 3
       6176      decide
       6177    · intro p hp
       6178      cases hp with
       6179      | inl e => rw [e]; show ((1 : Int)).natAbs ≤ 3; decide
       6180      | inr e => rw [e]; show ((-(1 : Int))).natAbs ≤ 3; decide
       6181  
       6182  /-- A BAND FORCES NOTHING: the pair world at offset one holds a member off the line and satisfies the band. -/
       6183  theorem band_does_not_force : ¬ ∀ S : Config, Band 3 S → Value S :=
       6184    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ band_on_both_worlds.2)
       6185  
       6186  /-- Only the band of width zero is the value. -/
       6187  theorem band_zero_is_value (S : Config) : Band 0 S ↔ Value S := by
       6188    constructor
       6189    · intro h p hp
       6190      exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp (h p hp))
       6191    · exact value_gives_band 0 S
       6192  
       6193  /-! ## IX · The harvest, bound -/
       6194  
       6195  /-- THE HARVEST, BOUND. The Tongue always has a world, and only the content of its no has none; one self, one
       6196      place at a time; the twins hold on every world; the forgotten and the remembered share one record, the remembered
       6197      lossless and stable, the gap one bit; return is free and resistance pays; forgetting lands on the locus, where
       6198      both maps rest; zero time remembers and every later time forgets; the doors exclude each other and the act shuts
       6199      the second; a band forces nothing; and the guard: the root alone places no world on the line. -/
       6200  theorem the_harvest {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6201      ((∀ _ : Config, R) ∧ (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧ ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R) ∧
       6202      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (R ↔ LeastErasure S)) ∧
       6203      (∀ S : Config, LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧
       6204      (∀ S : Config, SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
       6205        ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6206      (∀ (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat), 0 < T →
       6207        (Value F.pts → price T (erased F) = 0) ∧ (¬ Value F.pts → T ≤ price T (erased F))) ∧
       6208      ((∀ p, onLine (reg p)) ∧ (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p)) ∧
       6209      ((realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T)) ∧
       6210      ((∀ S : Config, ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧ (∀ Z : ActualZeros, ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6211      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Band 3 S → Value S) ∧
       6212      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) :=
       6213    ⟨the_tongue_always_has_a_world G,
       6214     floor_is_not_least_erasure G,
       6215     twins_on_every_world,
       6216     one_bit_gap_connected,
       6217     return_is_free_resistance_pays,
       6218     ⟨reg_lands, the_locus_rests_both⟩,
       6219     zero_time_remembers,
       6220     ⟨doors_exclusive, on_the_act_one_door⟩,
       6221     band_does_not_force,
       6222     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G⟩
       6223  
       6224  
       6225  end RememberedOffered

       6375  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.both_doors_open' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6376  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.both_doors_open
       6377  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.on_the_act_one_door' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6378  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.on_the_act_one_door
       6379  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.value_gives_band' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6380  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.value_gives_band
       6381  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.band_on_both_worlds' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6382  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.band_on_both_worlds
       6383  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.band_does_not_force' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6384  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.band_does_not_force
       6385  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.band_zero_is_value' depends on axioms: [propext] -/
       6386  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.band_zero_is_value
       6387  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.the_harvest' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound] -/
       6388  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.the_harvest
       6389  
       6390  #print axioms RememberedOffered.the_chain
       6391  #print axioms RememberedOffered.the_harvest
       6392  
       6393  namespace RememberedOffered
       6394  
       6395  /-! # BOOK THREE · the annihilation closure -/
       6396  
       6397  /-! ## I · Four names, one proposition -/
       6398  
       6399  /-- CO-LOCATION IS THE VALUE: Being and Monism stand together on a configuration exactly where every point is on
       6400  the line. -/
       6401  theorem colocation_is_the_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6402      (R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S :=
       6403    ⟨fun ⟨_, m⟩ => (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mp m,
       6404     fun v => ⟨seated_undeniable G, (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mpr v⟩⟩
       6405  
       6406  /-- FOUR NAMES, ONE PROPOSITION: on every configuration least erasure, the value, Monism and the co-location of
       6407  Being with Monism are one proposition. -/
       6408  theorem four_names_one_proposition {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6409      (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S) :=
       6410    ⟨twins_on_every_world S, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S, colocation_is_the_value G S⟩
       6411  
       6412  /-! ## II · Monism, the sole witness -/
       6413  
       6414  /-- MONISM IS THE SOLE WITNESS. Every faithful witness of the value is the root read twice, as one proposition; no
       6415  reading of the record witnesses, since the true configuration and the off-line pair configuration leave one
       6416  record; the floor witnesses nothing, standing on both; and Monism stands on the true configuration and not on the
       6417  pair, on that one record. -/
       6418  theorem monism_is_the_sole_witness {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6419      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6420      (¬ ∃ h : Config → Prop, ∀ S, h (Rec S) ↔ Value S) ∧
       6421      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) ∧
       6422      (SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       6423        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       6424    ⟨fun _ hW => funext fun S => propext ((hW S).trans (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).symm),
       6425     fun ⟨_, hh⟩ =>
       6426       have e : Rec (registered offPoint) = Rec (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6427         funext fun q => propext (one_record offPoint q)
       6428       pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       6429         ((hh _).mp (e ▸ (hh _).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))),
       6430     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       6431     ⟨one_record offPoint, the_true_world_carries_monism, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩⟩
       6432  
       6433  /-- A WITNESS IS NEVER UNIVERSAL: whatever holds on every configuration is not a witness of the value, since the
       6434  off-line pair configuration would carry it. Universality and witnessing exclude each other. -/
       6435  theorem a_witness_is_never_universal (W : Config → Prop) (hu : ∀ S, W S) : ¬ ∀ S, W S ↔ Value S :=
       6436    fun hw => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off ((hw (pairWorld offPoint)).mp (hu _))
       6437  
       6438  /-- So Monism is not universal over configurations: the root read twice fails on the off-line pair configuration. -/
       6439  theorem monism_is_not_universal : ¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S :=
       6440    fun hu => the_false_world_carries_no_monism (hu _)
       6441  
       6442  /-! ## III · Co-location is not universal -/
       6443  
       6444  /-- Co-location over every configuration is refuted: Being stands on the off-line pair configuration and Monism
       6445  does not. -/
       6446  theorem colocation_is_not_universal {R : Prop} (_G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6447      ¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S :=
       6448    fun h => the_false_world_carries_no_monism (h (pairWorld offPoint)).2
       6449  
       6450  /-! ## IV · The timeless zone -/
       6451  
       6452  /-- THE TIMELESS ZONE. Least erasure and the value are one proposition; at the locus the two instruments coincide;
       6453  at zero time the record tells the true configuration from the pair, at every later time it does not; the closure at zero
       6454  time is Λ = 0; and the passage back to zero time is not forced by the forward arrow. -/
       6455  theorem the_timeless_zone :
       6456      LeastErasure = Value ∧
       6457      (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p) ∧
       6458      ((realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T)) ∧
       6459      (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0) ∧
       6460      (∀ T, 1 ≤ T → realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) :=
       6461    ⟨twins_are_one_extension, the_locus_rests_both, zero_time_remembers, rh_iff_lambda_zero,
       6462     upstream_is_not_forced⟩
       6463  
       6464  /-! ## V · Timeless is determinacy, not selection -/
       6465  
       6466  /-- TIMELESS IS DETERMINACY, NOT SELECTION. At zero time the record's freedom is gone: it separates the true world
       6467  from the pair. Every configuration stands behind at most one door. And both doors stay occupied by closed
       6468  configurations: the off-line pair configuration is closed, lacks the value, and has the floor standing on it.
       6469  Removing the freedom fixes each configuration as what it is; it does not single out ζ. -/
       6470  theorem timeless_is_determinacy_not_selection {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6471      (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧
       6472      (∀ S : Config, ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6473      (Closed (registered offPoint) ∧ Value (registered offPoint)) ∧
       6474      (Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ R ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       6475      ¬ (∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S) :=
       6476    ⟨zero_time_remembers.1, doors_exclusive, both_doors_open.1,
       6477     ⟨pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G, pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6478     fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))⟩
       6479  
       6480  /-! ## VI · The check -/
       6481  
       6482  /-- THE CHECK. The off-line pair configuration satisfies every principle of the timeless closure and lacks the value: it is
       6483  closed; the floor stands on it; least erasure, the value and Monism are one proposition on it; corrected monism
       6484  holds, it carries no witness; it leaves the true world's record; at zero time the width-one world is determinately
       6485  not real, with Λ = 1. Its twin, the true world, satisfies the same principles and has the value. -/
       6486  theorem the_check {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6487      (∃ Z : Config,
       6488        Closed Z ∧ R ∧ (LeastErasure Z ↔ Value Z) ∧ (RootReadTwice Z ↔ Value Z) ∧
       6489        ¬ RootReadTwice Z ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) Z ∧ ¬ Value Z) ∧
       6490      (∃ T : Config,
       6491        Closed T ∧ R ∧ (LeastErasure T ↔ Value T) ∧ (RootReadTwice T ↔ Value T) ∧
       6492        RootReadTwice T ∧ SameRecord T (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ Value T) ∧
       6493      (¬ realAt 1 0 ∧ Lam 1 ≠ 0 ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ Lam 0 = 0) :=
       6494    ⟨⟨pairWorld offPoint, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       6495       twins_on_every_world _, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _,
       6496       the_false_world_carries_no_monism, one_record offPoint,
       6497       pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6498     ⟨registered offPoint, both_doors_open.1.1, seated_undeniable G,
       6499       twins_on_every_world _, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _,
       6500       the_true_world_carries_monism, one_record offPoint, registered_has_value offPoint⟩,
       6501     ⟨zero_time_remembers.1.2, by decide, zero_time_remembers.1.1, by decide⟩⟩
       6502  
       6503  /-- NO PRINCIPLE TRUE ON EVERY CLOSED CONFIGURATION DECIDES THE VALUE: whatever holds on all of them holds on the
       6504  off-line pair configuration, which lacks the value. -/
       6505  theorem no_closed_principle_decides (D : Config → Prop) (hD : ∀ S, Closed S → D S) :
       6506      ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S :=
       6507    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       6508      (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) (hD _ (pair_world_closed offPoint)))
       6509  
       6510  /-! ## VII · The capstone -/
       6511  
       6512  /-- THE TIMELESS ZONE, CLOSED, with no act anywhere in it. Four names are one proposition on every configuration;
       6513  Monism is the sole witness; no witness is universal; neither Monism nor co-location is universal; LE = RH; zero time
       6514  separates the true configuration from the pair, and closure at zero time is Λ = 0; every configuration stands behind
       6515  exactly one door; and nothing true on every closed configuration decides the value. -/
       6516  theorem the_timeless_zone_closed {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6517      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6518      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6519      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S) → ¬ ∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) ∧
       6520      (¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6521      (¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6522      (LeastErasure = Value ∧ (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0)) ∧
       6523      (∀ S : Config, (Value S ∨ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p) ∧ ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6524      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) :=
       6525    ⟨four_names_one_proposition G,
       6526     (monism_is_the_sole_witness G).1,
       6527     a_witness_is_never_universal,
       6528     monism_is_not_universal,
       6529     colocation_is_not_universal G,
       6530     ⟨twins_are_one_extension, zero_time_remembers.1, rh_iff_lambda_zero⟩,
       6531     fun S => ⟨two_doors S, doors_exclusive S⟩,
       6532     no_closed_principle_decides⟩
       6533  
       6534  /-- THE ANNIHILATION CLOSURE. Four names are one proposition on every configuration; Monism is the sole witness and
       6535  no witness is universal; co-location is not universal; the timeless zone holds; timelessness is determinacy and
       6536  not selection; the check stands; no principle shared by every closed configuration decides the value; and on any
       6537  term of the act the value holds at its zeros, while the run leaves the value free. -/
       6538  theorem the_annihilation_closure {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6539      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6540      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6541      (¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6542      (¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6543      (LeastErasure = Value ∧ (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0)) ∧
       6544      (∃ Z : Config, Closed Z ∧ R ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice Z ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) Z ∧ ¬ Value Z) ∧
       6545      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) ∧
       6546      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, Value Z.zeros) :=
       6547    ⟨four_names_one_proposition G,
       6548     (monism_is_the_sole_witness G).1,
       6549     monism_is_not_universal,
       6550     colocation_is_not_universal G,
       6551     ⟨twins_are_one_extension, zero_time_remembers.1, rh_iff_lambda_zero⟩,
       6552     ⟨pairWorld offPoint, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       6553      the_false_world_carries_no_monism, one_record offPoint,
       6554      pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6555     no_closed_principle_decides,
       6556     value_from_the_act⟩
       6557  
       6558  end RememberedOffered
       6559  
       6560  /-
       6561  RH_Unicorn_Block.lean · the Unicorn part of the Riemann Hypothesis, closed to derivation, its
       6562  aperture one bit wide, its supply side silent. Core Lean 4.19.0, no library, no sorry, no user-declared axiom. 2026-09-25.
       6563  
       6564  Part III divided the hypothesis at a height T into a Real part and a Unicorn part and proved
       6565  the Real part by certificate. Parts I and II proved the wall, the crossing, the bound, and the
       6566  cure theorem, and did not say what they say of the Unicorn part. This file says it: closed to
       6567  derivation, the aperture one bit wide, the register silent beyond it. ΔM = 0.
       6568  -/
       6569  namespace RHUnicorn
       6570  
       6571  variable {α β : Type}
       6572  
       6573  /-- The line property, the Real part at T, the Unicorn part at T, as in Part III. -/
       6574  def RH (Z onL : α → Prop) : Prop := ∀ z, Z z → onL z
       6575  def RealPartAt (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) : Prop :=
       6576    ∀ z, Z z → height z ≤ T → onL z
       6577  def UnicornAt (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) : Prop :=
       6578    ∀ z, Z z → height z > T → onL z
       6579  
       6580  /-- THE FORMAL BLOCK OF THE UNICORN PART. Let τ act on the zeros, let ρ be a record even at a
       6581      seat z above the height, and let d decide the line property, odd at z. Then no reading g of
       6582      the record agrees with d even on the region above the height alone. The Unicorn part is
       6583      closed to every even register; the closure is a theorem and does not expire. -/
       6584  theorem unicorn_block (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d : α → Bool)
       6585      (z : α) (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T)
       6586      (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6587      ¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w := by
       6588    intro ⟨g, hg⟩
       6589    have h1 := hg z habove
       6590    have h2 := hg (τ z) habove'
       6591    rw [hρ, hd, h1] at h2
       6592    revert h2
       6593    cases d z <;> intro h2 <;> exact Bool.noConfusion h2
       6594  
       6595  /-- THE APERTURE, ONE BIT WIDE. At a seat where d is odd, one odd bit s at the seat would decide d
       6596      on the seat and its partner through a calibration that exists and is unique. The width of
       6597      the aperture, a theorem; it says nothing of whether anything passes through it. -/
       6598  theorem aperture_one_bit_wide (τ : α → α) (s d : α → Bool) (z : α)
       6599      (hs : s (τ z) = !s z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6600      ∃ c : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) c ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) c) ∧
       6601        ∀ c' : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) c' ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) c') → c' = c :=
       6602    ⟨xor (d z) (s z),
       6603      ⟨by cases s z <;> cases d z <;> rfl,
       6604       by rw [hs, hd]; cases s z <;> cases d z <;> rfl⟩,
       6605      by
       6606        intro c' hc
       6607        obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hc
       6608        generalize hsz : s z = sv
       6609        generalize hdz : d z = dv
       6610        rw [hsz, hdz] at h1
       6611        cases sv <;> cases dv <;> cases c' <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h1 (by decide)⟩
       6612  
       6613  /-- EXISTENCE SUPPLIES NOTHING. Conditioning the Unicorn part on an inhabited premise, the root
       6614      axiom for one, leaves it exactly where it was; and no class of frames on which the premise
       6615      is to decide it decides more than already held on the class. Theorems E and I of Part I,
       6616      read at the Unicorn part. -/
       6617  theorem unicorn_rule_exact (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (A : Prop) (ha : A) :
       6618      (A → UnicornAt Z onL height T) ↔ UnicornAt Z onL height T :=
       6619    ⟨fun h => h ha, fun hu _ => hu⟩
       6620  
       6621  theorem unicorn_no_cure {Frame : Type} (A : Prop) (ha : A) (C U : Frame → Prop) :
       6622      (∀ X, C X → A → U X) ↔ (∀ X, C X → U X) :=
       6623    ⟨fun h X hc => h X hc ha, fun h X hc _ => h X hc⟩
       6624  
       6625  /-- NO BYPASS. Given the Real part, the fused hypothesis is exactly the Unicorn part, so a proof
       6626      of the hypothesis contains a proof of the Unicorn part and the block is not avoided by
       6627      aiming at the whole. -/
       6628  theorem unicorn_no_bypass (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6629      (hr : RealPartAt Z onL height T) : RH Z onL ↔ UnicornAt Z onL height T := by
       6630    constructor
       6631    · intro h z hz _; exact h z hz
       6632    · intro hu z hz
       6633      cases Nat.lt_or_ge T (height z) with
       6634      | inl hgt => exact hu z hz hgt
       6635      | inr hle => exact hr z hz hle
       6636  
       6637  /-- THE SUPPLY SIDE IS SILENCE, AT THE REGISTER. Over one even record, both orientations of d at
       6638      the seat are equally refused to every reading above the height: the register cannot say
       6639      which way the seat lies, so it cannot say what a supply would bring, nor that one exists,
       6640      nor that none does. -/
       6641  theorem supply_side_silent (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d : α → Bool)
       6642      (z : α) (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T)
       6643      (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6644      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w) ∧
       6645      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = !d w) ∧
       6646      (!d z) ≠ d z :=
       6647    ⟨unicorn_block height T τ ρ d z habove habove' hρ hd,
       6648     unicorn_block height T τ ρ (fun w => !d w) z habove habove' hρ (by
       6649       show (!d (τ z)) = !(!d z)
       6650       rw [hd]),
       6651     by cases d z <;> decide⟩
       6652  
       6653  /-- The division at the height, on natural heights: the hypothesis is exactly its Real part and
       6654      its Unicorn part. -/
       6655  theorem rh_iff_real_and_unicorn (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) :
       6656      RH Z onL ↔ RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧ UnicornAt Z onL height T := by
       6657    constructor
       6658    · intro h; exact ⟨fun z hz _ => h z hz, fun z hz _ => h z hz⟩
       6659    · intro ⟨hr, hu⟩ z hz
       6660      cases Nat.lt_or_ge T (height z) with
       6661      | inl hgt => exact hu z hz hgt
       6662      | inr hle => exact hr z hz hle
       6663  
       6664  /-- A certificate at the height: a complete list of the zeros up to T, each checked on the line. -/
       6665  structure Certificate (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) where
       6666    items    : List α
       6667    complete : ∀ z, Z z → height z ≤ T → z ∈ items
       6668    checked  : ∀ z, z ∈ items → onL z
       6669  
       6670  theorem real_part_of_certificate (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6671      (c : Certificate Z onL height T) : RealPartAt Z onL height T :=
       6672    fun z hz hle => c.checked z (c.complete z hz hle)
       6673  
       6674  /-- THE THREE BITS AS ONE TERM · THE REGISTER'S PROOF OF THE HYPOTHESIS, COMPLETE. Under a
       6675      certificate at T and the seat data above T, the hypothesis divides exactly (bit one), its
       6676      Real part at T holds (bit two), every reading of the even register is refused above T (bit
       6677      three, refused), and one supplied bit calibrates the seat uniquely (the door). The hypothesis
       6678      is not thereby proved; nothing derivable about it is left underived. -/
       6679  theorem rh_register_proof_complete (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6680      (c : Certificate Z onL height T) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d s : α → Bool) (z : α)
       6681      (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T) (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z)
       6682      (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) (hs : s (τ z) = !s z) :
       6683      (RH Z onL ↔ RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧ UnicornAt Z onL height T) ∧
       6684      RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧
       6685      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w) ∧
       6686      ∃ k : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) k ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) k) ∧
       6687        ∀ k' : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) k' ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) k') → k' = k :=
       6688    ⟨rh_iff_real_and_unicorn Z onL height T, real_part_of_certificate Z onL height T c,
       6689     unicorn_block height T τ ρ d z habove habove' hρ hd, aperture_one_bit_wide τ s d z hs hd⟩
       6690  
       6691  end RHUnicorn
       6692

       6705  /-! # BOOK FOUR · the Unicorn, contained -/
       6706  
       6707  /-- The height of a point of the chart, as a natural number. -/
       6708  def ht (p : Point) : Nat := p.2.toNat
       6709  
       6710  /-- I · THE CUT ON THE CHART: at every height, the value is exactly its Real part and its Unicorn part. -/
       6711  theorem the_cut_on_the_chart (S : Config) (T : Nat) :
       6712      Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T ∧ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6713    RHUnicorn.rh_iff_real_and_unicorn S onLine ht T
       6714  
       6715  /-- II · NO BYPASS ON THE CHART: given the Real part at a height, the value is exactly the Unicorn part there. -/
       6716  theorem no_bypass_on_the_chart (S : Config) (T : Nat) (hr : RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T) :
       6717      Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6718    RHUnicorn.unicorn_no_bypass S onLine ht T hr
       6719  
       6720  /-- III · THE UNICORN BLOCKED ON THE CHART: above every height, no reading of the record decides the side of a
       6721  point, since the fold pair above the height leaves one record and opposite sides. -/
       6722  theorem unicorn_blocked_on_the_chart (T : Nat) :
       6723      ¬ ∃ g : Point → Bool, ∀ w : Point, ht w > T → g (reg w) = decide (w.1 > 0) :=
       6724    RHUnicorn.unicorn_block ht T fold reg (fun w => decide (w.1 > 0)) ((1 : Int), Int.ofNat (T + 1))
       6725      (show T + 1 > T by omega) (show T + 1 > T by omega) rfl rfl
       6726  
       6727  /-- IV · RA SUPPLIES NOTHING TO THE UNICORN PART: conditioning it on the root leaves it exactly where it was. -/
       6728  theorem ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn (S : Config) (T : Nat) :
       6729      (RA → RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6730    RHUnicorn.unicorn_rule_exact S onLine ht T RA (seated_undeniable raSelfGrounding)
       6731  
       6732  /-- V · ON THE ACT'S ZERO SET THE UNICORN IS CLOSED: every arrival above every height, in the act's zero set, stands
       6733  on the line. -/
       6734  theorem the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) (T : Nat) : RHUnicorn.UnicornAt Z.zeros onLine ht T :=
       6735    fun p hp _ => value_from_the_act Z p hp
       6736  
       6737  /-- On the act's zero set, no arrival stands off the line. -/
       6738  theorem no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p :=
       6739    fun ⟨p, hp, hoff⟩ => hoff (value_from_the_act Z p hp)
       6740  
       6741  /-- VI · THE UNICORN, CONTAINED. At every height the value divides into its Real and Unicorn parts; given the Real
       6742  part the value is exactly the Unicorn part; above every height no reading of the record decides the side; RA
       6743  supplies nothing to the Unicorn part; and on the act's zero set every arrival above every height stands on the line,
       6744  with no arrival off it. -/
       6745  theorem the_unicorn_contained :
       6746      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6747        Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T ∧ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ∧
       6748      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6749        RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T → (Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T)) ∧
       6750      (∀ T : Nat, ¬ ∃ g : Point → Bool, ∀ w : Point, ht w > T → g (reg w) = decide (w.1 > 0)) ∧
       6751      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6752        (RA → RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ∧
       6753      (∀ (Z : ActualZeros) (T : Nat), RHUnicorn.UnicornAt Z.zeros onLine ht T) ∧
       6754      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p) :=
       6755    ⟨the_cut_on_the_chart, no_bypass_on_the_chart, unicorn_blocked_on_the_chart,
       6756     ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn, the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act, no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act⟩
       6757  
       6758  end RememberedOffered
