       7892  /-! ## THE PLUG · appended, nothing above changed. The run's true flag offered as the act's supply field. -/
       7893  namespace ForceWitness
       7894  /-- The plug, attempted: if a true flag supplied least erasure on every closed world, the run would force the value.
       7895      The compiler refuses it. -/
       7896  theorem the_plug_fails {Q : Type} (s : Exec Q) (h : ran s = true) :
       7897      ¬ (ran s = true → ∀ S : Config, Closed S → LeastErasure S) :=
       7898    fun plug => the_run_does_not_force_the_value s h (fun S hS => value_from_the_act ⟨S, hS, plug h S hS⟩)
       7899  /-- What the plug does deliver: with the act's field beside the run, the value stands on that field, the run is
       7900      witnessed, and the run still leaves the value free. Run and field are two inputs, never one. -/
       7901  theorem the_plug_delivers {Q : Type} (d : SubstrateDeed Q) (Z : ActualZeros) :
       7902      Value Z.zeros ∧ (∃ r : Exec Q, ran r = true) ∧ ¬ (∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S) :=
       7903    ⟨value_from_the_act Z, the_run_witnesses_a_run d.run d.didRun, the_run_does_not_force_the_value d.run d.didRun⟩
       7904  end ForceWitness
       7905  
       7906  end PartIVb
       7907  
       7908  /-! # PART IV-c · the time kernel of the monism-fixed codex, verbatim, with the judge probe -/
       7909  section PartIVc
       7910  /-
       7911    The time kernel of the monism-fixed codex, carried verbatim: Codex.lean of the Master Codex v5.1.0 with the patch of
       7912    APEX-PSP-MONISM-FIXED-01 applied (patched sha256 22d908f7d3d2c96b…), its two TimeLocus sections, lines 7875 to 7947,
       7913    followed by the judge probe of this edition. Nothing in the carried lines is changed. The carried chart reads real
       7914    parts as the first edition's chart does at resolution one, x = 2·Re s, with heights in ℤ, and its counter-world's
       7915    off-line pair sits at x = 0 and 2, Re s = 0 and 1;
       7916    the judge probe states the same test on the offset chart inside the open strip, with the conjugate symmetry and the
       7917    empty low band, its off-line zeros at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4. Two names in a carried docstring,
       7918    `not_constructible_off_line` and `monism_witness_fails_in_counter_world`, are theorems of the patched codex outside
       7919    the carried lines; they are not in this seed and nothing here uses them.
       7920  -/
       7921  namespace TimeLocus
       7922  
       7923  def onLine (p : Int × Int) : Prop := p.1 = 1
       7924  
       7925  /-- A timed world: the locus at each time, and the zeros present at each time. -/
       7926  structure World where
       7927    locus : Nat → (Int × Int → Prop)
       7928    zeros : Nat → (Int × Int → Prop)
       7929  
       7930  /-- TIME PSP premise: prior and posterior locus are the SAME locus, the line, at every time. -/
       7931  def SameLocus (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.locus t p ↔ onLine p
       7932  
       7933  /-- The claim to be tested: every zero at every time is bound to the locus. -/
       7934  def Bound (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → W.locus t p
       7935  
       7936  /-- Fold-invariance at every time: the functional equation acts at each iteration. -/
       7937  def FoldInv (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → W.zeros t (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7938  
       7939  /-- 51. Given the same locus at all times, being bound IS the line property at all times. -/
       7940  theorem bound_iff_line (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) :
       7941      Bound W ↔ ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → onLine p :=
       7942    ⟨fun b t p z => (h t p).mp (b t p z), fun l t p z => (h t p).mpr (l t p z)⟩
       7943  
       7944  /-- 52, the test world. A world where the locus is the same line at every time, the fold acts at every
       7945      time, the on-line zero recurs at every time, and a mirror pair sits off the line at every time. -/
       7946  def testWorld : World :=
       7947    ⟨fun _ p => onLine p, fun _ p => p = (1, 0) ∨ p = (0, 5) ∨ p = (2, 5)⟩
       7948  
       7949  theorem test_same_locus : SameLocus testWorld := fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
       7950  
       7951  theorem test_fold_inv : FoldInv testWorld := by
       7952    intro _ p hp
       7953    rcases hp with h | h | h <;> subst h
       7954    · exact Or.inl rfl
       7955    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       7956    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       7957  
       7958  theorem test_not_bound : ¬ Bound testWorld := fun b => by
       7959    have := b 0 (0, 5) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)); cases this
       7960  
       7961  /-- 52. Therefore SameLocus and FoldInv, at every time, do not imply Bound. -/
       7962  theorem time_does_not_bind :
       7963      ¬ ∀ W : World, SameLocus W → FoldInv W → Bound W :=
       7964    fun h => test_not_bound (h testWorld test_same_locus test_fold_inv)
       7965  
       7966  end TimeLocus
       7967  
       7968  namespace TimeLocus
       7969  
       7970  /-- Residual Monism read as the Codex states it: one involution serves both routes. -/
       7971  def sigmaGeo (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7972  def sigmaForm (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7973  def OneInvolution : Prop := ∀ p, sigmaGeo p = sigmaForm p
       7974  
       7975  /-- Residual Monism read as timeless: whether the zeros sit on the locus does not vary in time. -/
       7976  def P (W : World) (t : Nat) : Prop := ∀ p, W.zeros t p → onLine p
       7977  def Timeless (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t s, P W t ↔ P W s
       7978  
       7979  /-- 53. The seedless reading holds in the counter-world: one involution by rfl, and timelessness
       7980      because the property "all zeros on the line" is constantly false there. Timeless and unbound.
       7981      This is not monism. The monism witness carries its seed, and in the counter-world it fails
       7982      (`not_constructible_off_line`, `monism_witness_fails_in_counter_world`). -/
       7983  theorem seedless_reading_holds_in_counter_world :
       7984      OneInvolution ∧ Timeless testWorld ∧ ¬ Bound testWorld :=
       7985    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, test_not_bound⟩
       7986  
       7987  /-- 54. What timeless monism does do: it makes one instant decide all time. With the seed, binding
       7988      follows; the seed is "every zero present at the instant is on the line". -/
       7989  theorem timeless_with_seed_binds (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) (u : Timeless W) (s0 : P W 0) :
       7990      Bound W :=
       7991    (bound_iff_line W h).mpr (fun t p z => ((u 0 t).mp s0) p z)
       7992  
       7993  end TimeLocus
       7994  
       7995  namespace Judge
       7996  open TimeLocus
       7997  /-- The identical locus, the fold at every time, one involution and timelessness together do not exclude a zero off
       7998      the line: the counter-world carries all four. -/
       7999  theorem identical_locus_does_not_exclude :
       8000      ¬ ∀ W : World, SameLocus W → FoldInv W → OneInvolution → Timeless W → Bound W :=
       8001    fun h => test_not_bound (h testWorld test_same_locus test_fold_inv (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl))
       8002  /-- What does exclude it: on the same locus and timeless, being bound is exactly the seed at time zero. -/
       8003  theorem the_seed_is_exactly_what_binds (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) (u : Timeless W) : Bound W ↔ P W 0 :=
       8004    ⟨fun b => fun p z => ((bound_iff_line W h).mp b) 0 p z, fun s0 => timeless_with_seed_binds W h u s0⟩
       8005  
       8006  /-- The same test on the offset chart, d = 8·Re s − 4, inside the open strip: at every time the line occupied at every
       8007      height |t| ≥ 14, and one mirrored pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 with its conjugate. -/
       8008  def offsetWorld (_ : Nat) (p : RememberedOffered.Point) : Prop :=
       8009    (p.1 = 0 ∧ (14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14)) ∨ p = (2, 3000000000001) ∨ p = (-2, 3000000000001) ∨
       8010      p = (2, -3000000000001) ∨ p = (-2, -3000000000001)
       8011  /-- Bound on the offset chart: every zero at every time on the line, the same locus at every time. -/
       8012  def BoundO (Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config) : Prop := ∀ t p, Z t p → RememberedOffered.onLine p
       8013  /-- Timeless on the offset chart: whether every zero sits on the line does not vary in time. -/
       8014  def TimelessO (Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config) : Prop :=
       8015    ∀ t s, (∀ p, Z t p → RememberedOffered.onLine p) ↔ (∀ p, Z s p → RememberedOffered.onLine p)
       8016  
       8017  /-- THE IDENTICAL LOCUS INSIDE THE STRIP DOES NOT EXCLUDE: on the offset chart, the same locus at every time, the fold
       8018      and conjugation at every time, the empty low band, every zero strictly inside the strip (Re s strictly between 0
       8019      and 1) and timelessness hold together on a world that is not bound; and on every timeless world being bound is
       8020      exactly the seed at time zero. -/
       8021  theorem identical_locus_inside_the_strip_does_not_exclude :
       8022      (∀ t, RememberedOffered.Closed (offsetWorld t)) ∧
       8023      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → offsetWorld t (p.1, -p.2)) ∧
       8024      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → 14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14) ∧
       8025      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → -4 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 4) ∧
       8026      TimelessO offsetWorld ∧ ¬ BoundO offsetWorld ∧
       8027      (∀ Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config, TimelessO Z →
       8028        (BoundO Z ↔ ∀ p, Z 0 p → RememberedOffered.onLine p)) := by
       8029    refine ⟨fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
       8030    · unfold offsetWorld at hp ⊢
       8031      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8032      · exact Or.inl ⟨show -p.1 = 0 by omega, h2⟩
       8033      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8034      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8035      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by decide))))
       8036      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))))
       8037    · unfold offsetWorld at hp ⊢
       8038      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8039      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, by omega⟩
       8040      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))))
       8041      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by decide))))
       8042      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8043      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8044    · unfold offsetWorld at hp
       8045      rcases hp with ⟨_, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8046      · exact h2
       8047      all_goals (subst h; decide)
       8048    · unfold offsetWorld at hp
       8049      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8050      · constructor <;> omega
       8051      all_goals (subst h; decide)
       8052    · intro b
       8053      have h : (2 : Int) = 0 := b 0 (2, 3000000000001) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8054      exact absurd h (by decide)
       8055    · intro Z u
       8056      exact ⟨fun b => b 0, fun s0 t p z => ((u 0 t).mp s0) p z⟩
       8057  end Judge
       8058  
       8059  end PartIVc
       8060  
       8061  /-! # PART V · the arrow-side test -/
       8062  section PartV
       8063  /-
       8064    ARROW SIDE TEST · the ζ-specific facts, placed on RA's arrow, tested against an off-line pair.
       8065    Core Lean 4.19.0, no import, no axiom declared, no sorry.
       8066    Chart: x = 2W·Re s at resolution W, height t. The arrow's tail pole s = 0 sits at x = 0, its head pole s = 1 at
       8067    x = 2W, its hinge Re s = 1/2 at x = W. The Euler product lives beyond the head.
       8068    Each fact ζ has and the Davenport–Heilbronn shape lacks, or that is proved for ζ, enters as a predicate at its
       8069    place on the arrow, its source cited:
       8070      ENDS       Build and Edge: no zero at or beyond either pole (Euler product for Re s > 1; the prime number theorem's
       8071                 non-vanishing on Re s = 1; mirrored by the functional equation) [cited].
       8072      ZERO-FREE  near the head, and by the fold near the tail: at height t no zero within m t of a pole
       8073                 (de la Vallée Poussin; explicit constants Mossinghoff–Trudgian) [cited]; the margin is a parameter.
       8074      REAL PART  every zero up to height T0 on the line (Platt–Trudgian: every zero with 0 < Im s ≤ 3·10¹²) [cited];
       8075                 heights are read by their integer part, so chart height T0 = 3·10¹² − 1 reads Im s < 3·10¹².
       8076      FINITELY OFF  only finitely many zeros off the line: stronger than every positive-proportion theorem
       8077                 (Selberg, Levinson, Conrey) and every zero-density estimate [cited].
       8078  -/
       8079  set_option autoImplicit false
       8080  namespace ArrowSide
       8081  
       8082  abbrev Pt := Int × Int
       8083  
       8084  structure Chart where
       8085    W : Int
       8086    hW : 0 < W
       8087  
       8088  def onLine (C : Chart) (p : Pt) : Prop := p.1 = C.W
       8089  def fold (C : Chart) (p : Pt) : Pt := (2 * C.W - p.1, p.2)
       8090  def Closed (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold C p)
       8091  def Value (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine C p
       8092  
       8093  def ArrowEnds (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * C.W
       8094  def ZeroFree (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop :=
       8095    ∀ p, S p → m p.2 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * C.W - m p.2
       8096  def RealPart (C : Chart) (T0 : Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.2 ≤ T0 → onLine C p
       8097  def FinitelyOff (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∃ L : List Pt, ∀ p, S p → ¬ onLine C p → p ∈ L
       8098  
       8099  /-- The ζ-shaped world: a zero on the line at every height, and one mirrored pair at offset d, height H. -/
       8100  def zetaShaped (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Pt → Prop :=
       8101    fun p => p.1 = C.W ∨ p = (C.W - d, H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, H)
       8102  
       8103  theorem shaped_closed (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Closed C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8104    intro p hp
       8105    unfold zetaShaped at hp ⊢
       8106    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8107    · left; show 2 * C.W - p.1 = C.W; omega
       8108    · subst h; right; right; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8109    · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8110  
       8111  theorem shaped_ends (C : Chart) (d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) : ArrowEnds C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8112    have hW := C.hW
       8113    intro p hp
       8114    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8115    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8116    · constructor <;> omega
       8117    · subst h; show 0 < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W; constructor <;> omega
       8118    · subst h; show 0 < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W; constructor <;> omega
       8119  
       8120  theorem shaped_zero_free (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (hm : ∀ t, m t < C.W) (d H : Int) (hmH : m H < C.W - d)
       8121      (hd : 0 < d) : ZeroFree C m (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8122    intro p hp
       8123    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8124    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8125    · have := hm p.2; constructor <;> omega
       8126    · subst h; show m H < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8127    · subst h; show m H < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8128  
       8129  theorem shaped_real_part (C : Chart) (T0 d H : Int) (hH : T0 < H) : RealPart C T0 (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8130    intro p hp ht
       8131    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8132    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8133    · exact h
       8134    · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht; exfalso; omega
       8135    · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht; exfalso; omega
       8136  
       8137  theorem shaped_finitely_off (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : FinitelyOff C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8138    refine ⟨[(C.W - d, H), (C.W + d, H)], fun p hp hoff => ?_⟩
       8139    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8140    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8141    · exact absurd h hoff
       8142    · subst h; exact List.Mem.head _
       8143    · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)
       8144  
       8145  theorem shaped_lacks_value (C : Chart) (d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) : ¬ Value C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8146    intro hv
       8147    have h2 : C.W - d = C.W := hv (C.W - d, H) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8148    omega
       8149  
       8150  /-- THE ARROW SIDE TEST. Every ζ-specific fact placed on the arrow (ends, zero-free region, real part to T0,
       8151      finitely many off the line) holds on a world with a mirrored pair off the line above T0, so together they do
       8152      not force the value. -/
       8153  theorem arrow_side_test (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (hm : ∀ t, m t < C.W) (T0 d H : Int)
       8154      (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) (hH : T0 < H) (hmH : m H < C.W - d) :
       8155      Closed C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ZeroFree C m (zetaShaped C d H) ∧
       8156      RealPart C T0 (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ¬ Value C (zetaShaped C d H) :=
       8157    ⟨shaped_closed C d H, shaped_ends C d H hd hdW, shaped_zero_free C m hm d H hmH hd,
       8158     shaped_real_part C T0 d H hH, shaped_finitely_off C d H, shaped_lacks_value C d H hd⟩
       8159  
       8160  /-- THE FACTS ARE ζ-SPECIFIC AT THE ENDS: a zero beyond the head, the Davenport–Heilbronn shape, breaks ENDS. -/
       8161  theorem beyond_the_head_breaks_ends (C : Chart) (x t : Int) (hx : 2 * C.W ≤ x) :
       8162      ¬ ArrowEnds C (fun p => p = (x, t)) := by
       8163    intro h
       8164    have h2 : x < 2 * C.W := (h (x, t) rfl).2
       8165    omega
       8166  
       8167  /-- AT ζ'S OWN NUMBERS: resolution W = 4, so x = 8·Re s; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 (x = 2 and 6); the
       8168      zero-free margin below one unit of 1/8 at every height where zeros occur (c/log t < 0.07 for t ≥ 14); the real
       8169      part to chart height T0 = 3·10¹² − 1, every zero with Im s < 3·10¹²; the pair two units of height above it. -/
       8170  def zetaChart : Chart := ⟨4, by decide⟩
       8171  theorem at_zetas_numbers :
       8172      Closed zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8173      ArrowEnds zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8174      ZeroFree zetaChart (fun _ => 0) (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8175      RealPart zetaChart 2999999999999 (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8176      FinitelyOff zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8177      ¬ Value zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) :=
       8178    arrow_side_test zetaChart (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 4 by decide) 2999999999999 2 3000000000001
       8179      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
       8180  
       8181  /-! ## The faithful model: the facts of ζ with its two symmetries and its empty low band -/
       8182  
       8183  /-- Conjugate symmetry: the zero set is closed under t ↦ −t. -/
       8184  def ConjClosed (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (p.1, -p.2)
       8185  /-- No zero below height 14 in absolute value: ζ's first zero lies at height 14.13… [cited]; heights read by their
       8186      integer part, chart height 14 holds Im s in [14, 15). -/
       8187  def NoLowZeros (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → 14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14
       8188  /-- The verification in both half-planes: every zero at chart height |t| ≤ T0 is on the line; at T0 = 3·10¹² − 1,
       8189      every zero with |Im s| < 3·10¹² [Platt–Trudgian, cited]. -/
       8190  def RealPartAbs (C : Chart) (T0 : Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.2 ≤ T0 → -T0 ≤ p.2 → onLine C p
       8191  /-- The zero-free margin, in units of 1/(2W): the whole width below |t| = 14, where ζ has no zero, and no unit at
       8192      every height |t| ≥ 14. At every width it holds of ζ's reading, since it adds nothing to the ends there and the
       8193      reader's rule keeps every zero of the open strip inside the open chart strip; at the widths W ≤ 7 it is the
       8194      region at full strength, since c/log t < 0.07 < 1/(2W). `faithful_every_margin` carries the region at every
       8195      width, one unit short for the rounding. -/
       8196  def margin14 (C : Chart) : Int → Int := fun t => if 14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14 then 0 else C.W
       8197  /-- The faithful ζ-shaped world: a zero on the line at every height |t| ≥ 14, and one mirrored pair at offset d at
       8198      heights H and −H. -/
       8199  def zetaFaithful (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Pt → Prop := fun p =>
       8200    (p.1 = C.W ∧ (14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14)) ∨ p = (C.W - d, H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, H) ∨
       8201      p = (C.W - d, -H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, -H)
       8202  
       8203  theorem faithful_arrow_side_test (C : Chart) (T0 d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) (hH : T0 < H)
       8204      (h14 : 14 ≤ H) :
       8205      Closed C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ConjClosed (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8206      ZeroFree C (margin14 C) (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8207      RealPartAbs C T0 (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8208      ¬ Value C (zetaFaithful C d H) := by
       8209    have hW := C.hW
       8210    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
       8211    · intro p hp
       8212      unfold zetaFaithful at hp ⊢
       8213      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8214      · left; exact ⟨show 2 * C.W - p.1 = C.W by omega, h2⟩
       8215      · subst h; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8216      · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8217      · subst h; right; right; right; right; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8218      · subst h; right; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8219    · intro p hp
       8220      unfold zetaFaithful at hp ⊢
       8221      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8222      · left; exact ⟨h1, show 14 ≤ -p.2 ∨ -p.2 ≤ -14 by omega⟩
       8223      · subst h; right; right; right; left; rfl
       8224      · subst h; right; right; right; right; rfl
       8225      · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext rfl (show -(-H) = H by omega)
       8226      · subst h; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext rfl (show -(-H) = H by omega)
       8227    · intro p hp
       8228      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8229      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8230      · constructor <;> omega
       8231      all_goals (subst h; constructor <;> (show (_ : Int) < _; omega))
       8232    · intro p hp
       8233      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8234      unfold margin14
       8235      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8236      · rw [if_pos h2]; constructor <;> omega
       8237      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inl h14)]; show (0 : Int) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8238      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inl h14)]; show (0 : Int) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8239      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega))]
       8240        show (0 : Int) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8241      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega))]
       8242        show (0 : Int) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8243    · intro p hp
       8244      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8245      rcases hp with ⟨_, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8246      · exact h2
       8247      · subst h; exact Or.inl h14
       8248      · subst h; exact Or.inl h14
       8249      · subst h; exact Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega)
       8250      · subst h; exact Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega)
       8251    · intro p hp ht1 ht2
       8252      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8253      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8254      · exact h1
       8255      · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht1; exfalso; omega
       8256      · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht1; exfalso; omega
       8257      · subst h; have : -T0 ≤ -H := ht2; exfalso; omega
       8258      · subst h; have : -T0 ≤ -H := ht2; exfalso; omega
       8259    · refine ⟨[(C.W - d, H), (C.W + d, H), (C.W - d, -H), (C.W + d, -H)], fun p hp hoff => ?_⟩
       8260      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8261      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8262      · exact absurd h1 hoff
       8263      · subst h; exact List.Mem.head _
       8264      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)
       8265      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _))
       8266      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)))
       8267    · intro hv
       8268      have h2 : C.W - d = C.W := hv (C.W - d, H) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8269      omega
       8270  
       8271  /-- AT ζ'S OWN NUMBERS, FAITHFULLY: W = 4, so x = 8·Re s; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 and
       8272      its conjugate at −(3·10¹² + 1); the line occupied at every |t| ≥ 14; the verification, every zero with
       8273      |Im s| < 3·10¹², at chart height 3·10¹² − 1 in both half-planes. -/
       8274  theorem at_zetas_numbers_faithful :
       8275      Closed zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8276      ConjClosed (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8277      ArrowEnds zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8278      ZeroFree zetaChart (margin14 zetaChart) (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8279      NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8280      RealPartAbs zetaChart 2999999999999 (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8281      FinitelyOff zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8282      ¬ Value zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) :=
       8283    faithful_arrow_side_test zetaChart 2999999999999 2 3000000000001 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
       8284  
       8285  /-- THE FAITHFUL MODEL UNDER EVERY ZERO-FREE MARGIN: at every chart width and for every margin that, at the heights
       8286      where zeros occur, stays short of the line and leaves the off-line quadruple outside it at ±H, the facts hold on
       8287      the faithful world and the value fails. ζ's known region, c/log|t| in Re s with c/log 14 < 0.07 and
       8288      c/log(3·10¹²) < 0.0065, read in units of 1/(2W), is such a margin at every width for the pair at Re s = 1/4 and
       8289      3/4 [Mossinghoff–Trudgian 2015, cited]. -/
       8290  theorem faithful_every_margin (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (T0 d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W)
       8291      (hH : T0 < H) (h14 : 14 ≤ H) (hm : ∀ t, (14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14) → m t < C.W)
       8292      (hmH : m H < C.W - d) (hmH' : m (-H) < C.W - d) :
       8293      Closed C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ConjClosed (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8294      ZeroFree C m (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8295      RealPartAbs C T0 (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8296      ¬ Value C (zetaFaithful C d H) := by
       8297    have base := faithful_arrow_side_test C T0 d H hd hdW hH h14
       8298    refine ⟨base.1, base.2.1, base.2.2.1, ?_, base.2.2.2.2.1, base.2.2.2.2.2.1, base.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
       8299      base.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
       8300    intro p hp
       8301    unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8302    rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8303    · have := hm p.2 h2; constructor <;> omega
       8304    · subst h; show m H < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8305    · subst h; show m H < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8306    · subst h; show m (-H) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m (-H); constructor <;> omega
       8307    · subst h; show m (-H) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m (-H); constructor <;> omega
       8308  
       8309  /-- AT WIDTH ONE THE ENDS ARE THE VALUE: the open strip holds only the line, so the placed ends force the value there,
       8310      as at the first edition's resolution one; the faithful model needs a width of at least two. -/
       8311  theorem at_width_one_the_ends_are_the_value (S : Pt → Prop) :
       8312      ArrowEnds ⟨1, by decide⟩ S ↔ Value ⟨1, by decide⟩ S := by
       8313    constructor
       8314    · intro h p hp
       8315      have := h p hp
       8316      show p.1 = 1
       8317      have h1 : 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * 1 := this
       8318      omega
       8319    · intro h p hp
       8320      have h1 : p.1 = 1 := h p hp
       8321      show 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * 1
       8322      omega
       8323  
       8324  /-- AN OFF-LINE ZERO COMES IN FOUR: in a world closed under the reflection and under conjugation, with no zero below
       8325      height 14, a zero off the line brings its mirror, its conjugate and its conjugate's mirror, four distinct points:
       8326      one mirrored pair and its conjugate. -/
       8327  theorem an_off_line_zero_comes_in_four (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) (hc : Closed C S) (hk : ConjClosed S)
       8328      (hl : NoLowZeros S) (p : Pt) (hp : S p) (hoff : ¬ onLine C p) :
       8329      S (fold C p) ∧ S (p.1, -p.2) ∧ S (fold C (p.1, -p.2)) ∧
       8330      fold C p ≠ p ∧ (p.1, -p.2) ≠ p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ p ∧
       8331      (p.1, -p.2) ≠ fold C p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ fold C p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ (p.1, -p.2) := by
       8332    have h14 := hl p hp
       8333    refine ⟨hc p hp, hk p hp, hc _ (hk p hp), ?_⟩
       8334    obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := p
       8335    have hx : x ≠ C.W := hoff
       8336    have ht : 14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14 := h14
       8337    refine ⟨fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
       8338    · have h1 : 2 * C.W - x = x := congrArg Prod.fst e
       8339      omega
       8340    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8341      omega
       8342    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8343      omega
       8344    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8345      omega
       8346    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8347      omega
       8348    · have h1 : 2 * C.W - x = x := congrArg Prod.fst e
       8349      omega
       8350  
       8351  end ArrowSide
       8352  
       8353  
       8354  end PartV
       8355  
       8356  /-! # PART V-b · the charts are one -/
       8357  section PartVb
       8358  /-
       8359    THE CHARTS ARE ONE. The seed reads the critical line on five charts: Part II's at x = 2n·Re s for every resolution n
       8360    (x = 2·Re s at resolution one, x = 4·Re s at resolution two), heights in ℕ; Part IV's at x = 4·Re s; Part IV-c's at
       8361    x = 2·Re s, heights in ℤ; Part V's at x = 2W·Re s for every width W; and the offset chart of Parts III and IV-b,
       8362    d = 2n·Re s − n at resolution n, whose line d = 0 and fold d ↦ −d are the same at every resolution. Each maps into
       8363    the offset chart at a definite resolution by an equivariant map, one that carries the chart's fold to the offset
       8364    fold and the chart's line to the offset line: the maps of Parts II at resolutions one and two, IV, IV-c and V at
       8365    width four land at resolution four, where one real part read on any of them lands at one offset point; the maps
       8366    at resolution n and width W land at resolution n and W. Every map keeps the chart's height and scales the offset
       8367    from the line by a positive factor; the maps out of the charts with heights in ℤ commute with conjugation, and
       8368    the first edition's chart reads the upper half-plane. Transport carries
       8369    reflection-closure and the value across. Every act type of the seed is an act of the offset chart at the image of
       8370    its zero set; the root read at the zeros on Part II's chart is the root read twice at the image; both constructed
       8371    roots, Part I's and Part II's, feed the closing theorems. The zero set of ζ is read on the offset chart at every
       8372    resolution by the reader's rule, and the act supplies least erasure at every resolution.
       8373  -/
       8374  set_option autoImplicit false
       8375  namespace Charts
       8376  
       8377  /-- The image of a configuration under a chart map into the offset chart. -/
       8378  def img {α : Type} (φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point) (S : α → Prop) : RememberedOffered.Config :=
       8379    fun q => ∃ p, S p ∧ φ p = q
       8380  
       8381  /-- A chart map is equivariant when it carries the chart's fold to the offset fold and the chart's line to the
       8382      offset line. -/
       8383  structure Equivariant {α : Type} (fold : α → α) (onLine : α → Prop) (φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point) : Prop where
       8384    comm : ∀ p, φ (fold p) = RememberedOffered.fold (φ p)
       8385    line : ∀ p, RememberedOffered.onLine (φ p) ↔ onLine p
       8386  
       8387  /-- TRANSPORT: an equivariant map carries reflection-closure across, and the value both ways. -/
       8388  theorem transport {α : Type} {fold : α → α} {onLine : α → Prop} {φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point}
       8389      (E : Equivariant fold onLine φ) (S : α → Prop) :
       8390      ((∀ p, S p → S (fold p)) → RememberedOffered.Closed (img φ S)) ∧
       8391      ((∀ p, S p → onLine p) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φ S)) := by
       8392    refine ⟨fun hS q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ => ⟨fold p, hS p hp, by rw [E.comm, e]⟩,
       8393      ⟨fun hv q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ => ?_, fun hv p hp => (E.line p).mp (hv _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)⟩⟩
       8394    rw [← e]; exact (E.line p).mpr (hv p hp)
       8395  
       8396  /-- Part IV's chart, x = 4·Re s, into the offset chart d = 8·Re s − 4. -/
       8397  def φH (p : Hinge.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (2 * p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8398  /-- Part V's chart at ζ's resolution, x = 8·Re s, into the offset chart. -/
       8399  def φA (p : ArrowSide.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8400  /-- Part II's chart, x = 2·Re s with heights in ℕ, into the offset chart. -/
       8401  def φP (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (4 * z.x - 4, (z.t : Int))
       8402  /-- Part II's chart at resolution two, x = 4·Re s, into the offset chart. -/
       8403  def φP₂ (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (2 * z.x - 4, (z.t : Int))
       8404  /-- Part V's chart at every width W, x = 2W·Re s, into the offset chart at resolution W: d = x − W. -/
       8405  def φW (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (p.1 - C.W, p.2)
       8406  /-- Part II's chart at every resolution n, x = 2n·Re s with heights in ℕ, into the offset chart at resolution n. -/
       8407  def φPn (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (z.x - n, (z.t : Int))
       8408  /-- Part IV-c's chart, x = 2·Re s with heights in ℤ, into the offset chart. -/
       8409  def φT (p : Int × Int) : RememberedOffered.Point := (4 * p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8410  /-- Part IV-b's chart is the offset chart: the identity. -/
       8411  def φF (p : ForceWitness.Point) : RememberedOffered.Point := p
       8412  
       8413  theorem eqH : Equivariant Hinge.fold Hinge.onLine φH :=
       8414    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * (0 + 4 - p.1) - 4 = -(2 * p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8415     fun p => show 2 * p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 2 by omega⟩
       8416  theorem eqA : Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold ArrowSide.zetaChart) (ArrowSide.onLine ArrowSide.zetaChart) φA :=
       8417    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * 4 - p.1 - 4 = -(p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8418     fun p => show p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 4 by omega⟩
       8419  theorem eqP : Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold PrimeFreedom.onLine φP :=
       8420    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 4 * (2 - z.x) - 4 = -(4 * z.x - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8421     fun z => show 4 * z.x - 4 = 0 ↔ z.x = 1 by omega⟩
       8422  theorem eqP₂ : Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold₂ PrimeFreedom.onLine₂ φP₂ :=
       8423    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * (4 - z.x) - 4 = -(2 * z.x - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8424     fun z => show 2 * z.x - 4 = 0 ↔ z.x = 2 by omega⟩
       8425  theorem eqW (C : ArrowSide.Chart) : Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold C) (ArrowSide.onLine C) (φW C) :=
       8426    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - p.1 - C.W = -(p.1 - C.W) by omega) rfl,
       8427     fun p => show p.1 - C.W = 0 ↔ p.1 = C.W by omega⟩
       8428  theorem eqPn (n : Int) : Equivariant (PrimeFreedom.foldAt n) (fun z => z.x = n) (φPn n) :=
       8429    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * n - z.x - n = -(z.x - n) by omega) rfl,
       8430     fun z => show z.x - n = 0 ↔ z.x = n by omega⟩
       8431  theorem eqT : Equivariant TimeLocus.sigmaGeo TimeLocus.onLine φT :=
       8432    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 4 * (2 - p.1) - 4 = -(4 * p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8433     fun p => show 4 * p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 1 by omega⟩
       8434  theorem eqF : Equivariant ForceWitness.fold ForceWitness.onLine φF :=
       8435    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
       8436  
       8437  /-- EVERY MAP KEEPS HEIGHT AND SCALES THE OFFSET from the line by a positive factor. -/
       8438  theorem the_maps_keep_height_and_scale :
       8439      (∀ p : Hinge.Pt, φH p = (2 * (p.1 - 2), p.2)) ∧
       8440      (∀ p : ArrowSide.Pt, φA p = (1 * (p.1 - 4), p.2)) ∧
       8441      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt), φW C p = (1 * (p.1 - C.W), p.2)) ∧
       8442      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP z = (4 * (z.x - 1), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8443      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP₂ z = (2 * (z.x - 2), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8444      (∀ (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt), φPn n z = (1 * (z.x - n), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8445      (∀ p : Int × Int, φT p = (4 * (p.1 - 1), p.2)) ∧
       8446      (∀ p : ForceWitness.Point, φF p = (1 * (p.1 - 0), p.2)) :=
       8447    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * p.1 - 4 = 2 * (p.1 - 2) by omega) rfl,
       8448     fun p => Prod.ext (show p.1 - 4 = 1 * (p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8449     fun C p => Prod.ext (show p.1 - C.W = 1 * (p.1 - C.W) by omega) rfl,
       8450     fun z => Prod.ext (show 4 * z.x - 4 = 4 * (z.x - 1) by omega) rfl,
       8451     fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * z.x - 4 = 2 * (z.x - 2) by omega) rfl,
       8452     fun n z => Prod.ext (show z.x - n = 1 * (z.x - n) by omega) rfl,
       8453     fun p => Prod.ext (show 4 * p.1 - 4 = 4 * (p.1 - 1) by omega) rfl,
       8454     fun p => Prod.ext (show p.1 = 1 * (p.1 - 0) by omega) rfl⟩
       8455  
       8456  /-- The first edition's act, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8457  def actP (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8458    ⟨img φP A.zeros, (transport eqP A.zeros).1 A.fold_closed,
       8459     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport eqP A.zeros).2.mp (PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act A))⟩
       8460  
       8461  /-- The first edition's act at every resolution n, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8462  def actPn (n : Int) (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZerosAt n) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8463    ⟨img (φPn n) A.zeros, (transport (eqPn n) A.zeros).1 A.closed,
       8464     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport (eqPn n) A.zeros).2.mp
       8465       (fun z hz => (PrimeFreedom.foldAt_fixed_iff n z).mp (PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act_at n A z hz)))⟩
       8466  /-- Part IV's act, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8467  def actH (A : Hinge.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8468    ⟨img φH A.zeros, (transport eqH A.zeros).1 A.closed,
       8469     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport eqH A.zeros).2.mp (Hinge.value_from_the_act A))⟩
       8470  /-- Part IV-b's act is an act of the offset chart as it stands. -/
       8471  def actF (A : ForceWitness.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros := ⟨A.zeros, A.closed, A.supply⟩
       8472  
       8473  /-- The constructed root of Part I, as the root the closing theorems of Part III take. -/
       8474  def rootOf {R : Prop} (G : TOE0.SelfGrounding R) : RememberedOffered.SelfGrounding R := ⟨G.Act, G.anAct, G.instances⟩
       8475  /-- Part II's self-grounding root, as the root the closing theorems of Part III take. -/
       8476  def rootP {R : Prop} (G : PrimeFreedom.SelfGrounding R) : RememberedOffered.SelfGrounding R :=
       8477    ⟨G.Act, G.anAct, G.instances⟩
       8478  
       8479  /-- THE CHARTS ARE ONE. Every plane chart of the seed maps equivariantly into the offset chart, at every resolution and every
       8480      width; the value of a configuration is the value of its image on every chart; every act type of the seed is an act
       8481      of the offset chart at the image of its zero set; the root read at the zeros on Part II's chart is the root read
       8482      twice at the image; and both constructed roots feed the closing theorems of Part III: Part I's forces no value,
       8483      and the deed of either is the supply at a zero set exactly where the value holds. -/
       8484  theorem the_charts_are_one :
       8485      Equivariant Hinge.fold Hinge.onLine φH ∧
       8486      Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold ArrowSide.zetaChart) (ArrowSide.onLine ArrowSide.zetaChart) φA ∧
       8487      Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold PrimeFreedom.onLine φP ∧
       8488      Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold₂ PrimeFreedom.onLine₂ φP₂ ∧
       8489      (∀ S : Hinge.Pt → Prop, Hinge.Value S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φH S)) ∧
       8490      (∀ S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop, ArrowSide.Value ArrowSide.zetaChart S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φA S)) ∧
       8491      (∀ Z : PrimeFreedom.World, PrimeFreedom.RH Z ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φP Z)) ∧
       8492      (∀ A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img φP A.zeros) ∧
       8493      (∀ Z : PrimeFreedom.World, PrimeFreedom.RootAtZeros Z ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (img φP Z)) ∧
       8494      (¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S → TOE0.RA₀ → RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
       8495      (∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
       8496        ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S)) ∧
       8497      (∀ C : ArrowSide.Chart, Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold C) (ArrowSide.onLine C) (φW C)) ∧
       8498      (∀ n : Int, Equivariant (PrimeFreedom.foldAt n) (fun z => z.x = n) (φPn n)) ∧
       8499      Equivariant TimeLocus.sigmaGeo TimeLocus.onLine φT ∧
       8500      Equivariant ForceWitness.fold ForceWitness.onLine φF ∧
       8501      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop),
       8502        ArrowSide.Value C S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img (φW C) S)) ∧
       8503      (∀ (n : Int) (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZerosAt n),
       8504        ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img (φPn n) A.zeros) ∧
       8505      (∀ A : Hinge.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img φH A.zeros) ∧
       8506      (∀ A : ForceWitness.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = A.zeros) ∧
       8507      (∀ (R : Prop) (G : PrimeFreedom.SelfGrounding R) (S : RememberedOffered.Config), RememberedOffered.Closed S →
       8508        (((rootP G).Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S)) :=
       8509    ⟨eqH, eqA, eqP, eqP₂,
       8510     fun S => (transport eqH S).2, fun S => (transport eqA S).2, fun Z => (transport eqP Z).2,
       8511     fun A => ⟨actP A, rfl⟩,
       8512     fun Z => ((PrimeFreedom.root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).trans (transport eqP Z).2).trans
       8513       (RememberedOffered.the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _).symm,
       8514     RememberedOffered.the_floor_alone_decides_no_value (rootOf TOE0.ra₀),
       8515     fun S hS => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) S hS).1,
       8516     eqW, eqPn, eqT, eqF, fun C S => (transport (eqW C) S).2,
       8517     fun n A => ⟨actPn n A, rfl⟩, fun A => ⟨actH A, rfl⟩, fun A => ⟨actF A, rfl⟩,
       8518     fun _ G S hS => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootP G) S hS).1⟩
       8519  
       8520  /-- The model pair of the zero side: Re s = 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 on the offset chart at resolution four (d = 2),
       8521      with its mirror at Re s = 1/4 (d = −2). -/
       8522  def thePair : RememberedOffered.Point := (2, 3000000000001)
       8523  
       8524  /-- THE ONE PAIR, READ BY EVERY INSTRUMENT, on the charts that hold it. On the offset chart it is closed, off the line, of one
       8525      record with its registered point, without the root read twice, and every report of it reads no act; its preimage
       8526      on Part IV's chart is centred on the line; its preimage on Part V's chart lies in the faithful ζ-shaped world,
       8527      which satisfies every fact of ζ placed on the arrow. -/
       8528  theorem the_pair_read_by_every_instrument :
       8529      RememberedOffered.Closed (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8530      ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8531      RememberedOffered.SameRecord (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8532      ¬ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8533      (¬ ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, ∀ p ∈ [thePair, RememberedOffered.fold thePair], Z.zeros p) ∧
       8534      (φH (3, 3000000000001) = thePair ∧ φH (1, 3000000000001) = RememberedOffered.fold thePair ∧
       8535        Hinge.sumX [(1, 3000000000001), (3, 3000000000001)] = 2 * 2) ∧
       8536      (φA (6, 3000000000001) = thePair ∧ φA (2, 3000000000001) = RememberedOffered.fold thePair ∧
       8537        ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001 (6, 3000000000001) ∧
       8538        ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001 (2, 3000000000001)) := by
       8539    have off : ¬ RememberedOffered.onLine thePair := fun h => by
       8540      have h2 : (2 : Int) = 0 := h
       8541      exact absurd h2 (by decide)
       8542    have nv := RememberedOffered.pair_world_lacks_value thePair off
       8543    refine ⟨RememberedOffered.pair_world_closed thePair, nv, RememberedOffered.one_record thePair,
       8544      RememberedOffered.the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice _ nv,
       8545      (RememberedOffered.row_four_from_the_zero_side (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)).2.1
       8546        [thePair, RememberedOffered.fold thePair] ⟨thePair, List.Mem.head _, off⟩,
       8547      ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
       8548    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8549    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8550  
       8551  /-- THE BLOCKS AT THE MODEL PAIR: at the pair at height 3·10¹² + 1, which every fact of ζ placed on the arrow admits,
       8552      the registered world and the pair world leave one record; both readings of the halt hold on the first and fail on
       8553      the second; no reading of the record decides the value; every deed is the supply at the first and not at the
       8554      second; and the loop closes on the first and does not close on the second. -/
       8555  theorem the_blocks_at_the_one_pair :
       8556      RememberedOffered.SameRecord (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8557      (RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ∧
       8558        RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8559      (¬ RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8560        ¬ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)) ∧
       8561      (∀ g : RememberedOffered.Config → Prop,
       8562        (∀ S S', RememberedOffered.SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) →
       8563        ¬ ((g (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ↔
       8564              RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8565           (g (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ↔
       8566              RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)))) ∧
       8567      ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ∧
       8568        ¬ (TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)) ∧
       8569      ((TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8570        ¬ (TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair))) := by
       8571    have off : ¬ RememberedOffered.onLine thePair := fun h => by
       8572      have h2 : (2 : Int) = 0 := h
       8573      exact absurd h2 (by decide)
       8574    have nv := RememberedOffered.pair_world_lacks_value thePair off
       8575    have rv := RememberedOffered.registered_has_value thePair
       8576    have pc := RememberedOffered.pair_world_closed thePair
       8577    have rc : RememberedOffered.Closed (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) := fun s hs => by
       8578      rw [hs]
       8579      show RememberedOffered.fold (RememberedOffered.reg thePair) = RememberedOffered.reg thePair
       8580      rfl
       8581    have zr : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed T →
       8582        (RememberedOffered.ZeroReports T ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8583      fun T hT => (RememberedOffered.row_four_from_the_zero_side T).2.2.2 hT
       8584    have la : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed T →
       8585        ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = T) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8586      fun T hT => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) T hT).1
       8587    have lp : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config,
       8588        ((TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice T) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8589      fun T => (RememberedOffered.the_loop (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) T).2.2.2.2.1
       8590    exact ⟨RememberedOffered.one_record thePair,
       8591      ⟨(zr _ rc).mpr rv, (RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ rc).mpr rv⟩,
       8592      ⟨fun h => nv ((zr _ pc).mp h), fun h => nv ((RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ pc).mp h)⟩,
       8593      fun g hg ⟨h1, h2⟩ => nv (h2.mp ((hg _ _ (RememberedOffered.one_record thePair)).mp (h1.mpr rv))),
       8594      ⟨(la _ rc).mpr rv, fun h => nv ((la _ pc).mp h)⟩,
       8595      ⟨(lp _).mpr rv, fun h => nv ((lp _).mp h)⟩⟩
       8596  
       8597  /-- THE VERIFIED PART TRANSPORTS: at every width, the verification in both half-planes on Part V's chart is the
       8598      verified part on the offset chart with the height in absolute value. -/
       8599  theorem the_verified_part_transports (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (T : Nat) (S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop) :
       8600      ArrowSide.RealPartAbs C (T : Int) S ↔
       8601        RHUnicorn.RealPartAt (img (φW C) S) RememberedOffered.onLine RememberedOffered.htAbs T := by
       8602    constructor
       8603    · intro h q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ hq
       8604      subst e
       8605      have hq' : (p.2).natAbs ≤ T := hq
       8606      have h1 : p.1 = C.W := h p hp (by omega) (by omega)
       8607      show p.1 - C.W = 0
       8608      omega
       8609    · intro h p hp h1 h2
       8610      have h3 : p.1 - C.W = 0 := h (φW C p) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ (show (p.2).natAbs ≤ T by omega)
       8611      show p.1 = C.W
       8612      omega
       8613  
       8614  /-- THE FAITHFUL MODEL ON THE OFFSET CHART: its image carries the verified part at chart height 3·10¹² − 1, every zero
       8615      with |Im s| < 3·10¹², and lacks the value. -/
       8616  theorem the_faithful_model_on_the_offset_chart :
       8617      RHUnicorn.RealPartAt (img φA (ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001))
       8618        RememberedOffered.onLine RememberedOffered.htAbs 2999999999999 ∧
       8619      ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (img φA (ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001)) :=
       8620    ⟨(the_verified_part_transports ArrowSide.zetaChart 2999999999999 _).mp
       8621        ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers_faithful.2.2.2.2.2.1,
       8622     fun v => ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers_faithful.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ((transport eqA _).2.mpr v)⟩
       8623  
       8624  /-- ONE REAL PART, ONE OFFSET POINT, AT RESOLUTION FOUR: a real part a/4 read on Part IV's chart, on Part V's chart at
       8625      width four, on Part II's chart at resolution two, and a real part a/2 read on Part II's chart at resolution one
       8626      and on Part IV-c's chart, land at one point of the offset chart at resolution four. -/
       8627  theorem the_maps_agree_at_resolution_four :
       8628      (∀ a t : Int, φH (a, t) = φA (2 * a, t) ∧ φA (2 * a, t) = φW ArrowSide.zetaChart (2 * a, t)) ∧
       8629      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP₂ z = φH (z.x, (z.t : Int)) ∧ φP z = φH (2 * z.x, (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8630      (∀ x t : Int, φT (x, t) = φH (2 * x, t)) :=
       8631    ⟨fun a t => ⟨Prod.ext (show 2 * a - 4 = 2 * a - 4 from rfl) rfl, rfl⟩,
       8632     fun z => ⟨rfl, Prod.ext (show 4 * z.x - 4 = 2 * (2 * z.x) - 4 by omega) rfl⟩,
       8633     fun x t => Prod.ext (show 4 * x - 4 = 2 * (2 * x) - 4 by omega) rfl⟩
       8634  
       8635  /-- Conjugation on a chart with heights in ℤ. -/
       8636  def conj (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (p.1, -p.2)
       8637  /-- THE MAPS COMMUTE WITH CONJUGATION on every chart with heights in ℤ; the first edition's chart, with heights in ℕ,
       8638      reads the upper half-plane, and its maps reach only heights at or above zero. -/
       8639  theorem the_maps_commute_with_conjugation :
       8640      (∀ p : Hinge.Pt, φH (conj p) = conj (φH p)) ∧ (∀ p : ArrowSide.Pt, φA (conj p) = conj (φA p)) ∧
       8641      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt), φW C (conj p) = conj (φW C p)) ∧
       8642      (∀ p : Int × Int, φT (conj p) = conj (φT p)) ∧ (∀ p : ForceWitness.Point, φF (conj p) = conj (φF p)) ∧
       8643      (∀ (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt), 0 ≤ (φPn n z).2) ∧ (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, 0 ≤ (φP z).2) ∧
       8644      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, 0 ≤ (φP₂ z).2) :=
       8645    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl,
       8646     fun _ z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t, fun z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t, fun z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t⟩
       8647  
       8648  /-! ## The reading at every resolution -/
       8649  
       8650  /-- The open chart strip at resolution n: a reading inside the open strip 0 < Re s < 1 is kept at 1 ≤ x ≤ 2n − 1. -/
       8651  def clampStrip (n x : Int) : Int := max 1 (min (2 * n - 1) x)
       8652  /-- THE CLAMP KEEPS THE OPEN STRIP, COMMUTES WITH THE FOLD, AND KEEPS THE SIDE: at every resolution n ≥ 1 the clamped
       8653      reading lies in the open chart strip; the clamp commutes with x ↦ 2n − x; and at every resolution n ≥ 2 it lands
       8654      on the line exactly when the rounded reading does. -/
       8655  theorem the_clamp_keeps_strip_fold_and_side :
       8656      (∀ n x : Int, 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ clampStrip n x ∧ clampStrip n x ≤ 2 * n - 1) ∧
       8657      (∀ n x : Int, 1 ≤ n → clampStrip n (2 * n - x) = 2 * n - clampStrip n x) ∧
       8658      (∀ n x : Int, 2 ≤ n → (clampStrip n x = n ↔ x = n)) :=
       8659    ⟨fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega, fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega,
       8660     fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega⟩
       8661  
       8662  /-- Rounding half to even of a / b, for b > 0. -/
       8663  def roundHalfEven (a b : Int) : Int :=
       8664    let q := a / b
       8665    let r := a % b
       8666    if 2 * r < b then q else if 2 * r > b then q + 1 else if q % 2 = 0 then q else q + 1
       8667  /-- THE READER'S RULE on the offset chart at resolution n ≥ 1: a real part σ = a / b of the open strip is read at
       8668      x = round(2n·σ), rounded half to even and kept in the open chart strip, and at d = x − n. -/
       8669  def readAt (n : Nat) (a b : Int) : Int := clampStrip n (roundHalfEven (2 * n * a) b) - n
       8670  
       8671  /-- ONE RESOLUTION IS NOT ENOUGH: a zero at Re s = 51/100 and its mirror at 49/100 read onto the line at resolution
       8672      four and off it at resolution fifty; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 reads at d = ∓2 at resolution four; and a
       8673      zero at Re s = 97/100 or 3/100 is kept off the poles, at d = ±3. -/
       8674  theorem one_resolution_is_not_enough :
       8675      readAt 4 51 100 = 0 ∧ readAt 4 49 100 = 0 ∧ readAt 50 51 100 = 1 ∧ readAt 50 49 100 = -1 ∧
       8676      readAt 4 1 4 = -2 ∧ readAt 4 3 4 = 2 ∧ readAt 4 97 100 = 3 ∧ readAt 4 3 100 = -3 := by decide
       8677  
       8678  /-- A zero at Re s = 51/100 with its mirror at 49/100, at height 3·10¹² + 1, read at resolution n. -/
       8679  def nearWorld (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.Config := fun q =>
       8680    q = (readAt n 51 100, 3000000000001) ∨ q = (readAt n 49 100, 3000000000001)
       8681  
       8682  /-- THE VALUE AT ONE RESOLUTION DOES NOT DECIDE IT AT A FINER ONE: read at resolution four the near pair is closed and
       8683      has the value; read at resolution fifty it is closed and lacks it. -/
       8684  theorem one_resolution_does_not_decide_the_next :
       8685      RememberedOffered.Closed (nearWorld 4) ∧ RememberedOffered.Value (nearWorld 4) ∧
       8686      RememberedOffered.Closed (nearWorld 50) ∧ ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (nearWorld 50) := by
       8687    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4, _, _, _, _⟩ := one_resolution_is_not_enough
       8688    refine ⟨fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun v => ?_⟩
       8689    · unfold nearWorld at hq ⊢
       8690      rw [e1, e2] at hq ⊢
       8691      rcases hq with h | h <;> (subst h; exact Or.inl (by decide))
       8692    · unfold nearWorld at hq
       8693      rw [e1, e2] at hq
       8694      rcases hq with h | h <;> (subst h; rfl)
       8695    · unfold nearWorld at hq ⊢
       8696      rw [e3, e4] at hq ⊢
       8697      rcases hq with h | h
       8698      · subst h; exact Or.inr (by decide)
       8699      · subst h; exact Or.inl (by decide)
       8700    · have h : (1 : Int) = 0 := v (1, 3000000000001) (by unfold nearWorld; rw [e3]; exact Or.inl rfl)
       8701      exact absurd h (by decide)
       8702  
       8703  /-- THE ACT AT EVERY RESOLUTION: a family of readings of the offset chart, one at each resolution, each closed under
       8704      the fold, with least erasure supplied at every resolution. The zero set of ζ read by the reader's rule at every
       8705      resolution n ≥ 1 is such a family by the reading of the paper's Section 11; resolution zero is no reading, and the
       8706      family's term there is the empty configuration by stipulation. -/
       8707  structure ActualZerosEvery where
       8708    zeros : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config
       8709    closed : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (zeros n)
       8710    supply : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.LeastErasure (zeros n)
       8711  
       8712  /-- The act at every resolution is an act of the offset chart at each one. -/
       8713  def ActualZerosEvery.atRes (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8714    ⟨Z.zeros n, Z.closed n, Z.supply n⟩
       8715  
       8716  /-- THE VALUE AT EVERY RESOLUTION, ON NO AXIOM: on the act at every resolution, every reading has the value. -/
       8717  theorem the_value_at_every_resolution (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.Value (Z.zeros n) :=
       8718    RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n)
       8719  
       8720  /-- THE ACT AT EVERY RESOLUTION, WHOLE: the act stands at the readings exactly where the value holds at every
       8721      resolution; on it, at every resolution, the value, the zero reports and the prime bound hold; every proof of the
       8722      value at every resolution, from any premise, is a supply of the act; the supply is unique; and the atomic proof,
       8723      the atomic necessity and the two-sided halt hold at every resolution. -/
       8724  theorem the_act_at_every_resolution (R : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config)
       8725      (hR : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (R n)) :
       8726      ((∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8727      (∀ (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat), RememberedOffered.Value (Z.zeros n) ∧
       8728        RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (Z.zeros n) ∧ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (Z.zeros n)) ∧
       8729      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) → Q → ∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R) ∧
       8730      (∀ Z₁ Z₂ : ActualZerosEvery, Z₁.zeros = R → Z₂.zeros = R → Z₁ = Z₂) ∧
       8731      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.the_atomic_proof (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) (R n) (hR n))) ∧
       8732      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.the_atomic_necessity (R n) (hR n))) ∧
       8733      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n))) := by
       8734    have mk : (∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) → ∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R := fun v =>
       8735      ⟨⟨R, hR, fun n => (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world (R n)).mpr (v n)⟩, rfl⟩
       8736    refine ⟨⟨fun ⟨Z, hZ⟩ n => by rw [← hZ]; exact RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n), mk⟩,
       8737      fun Z n => ⟨RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n),
       8738        (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction _ (Z.closed n)).2.2.2.2.2 (Z.atRes n)⟩,
       8739      fun _ hQ q => mk (hQ q), ?_,
       8740      fun n => RememberedOffered.the_atomic_proof (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) (R n) (hR n),
       8741      fun n => RememberedOffered.the_atomic_necessity (R n) (hR n),
       8742      fun n => RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)⟩
       8743    intro Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂
       8744    obtain ⟨z₁, c₁, s₁⟩ := Z₁
       8745    obtain ⟨z₂, c₂, s₂⟩ := Z₂
       8746    change z₁ = R at h₁
       8747    change z₂ = R at h₂
       8748    subst h₁
       8749    subst h₂
       8750    rfl
       8751  
       8752  /-- THE PRIME BOUND AT ONE RESOLUTION IS WEAKER: the near pair at Re s = 51/100 meets the prime bound read at
       8753      resolution four and fails it read at resolution fifty; at one resolution n the chart's prime bound reads a zero
       8754      within 1/(4n) of the line onto it. -/
       8755  theorem the_prime_bound_at_one_resolution :
       8756      RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (nearWorld 4) ∧ ¬ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (nearWorld 50) := by
       8757    have h := one_resolution_does_not_decide_the_next
       8758    exact ⟨(RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ h.1).mpr h.2.1,
       8759      fun b => h.2.2.2 ((RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ h.2.2.1).mp b)⟩
       8760  
       8761  /-- THE HALT AT EVERY RESOLUTION: for every family of reflection-closed readings, the zero reports at every resolution,
       8762      the prime bound at every resolution and the value at every resolution are one proposition. The prime bound at
       8763      every resolution together is the chart's image of the cited bound at x^(1/2 + ε). -/
       8764  theorem the_halt_at_every_resolution (R : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config)
       8765      (hR : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (R n)) :
       8766      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8767      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8768      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (R n)) := by
       8769    have z := fun n => (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)).1
       8770    have p := fun n => (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)).2.1
       8771    refine ⟨⟨fun h n => (z n).mp (h n), fun h n => (z n).mpr (h n)⟩,
       8772      ⟨fun h n => (p n).mp (h n), fun h n => (p n).mpr (h n)⟩,
       8773      ⟨fun h n => (p n).mpr ((z n).mp (h n)), fun h n => (z n).mpr ((p n).mp (h n))⟩⟩
       8774  
       8775  end Charts
       8776  
       8777  end PartVb
       8778  
       8779  /-! # PART VI · THE TWO-SIDED CLOSURE -/
       8780  section PartVI
       8781  namespace BothSides
       8782  
       8783  /-- THE TWO-SIDED CLOSURE. One theorem, every capstone of the seed bound by its exact type.
       8784      I    the floor, on no axiom: the root holds for every self-grounding root; the Root Axiom on its constructed
       8785           domain; the master seal of the three axes; the line is the fixed set of conjugation.
       8786      II   the arrow: the only rigid reversal of the two poles; the freedom cut, the line blind to the arrow's sign;
       8787           the hinge at Re s = 1/2; the fold's fixed set is the line.
       8788      III  the prime side: the primes admit every assignment; prime freedom forces nothing; the prime bound halts
       8789           at the value; the ζ-specific facts on the arrow, their test and their reach at the ends.
       8790      IV   the non-trivial-zero side: the zero set's own centre is the line; a centred pair off it; row four read
       8791           from the zeros.
       8792      V    the nine rows: the form; the keyless leg; the blind record; the premise forced, the act, the weakest
       8793           forcing premise; the barred refuter; the terminal saturation; the capstone; the annihilating timeless
       8794           closure and the one; the atomic form forced.
       8795      VI   the termination: the bidirectional halted uniduction; the atomic proof; the last act; least erasure and
       8796           least escape; the loop.
       8797      VII  the run: a run witnesses that it ran and leaves the value free; a run's flag offered as the field at every
       8798           closed configuration is refused; beside the field, the run is witnessed and the value stands on the field.
       8799      VIII the charts are one; the one model pair read by every instrument; the faithful model of ζ's zeros; the hinge
       8800           exists; both values of the bit are atomic.
       8801      IX   further capstones and row mechanisms of Parts II, III, IV, IV-b and IV-c.
       8802      X    every further theorem the body of the paper cites, generated from the body's citations: with I to IX, the
       8803           closure binds every theorem the body cites. -/
       8804  theorem the_two_sided_closure :
       8805      -- I · the floor
       8806      (type_of% @TOE0.the_floor_is_universal) ∧ (type_of% @TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain) ∧
       8807      (type_of% @TOE0.the_master_seal) ∧ (type_of% @TOE0.the_line_is_the_fixed_set) ∧
       8808      -- II · the arrow
       8809      (type_of% @Hinge.the_only_rigid_reversal) ∧ (type_of% @Hinge.hinge_sign_blind) ∧
       8810      (type_of% @Hinge.zeta_hinge) ∧ (type_of% @Hinge.locus) ∧
       8811      -- III · the prime side
       8812      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.primes_admit_every_assignment) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.prime_freedom_forces_nothing) ∧
       8813      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts) ∧ (type_of% @ArrowSide.arrow_side_test) ∧
       8814      (type_of% @ArrowSide.beyond_the_head_breaks_ends) ∧ (type_of% @ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers) ∧
       8815      -- IV · the non-trivial-zero side
       8816      (type_of% @Hinge.centre_is_the_line) ∧ (type_of% @Hinge.centred_yet_off) ∧
       8817      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.row_four_from_the_zero_side) ∧
       8818      -- V · the nine rows
       8819      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.least_erasure_is_the_value) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.keyless_forces_nothing) ∧
       8820      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.record_decides_nothing) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act) ∧
       8821      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.the_tenth_is_barred_by_the_act) ∧
       8822      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.nothing_left_open_on_the_act) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.the_capstone) ∧
       8823      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_annihilation_closure) ∧ (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_one) ∧
       8824      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_atomic_necessity) ∧
       8825      -- VI · the termination
       8826      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction) ∧ (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_atomic_proof) ∧
       8827      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_last_act) ∧ (type_of% @RememberedOffered.least_erasure_and_least_escape) ∧
       8828      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.the_loop) ∧
       8829      -- VII · the run
       8830      (type_of% @ForceWitness.force_witness_closure) ∧ (type_of% @ForceWitness.the_plug_fails) ∧
       8831      (type_of% @ForceWitness.the_plug_delivers) ∧
       8832      -- VIII · the charts, the pair and the faithful model
       8833      (type_of% @Charts.the_charts_are_one) ∧ (type_of% @Charts.the_pair_read_by_every_instrument) ∧
       8834      (type_of% @ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers_faithful) ∧ (type_of% @Hinge.hinge_exists) ∧
       8835      (type_of% @RememberedOffered.both_values_atomic) ∧
       8836      -- IX · every further capstone and row mechanism the paper cites
       8837      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.vocabulary_law) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.the_front) ∧
       8838      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.posit_is_the_value) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.every_face_proves_every_face) ∧
