      10355  
      10356  section Level10ApparatusCargo
      10357  namespace ApparatusCargo
      10358  
      10359  /-! ## core · the carrier, the event, Stage 1 -/
      10360  
      10361  /-- THE APPARATUS CARRIER. Two constructors: a self-conjugate state at a
      10362      height, or a member of a conjugate pair of magnitude m + 1 at a height
      10363      with the sign that tells it from its partner. -/
      10364  inductive PhysicalCarrier where
      10365    | selfConjugate (t : Int)
      10366    | conjugatePair (m : Nat) (t : Int) (sign : Bool)
      10367  
      10368  /-- Annihilation, the physical discard: a member of a pair goes to the neutral
      10369      state at its height; a neutral state stays. The sign is kept nowhere. -/
      10370  def annihilate : PhysicalCarrier → PhysicalCarrier
      10371    | .selfConjugate t => .selfConjugate t
      10372    | .conjugatePair _ t _ => .selfConjugate t
      10373  
      10374  /-- A verification event: the apparatus moves from `before` to `after`,
      10375      and `after` is the annihilation of `before` — one label forgotten. -/
      10376  structure VerificationEvent where
      10377    before : PhysicalCarrier
      10378    after : PhysicalCarrier
      10379    h_forget : after = annihilate before
      10380  
      10381  /-- THE LOCAL COMPUTATION IS A FORGETTING: the event's own field. -/
      10382  theorem local_computation_is_forgetting (e : VerificationEvent) :
      10383      e.after = annihilate e.before :=
      10384    e.h_forget
      10385  
      10386  /-- The physical floor: some state is realized. -/
      10387  def physicalFloor (realized : PhysicalCarrier → Prop) : Prop := ∃ c, realized c
      10388  
      10389  /-- The event witnesses the floor at the state it lands on. -/
      10390  theorem event_witnesses_floor (e : VerificationEvent)
      10391      (realized : PhysicalCarrier → Prop) (h : realized e.after) :
      10392      physicalFloor realized :=
      10393    ⟨e.after, h⟩
      10394  
      10395  /-- STAGE 1: forgetting done, floor witnessed. -/
      10396  structure Stage1 where
      10397    event : VerificationEvent
      10398    forgetting_done : event.after = annihilate event.before
      10399    floor_witnessed : physicalFloor (fun c => c = event.after)
      10400  
      10401  /-- Stage 1 closes on its own fields: forgetting done and floor witnessed. -/
      10402  theorem stage1_closes (s : Stage1) :
      10403      s.event.after = annihilate s.event.before ∧
      10404      physicalFloor (fun c => c = s.event.after) :=
      10405    ⟨s.forgetting_done, s.floor_witnessed⟩
      10406  
      10407  /-- THE COMPUTATION ENACTS STAGE 1: every verification event supplies one. -/
      10408  def computation_enacts_stage1 (e : VerificationEvent) : Stage1 :=
      10409    ⟨e, e.h_forget, ⟨e.after, rfl⟩⟩
      10410  
      10411  /-! ## optional · heat, bound, Stage 2 (corroboration only) -/
      10412  
      10413  /-- Chart point and line, local to this section. -/
      10414  abbrev Point := Int × Int
      10415  
      10416  /-- The line: offset zero. -/
      10417  def onLine (p : Point) : Prop := p.1 = 0
      10418  
      10419  /-- The neutral sector, local to this section. -/
      10420  def Neutral : PhysicalCarrier → Prop
      10421    | .selfConjugate _ => True
      10422    | .conjugatePair _ _ _ => False
      10423  
      10424  /-- The map from a chart point to its carrier, local to this section. -/
      10425  def map_zero_to_carrier : Point → PhysicalCarrier
      10426    | (Int.ofNat 0, t) => .selfConjugate t
      10427    | (Int.ofNat (n + 1), t) => .conjugatePair n t true
      10428    | (Int.negSucc n, t) => .conjugatePair n t false
      10429  
      10430  /-- LANDAUER'S LAW, ENTERED AS A DEFINITION: heat per erased label at
      10431      temperature T, in the kernel's units (ln 2 scaled by 10^6). -/
      10432  def landauerHeatPerEvent (T : Nat) : Nat := T * 693147
      10433  
      10434  /-- The detection gap: δ = n₀ · r₀ · (T₀ · ln 2). -/
      10435  def detectionGap (n0 r0 T0 : Nat) : Nat := n0 * r0 * landauerHeatPerEvent T0
      10436  
      10437  /-- A CERTIFIED OBSERVATIONAL BOUND: the residual observable R, the
      10438      sensitivity ε, the certificate R ≤ ε, and the dataset that issued it.
      10439      A measurement is a premise by its nature; this is the type it is entered as. -/
      10440  structure CertifiedObservationalBound where
      10441    R : Nat
      10442    ε : Nat
      10443    certificate : R ≤ ε
      10444    dataset : String
      10445  
      10446  set_option linter.unusedVariables false in
      10447  /-- STAGE 2, OPTIONAL CORROBORATION. The retrospective implication under the
      10448      eight former inputs, plus the discharge step the seated kernels prove by
      10449      cases and Nat arithmetic. The eight names are kept so the interface is the
      10450      documented one; the step from a failed universal to its witness is
      10451      classical, and the cone is printed as is. -/
      10452  theorem stage2_optional_corroboration
      10453      {ClassicalRH : Prop} {Z : Point → Prop} {n0 r0 T0 T : Nat}
      10454      (realized : PhysicalCarrier → Prop)
      10455      (population rate : PhysicalCarrier → Nat)
      10456      (B : CertifiedObservationalBound)
      10457      (h_read    : ClassicalRH ↔ ∀ p, Z p → onLine p)
      10458      (h_realize : ∀ p, Z p → realized (map_zero_to_carrier p))
      10459      (h_pop     : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ Neutral c → population c ≥ n0)
      10460      (h_rate    : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ Neutral c → rate c ≥ r0)
      10461      (h_temp    : T ≥ T0)
      10462      (h_couple  : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ Neutral c →
      10463                     B.R ≥ population c * rate c * landauerHeatPerEvent T)
      10464      (h_gap     : B.ε < detectionGap n0 r0 T0)
      10465      (h_discharge : ∀ p, Z p → ¬ onLine p → B.R ≥ detectionGap n0 r0 T0) :
      10466      ClassicalRH :=
      10467    h_read.mpr (fun p hp =>
      10468      by
      10469        cases Classical.em (onLine p) with
      10470        | inl h => exact h
      10471        | inr hoff =>
      10472          have hR := h_discharge p hp hoff
      10473          exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_trans hR B.certificate) h_gap)
      10474                       (Nat.lt_irrefl _))
      10475  
      10476  /-! ## cones, pinned -/
      10477  
      10478  /-- info: 'ApparatusCargo.local_computation_is_forgetting' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10479  #guard_msgs in #print axioms ApparatusCargo.local_computation_is_forgetting
      10480  /-- info: 'ApparatusCargo.event_witnesses_floor' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10481  #guard_msgs in #print axioms ApparatusCargo.event_witnesses_floor
      10482  /-- info: 'ApparatusCargo.stage1_closes' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10483  #guard_msgs in #print axioms ApparatusCargo.stage1_closes
      10484  /-- info: 'ApparatusCargo.computation_enacts_stage1' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10485  #guard_msgs in #print axioms ApparatusCargo.computation_enacts_stage1
      10486  /-- info: 'ApparatusCargo.stage2_optional_corroboration' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      10487  #guard_msgs in #print axioms ApparatusCargo.stage2_optional_corroboration
      10488  
      10489  end ApparatusCargo
      10490  end Level10ApparatusCargo
      10491  
      10492  /-! # PART IX . RH_Bound_Chain_v1.0.1.lean, verbatim (The Formal Arch, Discrete Offset Chart) -/
      10493  /-!
      10494    RH · BOUND CHAIN v1.0.1 — the Final Arch, in ONE FILE, in the Freedom register.
      10495  
      10496    Core Lean 4.19.0: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
      10497  
      10498    This file speaks only deliverance: what the Freedom arrow gives. No hypotheses are
      10499    taken and none are offered. Every statement below is exhibited by a closed term.
      10500  
      10501    THIS FILE BINDS `Cargo_Delivered_Flip.lean` (the flip: Freedom → act → locus → lever)
      10502    and `RH_Both_Sides_Flip_v1.0.lean` (the seed rebuilt in one stroke, pure formal domain)
      10503    into a SINGLE ARCH, one namespace, one capstone. Nothing is re-proved from
      10504    memory: every definition and proof below is the merged, de-duplicated content of the
      10505    two compiled files, with the prose lifted into the Freedom register.
      10506  
      10507    THE FINAL ARCH, end to end:
      10508      FREEDOM  — the arrow, unconditionally inhabited; the massless root. The source;
      10509                 everything below is its product.
      10510      ACT      — registration: the forgetting, definitional. Stage1: the formal
      10511                 annihilation, inhabited by the trivial neutral state.
      10512      EDGE     — where the deliverance stops, inside the arch: no universal route is
      10513                 delivered, no shared principle delivers the value, no inhabited deed
      10514                 delivers it, no record-reading delivers it. The edge is part of the
      10515                 arch, not a wall around it.
      10516      FORM     — the twins: LeastErasure ↔ Value, at each configuration.
      10517      LOCUS    — Rec S: the arrow's product, the formal world as the output of the act.
      10518      LEVER    — the remembered is lossless, definitionally; the twins carry it to
      10519                 least erasure; the remembering is stable.
      10520      SOCKET   — the filled ActualZeros at the locus, all fields by closed terms.
      10521      CLOSURE  — the identification IS the proof: the exhibited socket and the value
      10522                 coincide at the locus. One exhibited thing.
      10523      MEASURE  — the arrow's own measure of its reach: carrying the cargo from the
      10524                 record to a configuration IS the value there; and the arrow's product
      10525                 coexists with configurations the arrow does not value.
      10526      CAP      — bound_chain: Freedom ∧ lever ∧ socket ∧ edge ∧ inhabited act,
      10527                 one conjunction, empty cone.
      10528  
      10529    Read the capstone's type as the whole arch: what is delivered is exactly what is
      10530    exhibited. The arrow delivers the record, the socket, the closure — at its product.
      10531    Beyond its product the arrow delivers nothing.
      10532  
      10533    No seat is earned by this file. Seat follows the OS rule only. ΔM = 0.
      10534  -/
      10535  
      10536  section BoundChainV101
      10537  namespace BoundChain
      10538  
      10539  /-! ## chart: points, fold, line, registration -/
      10540  
      10541  /-- A point is (d, t): d its offset from the line, t its height. The line is d = 0. -/
      10542  abbrev Point := Int × Int
      10543  
      10544  /-- The fold: (d, t) ↦ (−d, t). -/
      10545  def fold (p : Point) : Point := (-p.1, p.2)
      10546  
      10547  /-- The line: offset zero. -/
      10548  def onLine (p : Point) : Prop := p.1 = 0
      10549  
      10550  /-- The registration: it keeps the height and forgets the side. The formal act. -/
      10551  def reg (p : Point) : Point := (0, p.2)
      10552  
      10553  /-- Integer negation is an involution, by the integer's constructors. -/
      10554  theorem neg_neg_free : ∀ d : Int, - -d = d := fun
      10555    | Int.ofNat 0 => rfl
      10556    | Int.ofNat (_ + 1) => rfl
      10557    | Int.negSucc _ => rfl
      10558  
      10559  /-- The fold is an involution. -/
      10560  theorem fold_involutive (p : Point) : fold (fold p) = p := by
      10561    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10562    show (- -d, t) = (d, t)
      10563    rw [neg_neg_free d]
      10564  
      10565  /-- THE REGISTRATION LANDS ON THE LINE: the forgetting, definitional. -/
      10566  theorem reg_lands (p : Point) : onLine (reg p) := rfl
      10567  
      10568  /-- The registration erases nothing at a point exactly when the point is on the line. -/
      10569  theorem reg_erases_nothing_iff (p : Point) : reg p = p ↔ onLine p := by
      10570    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10571    exact ⟨fun h => (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm, fun h => by cases h; rfl⟩
      10572  
      10573  /-- The fold fixes the registered point: the line is the fixed set. -/
      10574  theorem fold_reg (p : Point) : fold (reg p) = reg p := by
      10575    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10576    rfl
      10577  
      10578  /-! ## configurations, the value, least erasure -/
      10579  
      10580  /-- A configuration: a set of points. Closed: the fold carries it to itself. -/
      10581  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
      10582  
      10583  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold p)
      10584  
      10585  /-- The value: every point of the configuration is on the line. -/
      10586  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine p
      10587  
      10588  /-- Least erasure: the registration leaves every point of the configuration unchanged. -/
      10589  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → reg p = p
      10590  
      10591  /-! ## FREEDOM: the sole root -/
      10592  
      10593  /-- THE FREEDOM ARROW, massless: a true premise adds nothing. -/
      10594  theorem massless_arrow (Q : Prop) (hq : Q) (P : Prop) : (Q → P) ↔ P :=
      10595    ⟨fun f => f hq, fun h _ => h⟩
      10596  
      10597  /-- THE FORMAL ROOT: the identity arrow exists. Unconditionally inhabited, keyless. -/
      10598  def FreedomRoot : Prop := ∃ f : Nat → Nat, ∀ a, f a = a
      10599  
      10600  /-- The root is inhabited by a closed term. -/
      10601  theorem freedom_root_inhabited : FreedomRoot := ⟨id, fun _ => rfl⟩
      10602  
      10603  /-! ## THE ARROW'S EDGE: where the deliverance stops, inside the arch -/
      10604  
      10605  /-- The off-line point. -/
      10606  def offPoint : Point := (1, 0)
      10607  
      10608  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := by
      10609    intro h
      10610    have e : (1 : Int) = 0 := h
      10611    exact absurd e (by decide)
      10612  
      10613  /-- The pair world: a point and its fold partner. -/
      10614  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
      10615  
      10616  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
      10617    match hs with
      10618    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
      10619    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
      10620  
      10621  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
      10622    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
      10623  
      10624  /-- The arrow delivers no universal route. -/
      10625  theorem the_unconditional_route_is_blocked :
      10626      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S := by
      10627    intro h
      10628    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))
      10629  
      10630  /-- Nothing every closed configuration shares forces the value. -/
      10631  theorem no_closed_principle_decides (D : Config → Prop) (hD : ∀ S, Closed S → D S) :
      10632      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D S → Value S := by
      10633    intro hall
      10634    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10635      (hall _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) (hD _ (pair_world_closed offPoint)))
      10636  
      10637  /-- NO INHABITED FORMAL TYPE FORCES THE VALUE: whatever the deed, pairWorld offPoint
      10638      is closed and lacks the value. -/
      10639  theorem freedom_forces_nothing (D : Prop) (hD : D) :
      10640      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S := by
      10641    intro hall
      10642    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10643      (hall _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) hD)
      10644  
      10645  /-- The freedom root, inhabited, forces nothing on arbitrary configurations. -/
      10646  theorem freedom_root_forces_nothing :
      10647      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → FreedomRoot → Value S :=
      10648    freedom_forces_nothing _ freedom_root_inhabited
      10649  
      10650  /-! ## ACT: the formal forgetting, and Stage 1 -/
      10651  
      10652  /-- THE CARRIER. Two constructors: a self-conjugate state at a height, or a member of a
      10653      conjugate pair of magnitude m + 1 at a height with the sign that tells it from its partner. -/
      10654  inductive PhysicalCarrier where
      10655    | selfConjugate (t : Int)
      10656    | conjugatePair (m : Nat) (t : Int) (sign : Bool)
      10657  
      10658  /-- Annihilation, the discard: a member of a pair goes to the neutral state at its height;
      10659      a neutral state stays. The sign is kept nowhere. -/
      10660  def annihilate : PhysicalCarrier → PhysicalCarrier
      10661    | .selfConjugate t => .selfConjugate t
      10662    | .conjugatePair _ t _ => .selfConjugate t
      10663  
      10664  /-- A verification event: from `before` to `after`, with `after` the annihilation of
      10665      `before` — one label forgotten. -/
      10666  structure VerificationEvent where
      10667    before : PhysicalCarrier
      10668    after : PhysicalCarrier
      10669    h_forget : after = annihilate before
      10670  
      10671  /-- THE LOCAL COMPUTATION IS A FORGETTING: the event's own field. -/
      10672  theorem local_computation_is_forgetting (e : VerificationEvent) :
      10673      e.after = annihilate e.before :=
      10674    e.h_forget
      10675  
      10676  /-- STAGE 1: forgetting done, floor witnessed. -/
      10677  structure Stage1 where
      10678    event : VerificationEvent
      10679    forgetting_done : event.after = annihilate event.before
      10680    floor_witnessed : ∃ c, c = event.after
      10681  
      10682  /-- THE COMPUTATION ENACTS STAGE 1: every verification event supplies one. -/
      10683  def computation_enacts_stage1 (e : VerificationEvent) : Stage1 :=
      10684    ⟨e, e.h_forget, ⟨e.after, rfl⟩⟩
      10685  
      10686  /-- Stage 1 is inhabited by the trivial neutral state: selfConjugate 0. -/
      10687  def trivial_neutral_event : VerificationEvent :=
      10688    ⟨.selfConjugate 0, .selfConjugate 0, rfl⟩
      10689  
      10690  theorem stage1_inhabited : Nonempty Stage1 :=
      10691    ⟨computation_enacts_stage1 trivial_neutral_event⟩
      10692  
      10693  /-- The inhabited Stage1 forces nothing on arbitrary configurations. -/
      10694  theorem stage1_forces_nothing :
      10695      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Nonempty Stage1 → Value S :=
      10696    freedom_forces_nothing _ stage1_inhabited
      10697  
      10698  /-! ## FORM: least erasure is the value -/
      10699  
      10700  /-- THE TWINS LAW: least erasure and the value are one extension, read two ways. -/
      10701  theorem twins_on_every_world (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
      10702    ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
      10703     fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
      10704  
      10705  /-! ## LOCUS + LEVER: the record, the lossless remembered -/
      10706  
      10707  /-- The record of a configuration: what the registration leaves. The constructed locus. -/
      10708  def Rec (S : Config) (q : Point) : Prop := ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
      10709  
      10710  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
      10711  
      10712  /-- The registered world of a point. -/
      10713  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
      10714  
      10715  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      10716    rw [hs]; exact reg_lands p
      10717  
      10718  theorem registered_closed (p : Point) : Closed (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      10719    rw [hs]; show fold (reg p) = reg p; exact fold_reg p
      10720  
      10721  /-- The registered world and the pair world leave one record. -/
      10722  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
      10723    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs]; rfl⟩,
      10724     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
      10725        rw [← hq]
      10726        exact match hs with
      10727          | Or.inl e => by rw [e]; rfl
      10728          | Or.inr e => by rw [e]; rfl⟩⟩
      10729  
      10730  /-- NO READING OF THE RECORD DECIDES: two worlds, one record, the value on one side only. -/
      10731  theorem record_decides_nothing (g : Config → Prop)
      10732      (hg : ∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) :
      10733      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S) := by
      10734    intro h
      10735    have pc := pair_world_closed offPoint
      10736    have pv := pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10737    have rc := registered_closed offPoint
      10738    exact pv ((h _ pc).mp ((hg _ _ (one_record offPoint)).mp
      10739      ((h _ rc).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))))
      10740  
      10741  /-- THE REMEMBERED IS LOSSLESS: the record of every configuration has the value.
      10742      Kept core: the output of a line-landing map lies on the line. No hypothesis on S. -/
      10743  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) :=
      10744    fun _ ⟨p, _, hq⟩ => hq ▸ reg_lands p
      10745  
      10746  /-- The record of every configuration has least erasure, via the twins law. -/
      10747  theorem record_has_least_erasure (S : Config) : LeastErasure (Rec S) :=
      10748    (twins_on_every_world (Rec S)).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S)
      10749  
      10750  /-- The record is closed: it lies on the line, which the fold fixes. -/
      10751  theorem record_closed (S : Config) : Closed (Rec S) := fun q ⟨p, hp, hq⟩ =>
      10752    ⟨p, hp, by rw [← hq, fold_reg p]⟩
      10753  
      10754  /-- Remembering is stable: the memory of a memory is the memory. -/
      10755  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
      10756    constructor
      10757    · intro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hp⟩, hq⟩
      10758      refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
      10759      rw [← hq, ← hp]
      10760      exact ((reg_erases_nothing_iff (reg r)).mpr (reg_lands r)).symm
      10761    · intro hq
      10762      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
      10763  
      10764  /-- The offered is the remembered exactly when the value holds. -/
      10765  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
      10766    constructor
      10767    · intro h p hp
      10768      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S p ((h p).mpr hp)
      10769    · intro v q
      10770      constructor
      10771      · intro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
      10772        have e : reg p = p := (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)
      10773        rw [← hq, e]; exact hp
      10774      · intro hq
      10775        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (v q hq)⟩
      10776  
      10777  /-- THE ONE-BIT GAP, CONNECTED. -/
      10778  theorem one_bit_gap_connected (S : Config) :
      10779      SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
      10780      ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) :=
      10781    ⟨fun q => (remembering_is_stable S q).symm, the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S,
      10782     offered_is_remembered_iff_value S⟩
      10783  
      10784  /-! ## SOCKET: the bit supplied, the closure at a term -/
      10785  
      10786  /-- THE SOCKET: the bit supplied once, explicitly, as a field of a type. -/
      10787  structure ActualZeros where
      10788    zeros : Config
      10789    closed : Closed zeros
      10790    supply : LeastErasure zeros
      10791  
      10792  /-- THE FILLED SOCKET: the constructed locus supplies all three fields by closed terms. -/
      10793  def formal_act (S : Config) : ActualZeros :=
      10794    ⟨Rec S, record_closed S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10795  
      10796  /-- CLOSURE AT A TERM: at the registered world of any point, the socket holds a closed term. -/
      10797  def formal_closure_term (p : Point) : ActualZeros :=
      10798    ⟨registered p, registered_closed p, (twins_on_every_world _).mpr (registered_has_value p)⟩
      10799  
      10800  /-! ## the remaining levels, delivered: force, bar, saturation, one, atom -/
      10801  
      10802  /-- The value is its own weakest forcing premise (constructive core). -/
      10803  theorem weakest_forcing_premise :
      10804      (∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S → Value S) ∧
      10805      ∀ P : Config → Prop, (∀ S : Config, Closed S → P S → Value S) →
      10806        ∀ S : Config, Closed S → P S → Value S :=
      10807    ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun _P h S hS hp => h S hS hp⟩
      10808  
      10809  /-- The barred refuter: the only other door is one point off the line. -/
      10810  theorem barred_refuter (p : Point) (hp : ¬ onLine p) : ∃ S, Closed S ∧ ¬ Value S :=
      10811    ⟨pairWorld p, pair_world_closed p, pair_world_lacks_value p hp⟩
      10812  
      10813  /-- SATURATION: the record is value-closed, least-erased, and stable. -/
      10814  theorem saturation (S : Config) :
      10815      Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) :=
      10816    ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S, remembering_is_stable S⟩
      10817  
      10818  /-- THE ONE: the two faces as one, zero gap, on the locus. -/
      10819  theorem the_one (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) :=
      10820    ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10821  
      10822  /-- THE ATOMIC NECESSITY: at the constructed locus the socket is filled. -/
      10823  theorem atomic_necessity (S : Config) : ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S :=
      10824    ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10825  
      10826  /-- Accepting the value at the locus forces the atomic proof. -/
      10827  theorem accepting_value_forces_atomic (S : Config) :
      10828      Value (Rec S) → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S :=
      10829    fun _ => ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10830  
      10831  /-! ## THE CAP: one arch, one capstone -/
      10832  
      10833  /-- THE BOUND CHAIN: Freedom (inhabited root) ∧ the lever with the filled socket on the
      10834      constructed locus ∧ the blocks intact ∧ the act inhabited — one conjunction, one
      10835      gapless chain, empty cone. This is the whole verdict in one type. -/
      10836  theorem bound_chain :
      10837      FreedomRoot ∧
      10838      (∀ S : Config, Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S)) ∧
      10839      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S) ∧
      10840      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) ∧
      10841      (∀ D : Prop, D → ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S) ∧
      10842      (∀ g : Config → Prop, (∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) →
      10843        ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S)) ∧
      10844      Nonempty Stage1 :=
      10845    ⟨freedom_root_inhabited,
      10846     fun S => ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S, formal_act S, rfl⟩,
      10847     the_unconditional_route_is_blocked, no_closed_principle_decides,
      10848     freedom_forces_nothing, record_decides_nothing, stage1_inhabited⟩
      10849  
      10850  /-! ## THE ARROW'S MEASURE I: the transport IS the value -/
      10851  
      10852  /-- THE ARROW'S MEASURE: carrying the cargo's least erasure from the record to a
      10853      configuration IS the value at that configuration — for every configuration M.
      10854      The arrow delivers the record; the distance from the record to M is the value
      10855      itself. The arrow measuring its own reach, in a proved iff. -/
      10856  theorem transport_needs_value (M : Config) :
      10857      (LeastErasure (Rec M) → LeastErasure M) ↔ Value M := by
      10858    constructor
      10859    · intro h
      10860      exact (twins_on_every_world M).mp (h (record_has_least_erasure M))
      10861    · intro v _
      10862      exact (twins_on_every_world M).mpr v
      10863  
      10864  /-! ## CLOSURE: the identification IS the proof, at the arrow's product -/
      10865  
      10866  /-- From the act, the value: the filled socket's zeros carry the value. -/
      10867  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
      10868    fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (Z.supply p hp)
      10869  
      10870  /-- THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE PROOF: at the arrow's product, the exhibited filled
      10871      socket and the value coincide — proof and identification are one exhibited thing,
      10872      with no gap between them. The socket is exhibited directly by the arrow; the value
      10873      follows at the locus. Full closure of the loop, delivered. -/
      10874  theorem identification_is_the_proof (S : Config) :
      10875      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S) ↔ Value (Rec S) := by
      10876    constructor
      10877    · intro ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      10878      exact hZ ▸ value_from_the_act Z
      10879    · intro _
      10880      exact ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10881  
      10882  /-! ## THE ARROW'S MEASURE II: the product coexists with what the arrow does not value -/
      10883  
      10884  /-- THE ARROW'S REACH: the arrow delivers least erasure at its product, the record —
      10885      and delivers nothing beyond its product. The product coexists with configurations
      10886      the arrow does not value. Checked coexistence, empty cone. -/
      10887  theorem cargo_compatible_with_denial :
      10888      ∃ S Z : Config, LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ ¬ LeastErasure Z :=
      10889    ⟨fun _ => False, pairWorld offPoint,
      10890     record_has_least_erasure _,
      10891     fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10892       ((twins_on_every_world (pairWorld offPoint)).mp h)⟩
      10893  
      10894  /-! ## THE SELF-GROUNDING RETRACTION RECURSION (DISCRETE CHART) -/
      10895  
      10896  /-- The retracted image Rec S is a self-grounding fixed-point root in the sense of Part I (TOE0),
      10897      canonically inhabited by the closed term `formal_act S` — the retraction witness bundle.
      10898      This is the discrete-chart instance of the cargo recursion lifted to ℂ in Part X. -/
      10899  def ra_cargo_self_grounding (S : Config) :
      10900      TOE0.SelfGrounding (LeastErasure (Rec S)) :=
      10901    ⟨ActualZeros, formal_act S, fun _ => record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10902  
      10903  /-- THE SELF-GROUNDING FIXED-POINT RECURSION AT THE RETRACTED IMAGE:
      10904      idempotence of registration makes LeastErasure (Rec S) unconditional and self-verifying
      10905      with an empty axiom cone. The three conjuncts are obtained by applying the Part I
      10906      theorems `TOE0.seated_undeniable`, `TOE0.denial_instantiates`, and
      10907      `TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing` to the closed term `ra_cargo_self_grounding S`. -/
      10908  theorem ra_recursion_at_record (S : Config) :
      10909      LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧
      10910      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure (Rec S)) ∧
      10911      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → LeastErasure (Rec S)) ↔ LeastErasure (Rec S)) :=
      10912    ⟨TOE0.seated_undeniable (ra_cargo_self_grounding S),
      10913     TOE0.denial_instantiates (ra_cargo_self_grounding S),
      10914     TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing (ra_cargo_self_grounding S)⟩
      10915

      11020  
      11021  /-! # PART X . The Complex Retraction, Fixed-Point Recursion, and Mathlib Binding -/
      11022  section PartX
      11023  open Complex
      11024  
      11025  namespace BoundChainMathlib
      11026  
      11027  /-! ### TRANSLATION DICTIONARY for analytic number theorists -/
      11028  
      11029  /-!
      11030    Dirichlet series and the Euler product → `riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re`
      11031    (Mathlib.NumberTheory.LSeries.Dirichlet): non-vanishing for Re s > 1, the right
      11032    edge of `zeta_zeros_in_strip`.
      11033  
      11034    The completed functional equation → `completedRiemannZeta_one_sub`: the analytic
      11035    symmetry s ↦ 1 − s is the retraction operator `foldPt`; its Schwarz reflection
      11036    form is `zeta_schwarz_reflection`.
      11037  
      11038    Zero-free regions and strip confinement → `zeta_zeros_in_strip`: every nontrivial
      11039    zero satisfies 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1, unconditionally.
      11040  
      11041    Explicit-formula / Weil-positivity criteria → `analytic_face_vocabulary_law`:
      11042    every analytic face equivalent to RH is identical to the fixed-point identity
      11043    `LeastErasure ZetaZeros`.
      11044  
      11045    The classical statement → `h_id_proved`: Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis` is
      11046    logically identical to `LeastErasure ZetaZeros`.
      11047  
      11048    The normal form → `zeta_ra_loop` (first leg) and `apex_cone`: RH is the apex of
      11049    a cone of equivalent readings — retraction injectivity, the ActualZeros socket,
      11050    record coincidence — any two the same proposition (`apex_one_gap`).
      11051  -/
      11052  
      11053  /-- Points of the complex plane. -/
      11054  abbrev Point := ℂ
      11055  
      11056  /-- The critical locus: Re s = 1/2. -/
      11057  def onLine (s : Point) : Prop := s.re = 1 / 2
      11058  
      11059  /-- Conjugate reflection across the critical line: s ↦ 1 - conj s. -/
      11060  def fold (s : Point) : Point := 1 - star s
      11061  
      11062  /-- Point reflection from the functional equation: s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11063  def foldPt (s : Point) : Point := 1 - s
      11064  
      11065  /-- Orthogonal retraction onto the critical line: s ↦ 1/2 + i Im s. -/
      11066  noncomputable def reg (s : Point) : Point := ⟨1 / 2, s.im⟩
      11067  
      11068  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
      11069  
      11070  /-- Reflection-closed configuration: invariant under s ↦ 1 - conj s. -/
      11071  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → S (fold s)
      11072  
      11073  /-- Critical-line inclusion: every point of S lies on Re s = 1/2. -/
      11074  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → onLine s
      11075  
      11076  /-- Pointwise retraction invariance: every point of S is fixed by reg. -/
      11077  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → reg s = s
      11078  
      11079  /-- The nontrivial zero set of ζ(s), defined directly from Mathlib's riemannZeta. -/
      11080  def ZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop :=
      11081    riemannZeta s = 0 ∧ (¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1)) ∧ s ≠ 1
      11082  
      11083  /-- The nontrivial zero set of the completed zeta function Λ(s). -/
      11084  def CompletedZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop :=
      11085    completedRiemannZeta s = 0 ∧ s ≠ 0 ∧ s ≠ 1
      11086  
      11087  /-- Conjugate reflection is an involution on ℂ. -/
      11088  theorem fold_involutive (s : Point) : fold (fold s) = s := by
      11089    simp only [fold, star_sub, star_one, star_star, sub_sub_cancel]
      11090  
      11091  /-- Point reflection fixes the real part if and only if the point lies on the critical line. -/
      11092  theorem foldPt_re_fixed_iff (s : Point) : (foldPt s).re = s.re ↔ onLine s := by
      11093    unfold foldPt onLine
      11094    simp only [sub_re, one_re]
      11095    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
      11096  
      11097  /-- Symmetry of the completed zero set under s ↦ 1 - s from Mathlib's functional equation. -/
      11098  theorem completed_zeta_zeros_symm (s : Point) (h : CompletedZetaZeros s) :
      11099      CompletedZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11100    rcases h with ⟨hz, h0, h1⟩
      11101    refine ⟨?_, sub_ne_zero.mpr h1.symm, ?_⟩
      11102    · show completedRiemannZeta (1 - s) = 0
      11103      rw [completedRiemannZeta_one_sub]
      11104      exact hz
      11105    · show (1 : Point) - s ≠ 1
      11106      intro hcon
      11107      apply h0
      11108      have h2 := congrArg (fun x : Point => (1 : Point) - x) hcon
      11109      simpa using h2
      11110  
      11111  /-- The retraction lands on the critical line for every complex number. -/
      11112  theorem reg_lands (s : Point) : onLine (reg s) := rfl
      11113  
      11114  /-- Conjugate reflection fixes every retracted point. -/
      11115  theorem fold_reg (s : Point) : fold (reg s) = reg s := by
      11116    apply Complex.ext
      11117    · simp [fold, reg]
      11118      norm_num
      11119    · simp [fold, reg]
      11120  
      11121  /-- The retraction fixes a point if and only if the point lies on the critical line. -/
      11122  theorem reg_eq_self_iff (s : Point) : reg s = s ↔ onLine s := by
      11123    constructor
      11124    · intro h
      11125      show s.re = 1 / 2
      11126      have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
      11127      simpa [reg] using hr.symm
      11128    · intro h
      11129      have hre : s.re = 1 / 2 := h
      11130      show (⟨1 / 2, s.im⟩ : Point) = s
      11131      apply Complex.ext
      11132      · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) = s.re
      11133        exact hre.symm
      11134      · rfl
      11135  
      11136  /-- Pointwise retraction invariance is equivalent to critical-line inclusion on every subset of ℂ. -/
      11137  theorem twins_zeta (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S := by
      11138    constructor
      11139    · intro h s hs
      11140      exact (reg_eq_self_iff s).mp (h s hs)
      11141    · intro h s hs
      11142      exact (reg_eq_self_iff s).mpr (h s hs)
      11143  
      11144  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is definitionally equivalent to critical-line inclusion of ZetaZeros. -/
      11145  theorem h_read_proved : RiemannHypothesis ↔ Value ZetaZeros := by
      11146    constructor
      11147    · intro h s ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      11148      exact h s h0 h1 h2
      11149    · intro h s h0 h1 h2
      11150      exact h s ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      11151  
      11152  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is equivalent to pointwise retraction invariance of ZetaZeros. -/
      11153  theorem h_id_proved : RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros :=
      11154    h_read_proved.trans (twins_zeta ZetaZeros).symm
      11155  
      11156  /-- The retracted image of a configuration S under reg. -/
      11157  def Rec (S : Config) : Config := fun q => ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
      11158  
      11159  /-- Retraction is idempotent on ℂ. -/
      11160  theorem reg_idem (s : Point) : reg (reg s) = reg s := rfl
      11161  
      11162  /-- Every retracted image lies on the critical line. -/
      11163  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) := by
      11164    intro q ⟨p, _, hpq⟩
      11165    rw [← hpq]
      11166    exact reg_lands p
      11167  
      11168  /-- Every retracted image is closed under conjugate reflection. -/
      11169  theorem record_closed (S : Config) : Closed (Rec S) := by
      11170    intro q ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩
      11171    exact ⟨p, hp, by rw [← hpq, fold_reg p]⟩
      11172  
      11173  /-- Every retracted image is pointwise invariant under reg. -/
      11174  theorem record_has_least_erasure (S : Config) : LeastErasure (Rec S) := by
      11175    intro q ⟨p, _, hpq⟩
      11176    show reg q = q
      11177    rw [← hpq, reg_idem]
      11178  
      11179  /-- Fixed-point witness bundle: a reflection-closed configuration equipped with retraction invariance. -/
      11180  structure ActualZeros where
      11181    zeros : Config
      11182    closed : Closed zeros
      11183    supply : LeastErasure zeros
      11184  
      11185  /-- Canonical fixed-point witness bundle at the retracted image Rec S. -/
      11186  noncomputable def formal_act (S : Config) : ActualZeros :=
      11187    ⟨Rec S, record_closed S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      11188  
      11189  /-- Every fixed-point witness bundle satisfies critical-line inclusion. -/
      11190  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
      11191    fun s hs => (reg_eq_self_iff s).mp (Z.supply s hs)
      11192  
      11193  /-- At the retracted image Rec S, existence of a fixed-point witness bundle coincides with Value (Rec S). -/
      11194  theorem identification_is_the_proof (S : Config) :
      11195      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S) ↔ Value (Rec S) := by
      11196    constructor
      11197    · intro ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      11198      exact hZ ▸ value_from_the_act Z
      11199    · intro _
      11200      exact ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      11201  
      11202  /-- Retraction transfer measure: carrying retraction invariance from Rec M to M is equivalent to Value M. -/
      11203  theorem transport_zeta (M : Config) :
      11204      (LeastErasure (Rec M) → LeastErasure M) ↔ Value M := by
      11205    constructor
      11206    · intro h
      11207      exact (twins_zeta M).mp (h (record_has_least_erasure M))
      11208    · intro v _
      11209      exact (twins_zeta M).mpr v
      11210  
      11211  /-- Unconditional retraction invariance of the retracted zero set Rec ZetaZeros. -/
      11212  theorem cargo_at_zeros : LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) :=
      11213    record_has_least_erasure ZetaZeros
      11214  
      11215  /-! ### X-a . Set-Level Idempotence and Fixed-Point Characterization over ℂ -/
      11216  
      11217  /-- Set-level idempotence of the retraction image: Rec (Rec S) = Rec S pointwise. -/
      11218  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
      11219    constructor
      11220    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩, hpq⟩
      11221      exact ⟨r, hr, (reg_idem r).symm.trans ((congrArg reg hpr).trans hpq)⟩
      11222    · intro hq
      11223      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
      11224  
      11225  /-- A configuration S is a fixed point of the set-level retraction Rec if and only if Value S holds. -/
      11226  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
      11227    constructor
      11228    · intro h s hs
      11229      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S s ((h s).mpr hs)
      11230    · intro hv q
      11231      constructor
      11232      · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩
      11233        have heq : reg p = p := (reg_eq_self_iff p).mpr (hv p hp)
      11234        rw [← hpq, heq]
      11235        exact hp
      11236      · intro hq
      11237        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (hv q hq)⟩
      11238  
      11239  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis holds if and only if ZetaZeros is a fixed point of Rec. -/
      11240  theorem rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec :
      11241      RiemannHypothesis ↔ (∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q) :=
      11242    h_read_proved.trans (offered_is_remembered_iff_value ZetaZeros).symm

      11244  /-! ### X-b . Complex-Analytic Vocabulary Isomorphism -/
      11245  
      11246  /-- Any complex-analytic proposition proved equivalent to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis. -/
      11247  structure AnalyticFace where

      11249    cited : RiemannHypothesis ↔ sentence

      11262  theorem analytic_face_vocabulary_law (F : AnalyticFace) (P : Prop) :

      11264      ((P → F.sentence) ↔ (P → LeastErasure ZetaZeros)) := by
      11265    have h := analytic_face_is_least_erasure F
      11266    exact ⟨⟨fun hf hl => hf (h.mpr hl), fun hl hf => hl (h.mp hf)⟩,

      11270  
      11271  /-- The retraction reg is invariant under conjugate reflection across the critical line. -/
      11272  theorem reg_fold (s : Point) : reg (fold s) = reg s := by
      11273    apply Complex.ext
      11274    · rfl
      11275    · simp [fold, reg]
      11276  
      11277  /-- Fiber equivalence: two configurations have the same retracted image under reg. -/
      11278  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
      11279  
      11280  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
      11281  
      11282  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
      11283  
      11284  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
      11285    match hs with
      11286    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
      11287    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
      11288  
      11289  theorem registered_closed (p : Point) : Closed (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      11290    rw [hs]
      11291    exact fold_reg p
      11292  
      11293  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      11294    rw [hs]
      11295    exact reg_lands p
      11296  
      11297  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
      11298    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
      11299  
      11300  /-- A point on the critical line and a conjugate-reflected pair at the same height share one retracted image. -/
      11301  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
      11302    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs, reg_idem]⟩,
      11303     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
      11304       rw [← hq, reg_idem]
      11305       rcases hs with rfl | rfl
      11306       · rfl
      11307       · exact (reg_fold p).symm⟩⟩
      11308  
      11309  def offPoint : Point := ⟨0, 14⟩
      11310  
      11311  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := by
      11312    unfold onLine offPoint
      11313    norm_num
      11314  
      11315  /-- Reflection symmetry alone does not force a complex configuration onto the critical line. -/
      11316  theorem the_unconditional_route_is_blocked :
      11317      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S :=
      11318    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))
      11319  
      11320  /-- Fiber invariance block: no predicate invariant under Rec decides Value on all reflection-closed subsets of ℂ. -/
      11321  theorem record_decides_nothing (g : Config → Prop)
      11322      (hg : ∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) :
      11323      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S) := by
      11324    intro h
      11325    have pc := pair_world_closed offPoint
      11326    have pv := pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      11327    have rc := registered_closed offPoint
      11328    exact pv ((h _ pc).mp ((hg _ _ (one_record offPoint)).mp
      11329      ((h _ rc).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))))
      11330  
      11331  /-- Existence of a point off the critical line in a configuration S. -/
      11332  def OffLine (S : Config) : Prop := ∃ s, S s ∧ ¬ onLine s
      11333  
      11334  /-- The retracted image Rec S contains no point off the critical line. -/
      11335  theorem no_offline_zero_on_record (S : Config) : ¬ OffLine (Rec S) :=

      11338  /-- Negation of Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is equivalent to an off-line point in ZetaZeros. -/
      11339  theorem offline_zero_iff_not_rh : OffLine ZetaZeros ↔ ¬ RiemannHypothesis := by
      11340    rw [h_read_proved]
      11341    constructor
      11342    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hoff⟩ hv
      11343      exact hoff (hv s hs)
      11344    · intro hnot
      11345      apply Classical.byContradiction
      11346      intro hno
      11347      apply hnot
      11348      intro s hs
      11349      apply Classical.byContradiction
      11350      intro hoff
      11351      exact hno ⟨s, hs, hoff⟩

      11353  /-- Σ₁ refuter seal over ℂ: where refutation requires an off-line zero, non-refutation seals RH. -/
      11354  theorem no_offline_refuter_seals_rh
      11355      (Prov : Prop → Prop)
      11356      (sigma1 : OffLine ZetaZeros → Prov (¬ RiemannHypothesis))

      11358      RiemannHypothesis := by

      11360    intro hnot
      11361    exact h_no_refute (sigma1 (offline_zero_iff_not_rh.mpr hnot))

      11363  /-! ### X-d . The Self-Grounding Retraction Recursion and Fiber Section Loop over ℂ -/
      11364  
      11365  /-- The retracted zero set Rec ZetaZeros forms a self-grounding fixed-point root (Part I, TOE0).
      11366      The retracted image is inhabited by the closed term `formal_act ZetaZeros` — the canonical

      11376      the Part I theorems `TOE0.seated_undeniable`, `TOE0.denial_instantiates`, and

      11391  theorem classes_coincide_under_ra_zeta

      11405  /-- THE FIVE-WAY FIXED-POINT LOOP OVER ℂ:

      11411      `LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros`. The first leg is the

      11413  theorem zeta_ra_loop :
      11414      ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧

      11416      ((∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11417      ((∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11418      (TOE0.SelfVerifying RiemannHypothesis ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      11419    have h_rec : LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) := cargo_at_zeros
      11420    have h_tr : (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=

      11429

      11481  /-! ### X-e . Step 4 from First Principles: Strip Equivalence and Functional-Equation Closure -/
      11482  
      11483  /-- Point reflection s ↦ 1 - s is an involution on ℂ. -/
      11484  theorem foldPt_involutive (s : Point) : foldPt (foldPt s) = s := by
      11485    unfold foldPt
      11486    ring
      11487  
      11488  /-- Point-reflection closure on complex configurations: invariant under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11489  def ClosedPt (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → S (foldPt s)
      11490  
      11491  /-- Unconditional functional-equation closure of CompletedZetaZeros under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11492  theorem completed_zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt CompletedZetaZeros :=
      11493    completed_zeta_zeros_symm
      11494  
      11495  /-- First-principles bridge from Mathlib's riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero and Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos:
      11496      at any complex point with 0 < Re s, riemannZeta s = 0 iff completedRiemannZeta s = 0. -/
      11497  theorem zeta_zero_iff_completed_of_re_pos {s : Point} (hre : 0 < s.re) :
      11498      riemannZeta s = 0 ↔ completedRiemannZeta s = 0 := by
      11499    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      11500      intro h0
      11501      rw [h0, zero_re] at hre
      11502      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
      11503    have hG : Gammaℝ s ≠ 0 := Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hre
      11504    rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff]
      11505    exact ⟨fun h => h.resolve_right hG, fun h => Or.inl h⟩
      11506  
      11507  /-- Inside the critical strip 0 < Re s < 1, ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s.
      11508      Proved unconditionally from first principles using Mathlib's Gammaℝ non-vanishing. -/
      11509  theorem zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip {s : Point} (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1) :
      11510      ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s := by
      11511    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      11512      intro heq
      11513      rw [heq, zero_re] at h0
      11514      exact lt_irrefl 0 h0
      11515    have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
      11516      intro heq
      11517      rw [heq, one_re] at h1
      11518      exact lt_irrefl 1 h1
      11519    have h_not_trivial : ¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1) := by
      11520      rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      11521      have hneg : ((-2 : Point) * ((n : Point) + 1)).re ≤ 0 := by
      11522        have hcast : ((-2 : Point) * ((n : Point) + 1)) = (((-2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      11523          push_cast
      11524          ring
      11525        rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_re]
      11526        have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      11527        linarith
      11528      linarith
      11529    unfold ZetaZeros CompletedZetaZeros
      11530    rw [zeta_zero_iff_completed_of_re_pos h0]
      11531    exact ⟨fun ⟨hz, _, _⟩ => ⟨hz, hs0, hs1⟩, fun ⟨hz, _, _⟩ => ⟨hz, h_not_trivial, hs1⟩⟩
      11532  
      11533  /-- Unconditional functional-equation symmetry of ZetaZeros inside the critical strip:
      11534      if 0 < Re s < 1 and ZetaZeros s, then ZetaZeros (1 - s). -/
      11535  theorem zeta_zeros_symm_in_strip {s : Point} (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1)
      11536      (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11537    have h1_0 : 0 < (foldPt s).re := by unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11538    have h1_1 : (foldPt s).re < 1 := by unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11539    rw [zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h1_0 h1_1]
      11540    exact completed_zeta_zeros_symm s ((zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h0 h1).mp hz)

      11542  /-- The strip-confined nontrivial zero set of ζ(s). -/
      11543  def StripZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop := ZetaZeros s ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1
      11544  
      11545  /-- Unconditional closure of StripZetaZeros under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11546  theorem strip_zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt StripZetaZeros := by

      11552  /-! ### X-f . First-Principles Retraction Injectivity and Orbit Collapse over ℂ -/
      11553  
      11554  /-- Conjugate reflection fold (s ↦ 1 - star s) fixes a complex point iff Re s = 1/2. -/
      11555  theorem fold_fixed_iff_onLine (s : Point) : fold s = s ↔ onLine s := by
      11556    constructor
      11557    · intro h
      11558      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11559      unfold fold onLine at *
      11560      simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re] at hre
      11561      linarith
      11562    · intro h
      11563      unfold onLine at h
      11564      apply Complex.ext
      11565      · unfold fold
      11566        simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re]
      11567        linarith
      11568      · unfold fold
      11569        simp only [sub_im, one_im, star_def, conj_im, zero_sub, neg_neg]

      11571  /-- Retraction injectivity on a configuration S: no two distinct points of S project to
      11572      the same registered point on the critical line. -/
      11573  def RetractionInjective (S : Config) : Prop :=
      11574    ∀ p q, S p → S q → reg p = reg q → p = q
      11575  
      11576  /-- FIRST-PRINCIPLES ORBIT COLLAPSE THEOREM:
      11577      On any conjugate-reflection-closed configuration S (Closed S), if the retraction reg
      11578      is injective on S, then every point of S lies on the critical line (Value S).
      11579      Proof: For s ∈ S, closure gives fold s ∈ S. Since reg (fold s) = reg s, injectivity
      11580      forces fold s = s, which by fold_fixed_iff_onLine forces Re s = 1/2. -/
      11581  theorem closed_retraction_injective_forces_value {S : Config}
      11582      (h_closed : Closed S) (h_inj : RetractionInjective S) : Value S := by
      11583    intro s hs
      11584    have h_fold_in : S (fold s) := h_closed s hs
      11585    have h_reg_eq : reg (fold s) = reg s := reg_fold s
      11586    have h_fixed : fold s = s := h_inj (fold s) s h_fold_in hs h_reg_eq
      11587    exact (fold_fixed_iff_onLine s).mp h_fixed
      11588  
      11589  /-- Conversely, if Value S holds, then reg is the identity on S and hence injective on S. -/
      11590  theorem value_implies_retraction_injective {S : Config} (hv : Value S) :
      11591      RetractionInjective S := by
      11592    intro p q hp hq hreg
      11593    have hp_eq : reg p = p := (reg_eq_self_iff p).mpr (hv p hp)
      11594    have hq_eq : reg q = q := (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (hv q hq)
      11595    rw [← hp_eq, ← hq_eq, hreg]
      11596  
      11597  /-- THE BIJECTIVE FIBER EQUIVALENCE ON CLOSED COMPLEX CONFIGURATIONS:
      11598      For any reflection-closed S ⊆ ℂ, retraction injectivity, critical-line inclusion (Value),
      11599      and pointwise retraction invariance (LeastErasure) are mutually equivalent. -/
      11600  theorem closed_retraction_injective_iff_value {S : Config} (h_closed : Closed S) :
      11601      (RetractionInjective S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RetractionInjective S ↔ LeastErasure S) := by
      11602    have h1 : RetractionInjective S ↔ Value S :=
      11603      ⟨closed_retraction_injective_forces_value h_closed, value_implies_retraction_injective⟩
      11604    exact ⟨h1, h1.trans (twins_zeta S).symm⟩
      11605  
      11606  /-- Retraction injectivity holds unconditionally on the retracted image Rec S of every S ⊆ ℂ. -/
      11607  theorem record_retraction_injective (S : Config) : RetractionInjective (Rec S) :=
      11608    value_implies_retraction_injective (the_remembered_is_lossless S)
      11609  
      11610  /-- THE 1-BIT BRIDGE IN ORBIT-COLLAPSE SPELLING:
      11611      On a reflection-closed ZetaZeros, retraction injectivity collapses each fiber to its
      11612      critical-line point, and Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis follows. By
      11613      `closed_retraction_injective_iff_value` this is the same 1-bit bridge as
      11614      `rh_from_the_cargo_loop`: on reflection-closed S, RetractionInjective S is
      11615      equivalent to LeastErasure S. By § X-b (`analytic_face_is_least_erasure`,
      11616      `analytic_face_is_transport_gap`, `analytic_face_vocabulary_law`) every analytic
      11617      face equivalent to RH is identical to `LeastErasure ZetaZeros` and cannot bypass
      11618      it. The two hypotheses are the bridge in analytic spelling. -/
      11619  theorem rh_from_closed_and_retraction_injective
      11620      (h_closed : Closed ZetaZeros)
      11621      (h_inj : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros) :
      11622      LeastErasure ZetaZeros ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
      11623    have hv : Value ZetaZeros := closed_retraction_injective_forces_value h_closed h_inj
      11624    exact ⟨(twins_zeta ZetaZeros).mpr hv, h_read_proved.mpr hv⟩
      11625  
      11626  /-! ### X-g . Step 5 from First Principles: Discrete-to-Complex Chart Homomorphism -/
      11627  
      11628  /-- Exact embedding of the discrete offset chart (BoundChain.Point = Int × Int) into ℂ:
      11629      offset d and height t map to (1/2 + d/8) + i t. -/
      11630  noncomputable def φC (p : BoundChain.Point) : Point :=
      11631    ⟨1 / 2 + (p.1 : ℝ) / 8, (p.2 : ℝ)⟩
      11632  
      11633  /-- THE DISCRETE-TO-COMPLEX HOMOMORPHISM:
      11634      Discrete fold, registration, and critical-line membership in Part IX commute
      11635      exact-for-exact with complex conjugate reflection, complex retraction, and
      11636      the complex critical line Re s = 1/2 in Part X. The chart of Part IX is left intact;
      11637      this homomorphism proves it an equivariant sub-chart of ℂ, and
      11638      `carrier_embeds_in_complex` (§ X-i) carries Part VIII's carrier into the same image. -/
      11639  theorem discrete_chart_embeds_in_complex (p : BoundChain.Point) :
      11640      φC (BoundChain.fold p) = fold (φC p) ∧
      11641      φC (BoundChain.reg p) = reg (φC p) ∧
      11642      (onLine (φC p) ↔ BoundChain.onLine p) := by
      11643    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      11644    · apply Complex.ext
      11645      · simp [φC, BoundChain.fold, fold]
      11646        ring
      11647      · simp [φC, BoundChain.fold, fold]
      11648    · apply Complex.ext
      11649      · simp [φC, BoundChain.reg, reg]
      11650      · simp [φC, BoundChain.reg, reg]
      11651    · unfold onLine BoundChain.onLine φC
      11652      simp only [add_eq_left, div_eq_zero_iff, Int.cast_eq_zero]
      11653      constructor
      11654      · intro h
      11655        exact h.resolve_right (by norm_num)
      11656      · intro h
      11657        exact Or.inl h
      11658  /-! ### X-h . Schwarz Reflection Chain: ZetaZeros is Reflection-Closed -/
      11659  
      11660  /-- Auxiliary: conjugation reflects differentiability. -/
      11661  theorem differentiableAt_star_comp {f : Point → Point} {x : Point}
      11662      (hf : DifferentiableAt ℂ f (star x)) :
      11663      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y => star (f (star y))) x := by
      11664    obtain ⟨Df, hDf⟩ := hf
      11665    have hstar_smul : ∀ c z : Point, star (c • z) = (star c) • (star z) := by
      11666      intro c z
      11667      rw [smul_eq_mul, star_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      11668    have norm_star : ∀ w : Point, ‖star w‖ = ‖w‖ := fun w => Complex.norm_conj w
      11669    let D : Point →L[ℂ] Point :=
      11670      { toFun := fun z => star (Df (star z)),
      11671        map_add' := fun a b => by
      11672          show star (Df (star (a + b))) = star (Df (star a)) + star (Df (star b))
      11673          rw [star_add, map_add, star_add],
      11674        map_smul' := fun c z => by
      11675          show star (Df (star (c • z))) = c • star (Df (star z))
      11676          rw [hstar_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, star_mul, star_star, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm],
      11677        cont := (continuous_star.comp (Df.cont.comp continuous_star)) }
      11678    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
      11679    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      11680    have hD : ∀ y : Point, D (y - x) = star (Df ((star y) - (star x))) := by
      11681      intro y
      11682      show star (Df (star (y - x))) = star (Df (star y - star x))
      11683      rw [star_sub]
      11684    have hnorm : ∀ y : Point, ‖(star y) - (star x)‖ = ‖y - x‖ := by
      11685      intro y
      11686      rw [← star_sub, norm_star]
      11687    have key : ∀ y : Point, ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y)) - star (f (star x)) - D (y - x)‖
      11688        = ‖(star y) - (star x)‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11689      intro y
      11690      calc ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y)) - star (f (star x)) - D (y - x)‖
      11691          = ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x)))‖ := by
      11692            congr 1
      11693            rw [hD y, star_sub, star_sub]
      11694        _ = ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11695            rw [norm_star]
      11696        _ = ‖(star y) - (star x)‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11697            rw [hnorm]
      11698    simp_rw [key]
      11699    have hDf' : Filter.Tendsto
      11700        (fun u => ‖u - star x‖⁻¹ * ‖f u - f (star x) - Df (u - star x)‖)
      11701        (nhds (star x)) (nhds 0) := by
      11702      rwa [← hasFDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      11703    have hstar_cont : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : Point => star y) (nhds x) (nhds (star x)) :=
      11704      (continuous_star.tendsto x)
      11705    exact hDf'.comp hstar_cont
      11706  
      11707  /-- Auxiliary: star of a nat-cast complex power. -/
      11708  theorem star_natCast_cpow (n : ℕ) (t : Point) :
      11709      star (((n:Point)) ^ (star t)) = ((n:Point)) ^ t := by
      11710    have harg : ((n:Point)).arg ≠ Real.pi := by
      11711      rw [Complex.natCast_arg]
      11712      exact (Real.pi_ne_zero).symm
      11713    have h2 := Complex.cpow_conj ((n:Point)) t harg
      11714    show (starRingEnd ℂ) (↑n ^ (starRingEnd ℂ) t) = ↑n ^ t
      11715    rw [h2]
      11716    have hinv : ∀ W : Point, (starRingEnd ℂ) ((starRingEnd ℂ) W) = W := by
      11717      intro W
      11718      show star (star W) = W
      11719      exact star_star W
      11720    rw [hinv, map_natCast]
      11721  
      11722  /-- Schwarz reflection for the Riemann zeta function. -/
      11723  theorem zeta_schwarz_reflection (s : Point) (hs : s ≠ 1) :
      11724      riemannZeta (star s) = star (riemannZeta s) := by
      11725    have hF_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) {1}ᶜ := by
      11726      intro x hx
      11727      rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      11728      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      11729      apply differentiableAt_star_comp
      11730      apply differentiableAt_riemannZeta
      11731      intro hcon
      11732      apply hx
      11733      have hxx : x = star (star x) := (star_star x).symm
      11734      rw [hxx, hcon, star_one]
      11735    have hF_analytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) {1}ᶜ :=
      11736      DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd hF_diff isOpen_compl_singleton
      11737    have hzeta_analytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ riemannZeta {1}ᶜ := by
      11738      apply DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd
      11739      · intro x hx
      11740        rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      11741        exact (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hx).differentiableWithinAt
      11742      · exact isOpen_compl_singleton
      11743    have hEqOn : Set.EqOn (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) riemannZeta {t : Point | 1 < t.re} := by
      11744      intro t ht
      11745      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ht
      11746      have ht_star : (1:ℝ) < (star t).re := by
      11747        have hre : (star t).re = t.re := Complex.conj_re t
      11748        rw [hre]; exact ht
      11749      show star (riemannZeta (star t)) = riemannZeta t
      11750      rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow ht_star, zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow ht, tsum_star]
      11751      apply tsum_congr
      11752      intro n
      11753      rw [star_div₀, star_one, star_natCast_cpow]
      11754    have hnbhd : {t : Point | 1 < t.re} ∈ nhds (2:Point) := by
      11755      apply IsOpen.mem_nhds
      11756      · exact Complex.continuous_re.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Ioi
      11757      · simp
      11758    have hev : (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) =ᶠ[nhds 2] riemannZeta :=
      11759      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnbhd hEqOn
      11760    have hpre : IsPreconnected ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by
      11761      apply IsConnected.isPreconnected
      11762      refine isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank ?_ (1:Point)
      11763      rw [Complex.rank_real_complex]
      11764      norm_num
      11765    have h2 : (2:Point) ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by simp
      11766    have hEq := AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
      11767      hF_analytic hzeta_analytic hpre h2 hev
      11768    have hs_mem : s ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by simpa using hs
      11769    have hFs := hEq hs_mem
      11770    simp only at hFs
      11771    have hcon := congrArg star hFs
      11772    simp only [star_star] at hcon
      11773    exact hcon
      11774  
      11775  /-- Zeta does not vanish at negative odd integers. -/
      11776  theorem zeta_ne_zero_neg_odd (k : ℕ) : riemannZeta (-(2 * (k : Point) + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
      11777    have hwre : (2 * (k:Point) + 2).re = 2 * (k:ℝ) + 2 := by
      11778      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.natCast_re]
      11779    have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      11780    have hw1 : (2:Point) * (k:Point) + 2 ≠ 1 := by
      11781      intro h
      11782      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11783      rw [hwre] at hre
      11784      simp at hre
      11785      linarith
      11786    have hw_neg : ∀ n : ℕ, (2:Point) * (k:Point) + 2 ≠ -((n:Point)) := by
      11787      intro n h
      11788      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11789      rw [hwre] at hre
      11790      simp [Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hre
      11791      have hn0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      11792      linarith
      11793    have hfe := riemannZeta_one_sub (s := 2*(k:Point)+2) hw_neg hw1
      11794    have h1w : (1:Point) - (2*(k:Point)+2) = -(2 * (k:Point) + 1) := by ring
      11795    rw [h1w] at hfe
      11796    rw [hfe]
      11797    apply mul_ne_zero
      11798    apply mul_ne_zero
      11799    apply mul_ne_zero
      11800    apply mul_ne_zero
      11801    · norm_num
      11802    · have h2pi_ne : ((2:Point) * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by
      11803        apply mul_ne_zero
      11804        · norm_num
      11805        · exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
      11806      rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero h2pi_ne]
      11807      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      11808    · apply Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
      11809      rw [hwre]
      11810      linarith
      11811    · have hcos_arg : (Real.pi:Point) * (2*(k:Point)+2) / 2 = (((Real.pi * ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ) : ℝ)):Point) := by
      11812        push_cast
      11813        ring
      11814      have hcos_val : Real.cos (Real.pi * ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ)) = (-1)^((k+1:ℕ)) := by
      11815        have h := Real.cos_add_nat_mul_pi (0:ℝ) (k+1)
      11816        rw [zero_add, Real.cos_zero, mul_one] at h
      11817        rw [mul_comm Real.pi]
      11818        exact h
      11819      have hne : ((-1:ℝ)^((k+1:ℕ))) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      11820      rw [hcos_arg, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, hcos_val]
      11821      exact_mod_cast hne
      11822    · apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
      11823      rw [hwre]
      11824      linarith
      11825  
      11826  /-- Nontrivial zeros avoid the nonpositive integers. -/
      11827  theorem zeta_zeros_not_neg_nat {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≠ -(n : Point) := by
      11828    intro n h
      11829    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11830    rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      11831    · rcases k with _ | k
      11832      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
      11833        subst hn0
      11834        simp at h
      11835        rw [h, riemannZeta_zero] at hz0
      11836        norm_num at hz0
      11837      · have hn : n = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
      11838        subst hn
      11839        apply hz1
      11840        use k
      11841        rw [h]
      11842        push_cast
      11843        ring
      11844    · have hn : n = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
      11845      subst hn
      11846      have hs : s = -(2 * (k:Point) + 1) := by
      11847        rw [h]
      11848        push_cast
      11849        ring
      11850      rw [hs] at hz0
      11851      exact (zeta_ne_zero_neg_odd k) hz0
      11852  
      11853  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11854  theorem zeta_zeros_symm {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11855    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11856    have hne := zeta_zeros_not_neg_nat ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩
      11857    have hfe := riemannZeta_one_sub (s := s) hne hz2
      11858    show ZetaZeros (1 - s)
      11859    constructor
      11860    · rw [hfe, hz0, mul_zero]
      11861    · constructor
      11862      · intro ⟨m, hm⟩
      11863        have hs : s = 1 + 2 * ((m:Point) + 1) := by linear_combination -hm
      11864        have hre : s.re = 1 + 2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) := by
      11865          rw [hs]
      11866          simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.natCast_re]
      11867        have h1lt : (1:ℝ) < s.re := by
      11868          rw [hre]
      11869          have hm0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      11870          linarith
      11871        exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re h1lt) hz0
      11872      · intro hcon
      11873        have hs0 : s = 0 := by linear_combination -hcon
      11874        have hne0 := hne 0
      11875        simp at hne0
      11876        exact hne0 hs0
      11877  
      11878  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under the point reflection. -/
      11879  theorem zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt ZetaZeros :=
      11880    fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_symm hz
      11881  
      11882  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under conjugation. -/
      11883  theorem zeta_zeros_conj {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (star s) := by
      11884    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11885    constructor
      11886    · rw [zeta_schwarz_reflection s hz2, hz0, star_zero]
      11887    · constructor
      11888      · intro ⟨n, hn⟩
      11889        apply hz1
      11890        use n
      11891        have hss : s = star (star s) := (star_star s).symm
      11892        rw [hss, hn]
      11893        simp
      11894      · intro hcon
      11895        apply hz2
      11896        have hss : s = star (star s) := (star_star s).symm
      11897        rw [hss, hcon, star_one]
      11898  
      11899  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under the conjugate reflection fold. -/
      11900  theorem zeta_zeros_closed : Closed ZetaZeros :=
      11901    fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_symm (zeta_zeros_conj hz)
      11902  
      11903  /-- Retraction injectivity on ZetaZeros is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis. -/
      11904  theorem retraction_injective_iff_rh : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=
      11905    (closed_retraction_injective_iff_value zeta_zeros_closed).1.trans h_read_proved.symm
      11906  
      11907  /-- From retraction injectivity, the 1-bit bridge delivers the Riemann Hypothesis. -/
      11908  theorem rh_from_retraction_injective (h_inj : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros) :
      11909      LeastErasure ZetaZeros ∧ RiemannHypothesis :=
      11910    rh_from_closed_and_retraction_injective zeta_zeros_closed h_inj
      11911  
      11912  /-- Nontrivial zeros lie in the closed critical strip 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1. -/
      11913  theorem zeta_zeros_in_strip {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : 0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1 := by
      11914    have hle : ∀ {w : Point}, ZetaZeros w → w.re ≤ 1 := by
      11915      intro w hw
      11916      by_contra h
      11917      push_neg at h
      11918      exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re h) hw.1
      11919    have h1 : s.re ≤ 1 := hle hz
      11920    have h0 : (foldPt s).re ≤ 1 := hle (zeta_zeros_symm hz)
      11921    unfold foldPt at h0
      11922    simp only [sub_re, one_re] at h0
      11923    exact ⟨by linarith, h1⟩
      11924  
      11925  /-- The zero set coincides with its intersection with the closed critical strip 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1. -/
      11926  theorem zeta_zeros_iff_strip : ZetaZeros = {s | (0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧ ZetaZeros s} := by
      11927    funext s
      11928    apply propext
      11929    exact ⟨fun hz => ⟨zeta_zeros_in_strip hz, hz⟩, fun ⟨_, hz⟩ => hz⟩
      11930
