      12123  
      12124  /-- THE SOCKET AND ATOMIC NECESSITY AT ZETAZEROS OVER ℂ: because ZetaZeros is
      12125      unconditionally reflection-closed (zeta_zeros_closed), a fixed-point witness
      12126      bundle ActualZeros exists at the unprojected ZetaZeros if and only if Mathlib's
      12127      RiemannHypothesis holds, and every proof of RiemannHypothesis from any premise Q
      12128      is a supply of that bundle. -/
      12129  theorem socket_at_zeta_zeros :
      12130      ((∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12131      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros) := by
      12132    have h_iff : (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=
      12133      ⟨fun ⟨Z, hZ⟩ => h_read_proved.mpr (hZ ▸ value_from_the_act Z),
      12134       fun hrh => ⟨⟨ZetaZeros, zeta_zeros_closed, h_id_proved.mp hrh⟩, rfl⟩⟩
      12135    exact ⟨h_iff, fun _ hQ q => h_iff.mpr (hQ q)⟩
      12136  
      12137  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.socket_at_zeta_zeros' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12138  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.socket_at_zeta_zeros
      12139  
      12140  /-! ### X-i . The Cross-Chart Locus Identity: Part VIII's Carrier in the Plane -/
      12141  
      12142  /-- THE CROSS-CHART LOCUS IDENTITY. Part VIII's carrier, read back through its chart by
      12143      `carrier_to_zero` and embedded by φC, carries charge conjugation to the complex fold,
      12144      annihilation to the complex retraction, and the neutral sector to the critical line. -/
      12145  theorem carrier_embeds_in_complex (c : PhysicoFormal.PhysicalCarrier) :
      12146      φC (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero (PhysicoFormal.C c)) =
      12147          fold (φC (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c)) ∧
      12148      φC (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero (PhysicoFormal.annihilate c)) =
      12149          reg (φC (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c)) ∧
      12150      (PhysicoFormal.Neutral c ↔ onLine (φC (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c))) := by
      12151    obtain ⟨hf, hr, hl⟩ := discrete_chart_embeds_in_complex (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c)
      12152    have hC : PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero (PhysicoFormal.C c) =
      12153        BoundChain.fold (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c) := by
      12154      conv_lhs => rw [← PhysicoFormal.map_right_inverse c]
      12155      rw [← PhysicoFormal.map_fold, PhysicoFormal.map_left_inverse]
      12156      rfl
      12157    have hA : PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero (PhysicoFormal.annihilate c) =
      12158        BoundChain.reg (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c) := by
      12159      conv_lhs => rw [← PhysicoFormal.map_right_inverse c]
      12160      rw [← PhysicoFormal.map_reg, PhysicoFormal.map_left_inverse]
      12161      rfl
      12162    have hN : PhysicoFormal.Neutral c ↔ BoundChain.onLine (PhysicoFormal.carrier_to_zero c) := by
      12163      conv_lhs => rw [← PhysicoFormal.map_right_inverse c]
      12164      exact PhysicoFormal.map_neutral_iff_onLine _
      12165    exact ⟨by rw [hC]; exact hf, by rw [hA]; exact hr, hN.trans hl.symm⟩
      12166  
      12167  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.carrier_embeds_in_complex' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12168  #guard_msgs in
      12169  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.carrier_embeds_in_complex
      12170  
      12171  /-! ### X-k . The Cone: One Apex, Every Reading, No Category Gap -/
      12172  
      12173  /-- The readings of the apex: the four registers' readings of the one bit. -/
      12174  inductive ApexReading where
      12175    | leastErasure
      12176    | retraction
      12177    | socket
      12178    | coincidence
      12179    deriving DecidableEq, Repr
      12180  
      12181  /-- The diagram: each reading as a proposition over ℂ. -/
      12182  def apexDiagram : ApexReading → Prop
      12183    | .leastErasure => LeastErasure ZetaZeros
      12184    | .retraction   => RetractionInjective ZetaZeros
      12185    | .socket       => ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros
      12186    | .coincidence  => ∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s
      12187  
      12188  /-- THE CONE: Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is the apex; every leg is a proved
      12189      equivalence. The category gaps between the readings are eliminated: a gap is
      12190      the absence of an identity leg, and every leg is exhibited here. -/
      12191  theorem apex_cone : ∀ r, apexDiagram r ↔ RiemannHypothesis := by
      12192    intro r
      12193    cases r
      12194    · exact h_id_proved.symm
      12195    · exact retraction_injective_iff_rh
      12196    · exact socket_at_zeta_zeros.1
      12197    · exact ra_coincidence_iff_rh
      12198  
      12199  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.apex_cone' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12200  #guard_msgs in
      12201  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.apex_cone
      12202  
      12203  /-- ONE GAP: any two readings are the same proposition. -/
      12204  theorem apex_one_gap (r s : ApexReading) : apexDiagram r ↔ apexDiagram s :=
      12205    (apex_cone r).trans (apex_cone s).symm
      12206  
      12207  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.apex_one_gap' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12208  #guard_msgs in
      12209  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.apex_one_gap
      12210  
      12211  /-- THE HALT: every proposition proved equivalent to the apex lands on the same
      12212      apex as the four readings. -/
      12213  theorem apex_regress_halts (P : Prop) (hP : P ↔ RiemannHypothesis) (r : ApexReading) :
      12214      P ↔ apexDiagram r :=
      12215    hP.trans (apex_cone r).symm
      12216  
      12217  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.apex_regress_halts' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12218  #guard_msgs in
      12219  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.apex_regress_halts
      12220  
      12221  /-- THE BIT READ TWICE: the delivered record-bit and the identification, one bit
      12222      with two readings — the cargo loop's geometric read and the formal read. -/
      12223  theorem bit_read_twice :
      12224      LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧ (RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) :=
      12225    ⟨cargo_at_zeros, h_id_proved⟩
      12226  
      12227  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.bit_read_twice' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12228  #guard_msgs in
      12229  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.bit_read_twice
      12230  
      12231  /-! ### X-l . Pause and Look Back: The Unconditional Retrospective Seal -/
      12232  
      12233  /-- No principle shared by all conjugate-reflection-closed subsets of ℂ forces
      12234      critical-line inclusion. -/
      12235  theorem no_closed_principle_decides (D : Config → Prop) (hD : ∀ S, Closed S → D S) :
      12236      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D S → Value S :=
      12237    fun hall => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      12238      (hall _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) (hD _ (pair_world_closed offPoint)))
      12239  
      12240  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.no_closed_principle_decides' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12241  #guard_msgs in
      12242  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.no_closed_principle_decides
      12243  
      12244  /-- THE PAUSE AT THE TERMINAL CARGO. Every nontrivial zero s lands in the
      12245      retracted record Rec ZetaZeros at reg s, where retraction is idempotent
      12246      and reflection partners collide. -/
      12247  def Pause : Prop :=
      12248    ∀ s, ZetaZeros s →
      12249      Rec ZetaZeros (reg s) ∧ reg (reg s) = reg s ∧ reg (fold s) = reg s
      12250  
      12251  /-- The Pause is inhabited unconditionally by a closed term. -/
      12252  theorem pause_is_unconditional : Pause :=
      12253    fun s hs => ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, reg_idem s, reg_fold s⟩
      12254  
      12255  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.pause_is_unconditional' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12256  #guard_msgs in
      12257  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.pause_is_unconditional
      12258  
      12259  /-- THE UNCONDITIONAL FORWARD PASS. From FreedomRoot through strip confinement,
      12260      reflection closure, self-verifying record cargo, and the Pause, every step
      12261      is established with zero hypotheses. -/
      12262  theorem forward_pass_unconditional :
      12263      BoundChain.FreedomRoot ∧
      12264      Closed ZetaZeros ∧
      12265      (∀ s, ZetaZeros s → 0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧
      12266      LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      12267      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) ∧
      12268      Pause :=
      12269    ⟨BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited,
      12270     zeta_zeros_closed,
      12271     fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_in_strip hz,
      12272     cargo_at_zeros,
      12273     ra_recursion_at_record.2.1,
      12274     pause_is_unconditional⟩
      12275  
      12276  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.forward_pass_unconditional' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12277  #guard_msgs in
      12278  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.forward_pass_unconditional
      12279  
      12280  /-- LOOK BACK. At the inhabited Pause locus Rec ZetaZeros (reg s), reading
      12281      retraction invariance back onto the preimage s gives reg s = s. -/
      12282  def LookBack : Prop :=
      12283    ∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros (reg s) → reg s = s
      12284  
      12285  /-- LookBack is logically identical to the cargo-transfer bridge and to
      12286      Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis. -/
      12287  theorem look_back_is_the_closure :
      12288      (LookBack ↔ (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros)) ∧
      12289      (LookBack ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      12290    have h_lb : LookBack ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros :=
      12291      ⟨fun h s hs => h s hs ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, fun h s hs _ => h s hs⟩
      12292    exact ⟨h_lb.trans (zeta_ra_loop.1.trans h_id_proved).symm,
      12293           h_lb.trans h_id_proved.symm⟩

      12296  #guard_msgs in

      12299  /-- THE UNCONDITIONAL RETROSPECTIVE SEAL (TIER T, ZERO PREMISES).
      12300      Binds the entire unconditional forward pass from FreedomRoot to Pause,
      12301      the identity of LookBack with RiemannHypothesis and with every reading of
      12302      the apex cone, the equivalence of LookBack with the ActualZeros socket,
      12303      the atomic necessity that every proof of RiemannHypothesis from any
      12304      premise Q supplies LookBack, and the refusal of every shared closed
      12305      principle over ℂ. -/
      12306  theorem the_unconditional_retrospective_seal :
      12307      BoundChain.FreedomRoot ∧
      12308      Closed ZetaZeros ∧
      12309      (∀ s, ZetaZeros s → 0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧
      12310      LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      12311      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) ∧
      12312      Pause ∧
      12313      (LookBack ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12314      (∀ r, LookBack ↔ apexDiagram r) ∧
      12315      ((∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros) ↔ LookBack) ∧
      12316      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q → LookBack) ∧
      12317      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) →
      12318        ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D S → Value S) :=
      12319    ⟨BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited,
      12320     zeta_zeros_closed,
      12321     fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_in_strip hz,
      12322     cargo_at_zeros,
      12323     ra_recursion_at_record.2.1,
      12324     pause_is_unconditional,
      12325     look_back_is_the_closure.2,
      12326     fun r => look_back_is_the_closure.2.trans (apex_cone r).symm,
      12327     socket_at_zeta_zeros.1.trans look_back_is_the_closure.2.symm,
      12328     fun _ hQ q => look_back_is_the_closure.2.mpr (hQ q),
      12329     no_closed_principle_decides⟩

      12331  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.the_unconditional_retrospective_seal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12332  #guard_msgs in
      12333  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.the_unconditional_retrospective_seal

      12337  theorem rh_from_pause_and_look_back (h_look : LookBack) :

      12345  /-- THE CANONICAL RECORD HYPOTHESIS (`CanonicalRH`). Every point of the
      12346      retracted record `Rec ZetaZeros` lies on the critical line, proved
      12347      unconditionally with zero premises (`canonical_rh_unconditional`). This is
      12348      the projection-side invariant: `reg` lands on the line by definition
      12349      (`reg_lands`). The bridge from the projection back to the unprojected zeros
      12350      is `LookBack`, proved identical to `RiemannHypothesis`
      12351      (`look_back_is_the_closure`). -/
      12352  def CanonicalRH : Prop := Value (Rec ZetaZeros)
      12353  
      12354  /-- Every point of the projected zero set lies on the critical line, with zero
      12355      premises. -/
      12356  theorem canonical_rh_unconditional : CanonicalRH :=
      12357    the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros
      12358  
      12359  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.canonical_rh_unconditional' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12360  #guard_msgs in
      12361  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.canonical_rh_unconditional
      12362  
      12363  /-- The projection property is not special to `ZetaZeros`: the retracted record
      12364      of every configuration lies on the critical line, including the closed
      12365      pair-world configuration with a point off the line. -/
      12366  theorem canonical_property_holds_off_the_line :
      12367      Value (Rec (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
      12368    the_remembered_is_lossless (pairWorld offPoint)
      12369  
      12370  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.canonical_property_holds_off_the_line' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12371  #guard_msgs in
      12372  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.canonical_property_holds_off_the_line
      12373  
      12374  /-- The Monism witness lifted to complex configurations S ⊆ ℂ. -/
      12375  def RootReadTwice (S : Config) : Prop :=
      12376    RememberedOffered.MonismWitness (fun _ => Value S)
      12377  
      12378  /-- On every complex configuration, the Monism witness is equivalent to Value. -/
      12379  theorem root_read_twice_iff_value (S : Config) :
      12380      RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S :=
      12381    ⟨fun w => w.seed,
      12382     fun hv => ⟨RememberedOffered.one_involution_constructed, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, hv⟩⟩
      12383  
      12384  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.root_read_twice_iff_value' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12385  #guard_msgs in
      12386  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.root_read_twice_iff_value
      12387  
      12388  /-- The retracted record Rec ZetaZeros unconditionally carries the Monism witness. -/
      12389  theorem canonical_record_carries_monism : RootReadTwice (Rec ZetaZeros) :=
      12390    (root_read_twice_iff_value (Rec ZetaZeros)).mpr canonical_rh_unconditional
      12391  
      12392  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.canonical_record_carries_monism' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12393  #guard_msgs in
      12394  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.canonical_record_carries_monism
      12395  
      12396  /-- On ℂ, the line-bound world and the off-line pair world share one projected
      12397      record, and the Monism witness separates them: the true world carries monism
      12398      and the false world carries no monism. -/
      12399  theorem monism_separates_shared_record :
      12400      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
      12401      RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧
      12402      ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
      12403    ⟨one_record offPoint,
      12404     (root_read_twice_iff_value _).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint),
      12405     fun w => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off w.seed⟩
      12406  
      12407  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.monism_separates_shared_record' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12408  #guard_msgs in
      12409  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.monism_separates_shared_record
      12410  
      12411  /-- THE CANONICAL NORMAL-FORM BRIDGE. CanonicalRH and the Monism witness hold
      12412      unconditionally at the projected record Rec ZetaZeros, and carrying
      12413      CanonicalRH to ZetaZeros (or equating CanonicalRH with the Monism witness
      12414      at ZetaZeros) is logically identical to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis. -/
      12415  theorem canonical_normal_form_bridge :
      12416      CanonicalRH ∧
      12417      RootReadTwice (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      12418      ((CanonicalRH → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12419      ((CanonicalRH ↔ RootReadTwice ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      12420    refine ⟨canonical_rh_unconditional, canonical_record_carries_monism, ?_, ?_⟩
      12421    · exact ⟨fun h => h_id_proved.mpr (h canonical_rh_unconditional),
      12422             fun hrh _ => h_id_proved.mp hrh⟩
      12423    · exact ⟨fun h => h_read_proved.mpr ((root_read_twice_iff_value ZetaZeros).mp (h.mp canonical_rh_unconditional)),
      12424             fun hrh => ⟨fun _ => (root_read_twice_iff_value ZetaZeros).mpr (h_read_proved.mp hrh),
      12425                         fun _ => canonical_rh_unconditional⟩⟩
      12426  
      12427  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.canonical_normal_form_bridge' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12428  #guard_msgs in
      12429  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.canonical_normal_form_bridge
      12430  
      12431  /-- The Euler product boundary on ZetaZeros: Mathlib's Euler product and
      12432      Dirichlet series establish non-vanishing for 1 < Re s, so every nontrivial
      12433      zero has Re s ≤ 1, and the reflection s ↦ 1 − s (`zeta_zeros_symm`) carries
      12434      the bound to 0 ≤ Re s. Mathlib's non-vanishing on Re s = 1 makes both
      12435      bounds strict (`zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip`). -/
      12436  theorem euler_product_boundary (s : Point) (hs : ZetaZeros s) :
      12437      (0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧ ¬ (1 < s.re) := by
      12438    have h := zeta_zeros_in_strip hs
      12439    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      12440    intro hgt
      12441    linarith
      12442  
      12443  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.euler_product_boundary' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12444  #guard_msgs in
      12445  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.euler_product_boundary
      12446  
      12447  /-- Non-vanishing in the right half of the critical strip, 1/2 < Re s. With
      12448      Mathlib's non-vanishing on Re s ≥ 1, its whole content is the band
      12449      1/2 < Re s < 1 (`right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band`). -/
      12450  def RightHalfStripZeroFree : Prop :=
      12451    ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → 1 / 2 < s.re → False
      12452  
      12453  /-- ANALYTIC TARGET REDUCTION (TIER T, ZERO PREMISES). Binds CanonicalRH,
      12454      the complex Monism witness at the record, and the Euler product boundary
      12455      (Re s ≤ 1), and proves unconditionally via conjugate-reflection closure
      12456      (zeta_zeros_closed) that RetractionInjective ZetaZeros, LookBack,
      12457      RootReadTwice ZetaZeros, and Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis reduce to
      12458      non-vanishing in the right half-strip 1/2 < Re s ≤ 1. -/
      12459  theorem analytic_target_reduction :
      12460      CanonicalRH ∧
      12461      RootReadTwice (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      12462      (∀ s, ZetaZeros s → (0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧ ¬ (1 < s.re)) ∧
      12463      (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RetractionInjective ZetaZeros) ∧
      12464      (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ LookBack) ∧
      12465      (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RootReadTwice ZetaZeros) ∧
      12466      ((CanonicalRH → RightHalfStripZeroFree) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12467      (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      12468    have h_rh : RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RiemannHypothesis := by
      12469      rw [h_read_proved]
      12470      constructor
      12471      · intro h s hs
      12472        have h1 : s.re ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      12473          by_contra hgt
      12474          push_neg at hgt
      12475          exact h s hs hgt
      12476        have h2 : (fold s).re ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      12477          by_contra hgt
      12478          push_neg at hgt
      12479          exact h (fold s) (zeta_zeros_closed s hs) hgt
      12480        have h3 : (fold s).re = 1 - s.re := by
      12481          unfold fold
      12482          simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re]
      12483        unfold onLine
      12484        linarith
      12485      · intro hv s hs hgt
      12486        have heq : s.re = 1 / 2 := hv s hs
      12487        linarith
      12488    have h_rrt : RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RootReadTwice ZetaZeros :=
      12489      h_rh.trans (h_read_proved.trans (root_read_twice_iff_value ZetaZeros).symm)
      12490    have h_can : (CanonicalRH → RightHalfStripZeroFree) ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=
      12491      ⟨fun h => h_rh.mp (h canonical_rh_unconditional),
      12492       fun hrh _ => h_rh.mpr hrh⟩
      12493    exact ⟨canonical_rh_unconditional,
      12494           canonical_record_carries_monism,
      12495           euler_product_boundary,
      12496           h_rh.trans retraction_injective_iff_rh.symm,
      12497           h_rh.trans look_back_is_the_closure.2.symm,
      12498           h_rrt,
      12499           h_can,
      12500           h_rh⟩
      12501  
      12502  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.analytic_target_reduction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12503  #guard_msgs in
      12504  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.analytic_target_reduction
      12505  
      12506  /-- THE JOINT PHYSICO-FORMAL SEAL OVER ℂ. Joining the physical carrier closure
      12507      of Part VIII (`classical_rh_from_physico_formal_closure`) with the complex
      12508      normal form of Part X (`look_back_is_the_closure`): under the discrete-to-complex
      12509      reading `LookBack ↔ RememberedOffered.Value Zζ`, the physical carrier floors
      12510      and certified observational bound supply `LookBack` and discharge Mathlib's
      12511      `RiemannHypothesis` in one step. -/
      12512  theorem physico_formal_supplies_look_back_and_rh
      12513      {Zζ : RememberedOffered.Config} {n0 r0 T0 T : Nat}
      12514      (realized : PhysicoFormal.PhysicalCarrier → Prop)
      12515      (population rate : PhysicoFormal.PhysicalCarrier → Nat)
      12516      (B : PhysicoFormal.CertifiedObservationalBound)
      12517      (h_read    : LookBack ↔ RememberedOffered.Value Zζ)
      12518      (h_realize : ∀ p, Zζ p → realized (PhysicoFormal.map_zero_to_carrier p))
      12519      (h_pop     : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ PhysicoFormal.Neutral c → population c ≥ n0)
      12520      (h_rate    : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ PhysicoFormal.Neutral c → rate c ≥ r0)
      12521      (h_temp    : T ≥ T0)
      12522      (h_couple  : ∀ c, realized c → ¬ PhysicoFormal.Neutral c →
      12523                     B.R ≥ LeastErasureDoF.residual (population c) (rate c)
      12524                       (PhysicoFormal.landauerHeatPerEvent T))
      12525      (h_gap     : B.ε < PhysicoFormal.detectionGap n0 r0 T0) :
      12526      LookBack ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
      12527    have h_lb : LookBack :=
      12528      PhysicoFormal.classical_rh_from_physico_formal_closure
      12529        realized population rate B h_read h_realize h_pop h_rate h_temp h_couple h_gap
      12530    exact ⟨h_lb, rh_from_pause_and_look_back h_lb⟩
      12531  
      12532  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.physico_formal_supplies_look_back_and_rh' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12533  #guard_msgs in
      12534  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.physico_formal_supplies_look_back_and_rh
      12535  
      12536  /-- The record's least erasure as a Part III self-grounding root, a closed term: one act,
      12537      and every act instances `LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)` by `cargo_at_zeros`. It supplies
      12538      the self-grounding argument of `RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked` at
      12539      the record of the zeros, so the Round 2 theorems below carry no premise. -/
      12540  noncomputable def record_self_grounding_RO :
      12541      RememberedOffered.SelfGrounding (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) :=
      12542    ⟨Unit, (), fun _ => cargo_at_zeros⟩
      12543  
      12544  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.record_self_grounding_RO' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12545  #guard_msgs in
      12546  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.record_self_grounding_RO
      12547  
      12548  /-- ROUND 2, STEP 1: THE HALT OF EVERY UNIFORM ROUTE. Round 1 closed the apex: every reading
      12549      of the bit is one proposition (`apex_one_gap`). Round 2 halts for every route uniform
      12550      over reflection-closed configurations: on Part III's
      12551      discrete chart no derivation valid at every closed configuration yields the value
      12552      (`RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked`, at `record_self_grounding_RO`).
      12553      No premise. -/
      12554  theorem round2_halted_uniduction :
      12555      (∀ r s : ApexReading, apexDiagram r ↔ apexDiagram s) ∧
      12556      ¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
      12557        RememberedOffered.Value S :=
      12558    ⟨apex_one_gap,
      12559     (RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked record_self_grounding_RO).1⟩
      12560  
      12561  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.round2_halted_uniduction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12562  #guard_msgs in
      12563  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.round2_halted_uniduction
      12564  
      12565  /-- ROUND 2, STEP 2: RESIDUAL MONISM. Over ℂ the line-bound configuration
      12566      `registered offPoint` and the off-line pair world share one record, and the Monism
      12567      witness, provably equivalent to the value on every configuration
      12568      (`root_read_twice_iff_value`), holds
      12569      on the first and fails on the second. The type is that of
      12570      `monism_separates_shared_record`. No premise. -/
      12571  theorem round2_residual_monism :
      12572      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
      12573      RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧
      12574      ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
      12575    monism_separates_shared_record
      12576  
      12577  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.round2_residual_monism' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12578  #guard_msgs in
      12579  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.round2_residual_monism
      12580  
      12581  /-- ROUND 2, COMPLETE: Step 1 (`round2_halted_uniduction`) and Step 2
      12582      (`round2_residual_monism`) in one conjunction. No premise. -/
      12583  theorem round2_absolute_closure :
      12584      ((∀ r s : ApexReading, apexDiagram r ↔ apexDiagram s) ∧
      12585       ¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
      12586         RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
      12587      (SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
      12588       RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧
      12589       ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
      12590    ⟨round2_halted_uniduction, round2_residual_monism⟩
      12591  
      12592  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.round2_absolute_closure' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12593  #guard_msgs in
      12594  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.round2_absolute_closure
      12595  
      12596  /-- EVERY ROUTE PASSES THE BIT. Any proof of `RiemannHypothesis`, from any premise `Q`,
      12597      analytic or otherwise, delivers `RightHalfStripZeroFree`, `LookBack`, retraction
      12598      injectivity of the zeros and the Monism witness at the zeros: each is proved
      12599      equivalent to the hypothesis (`analytic_target_reduction`), so no route to the
      12600      hypothesis avoids the 1-bit. Its content is that `RiemannHypothesis` implies each of
      12601      the four; the premise `Q` types the reading that any route delivers them. No premise. -/
      12602  theorem every_route_passes_the_bit :
      12603      ∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q →
      12604        RightHalfStripZeroFree ∧ LookBack ∧ RetractionInjective ZetaZeros ∧
      12605          RootReadTwice ZetaZeros := by
      12606    intro _ h q
      12607    have hH : RightHalfStripZeroFree :=
      12608      analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.mpr (h q)
      12609    exact ⟨hH, analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.1.mp hH,
      12610      analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.1.mp hH, analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.1.mp hH⟩
      12611  
      12612  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.every_route_passes_the_bit' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12613  #guard_msgs in
      12614  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.every_route_passes_the_bit
      12615  
      12616  /-- THE ANALYTIC ROUTE, LOCATED AND CLOSED ON THE BIT. (1) On Part III's discrete chart no
      12617      derivation valid at every reflection-closed configuration yields the value
      12618      (`RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked`). (2) The analytic target is
      12619      exactly `RightHalfStripZeroFree`, proved equivalent to `RiemannHypothesis`
      12620      (`analytic_target_reduction`). (3) Round 2 halts for every uniform route
      12621      (`round2_halted_uniduction`). (4) Every route to `RiemannHypothesis`, from any premise,
      12622      delivers `RightHalfStripZeroFree` and `LookBack` (`every_route_passes_the_bit`). A route
      12623      that uses properties of the zeros beyond reflection closure lies outside the class of
      12624      (1); by (4), if it reaches the hypothesis it has supplied the bit. No premise. -/
      12625  theorem analytic_route_sealed :
      12626      (¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
      12627         RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
      12628      (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12629      ((∀ r s : ApexReading, apexDiagram r ↔ apexDiagram s) ∧
      12630       ¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
      12631         RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
      12632      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q →
      12633        RightHalfStripZeroFree ∧ LookBack) := by
      12634    refine ⟨(RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked record_self_grounding_RO).1,
      12635            analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
      12636            round2_halted_uniduction,
      12637            fun Q h q => ⟨(every_route_passes_the_bit Q h q).1,
      12638                          (every_route_passes_the_bit Q h q).2.1⟩⟩
      12639  
      12640  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.analytic_route_sealed' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12641  #guard_msgs in
      12642  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.analytic_route_sealed
      12643  
      12644  /-- Complex Triaxiality (lifted from Part II `PrimeFreedom.three_axis_lock` to ℂ):
      12645      the freedom axis, the reflection-seat axis (`fold s = s`), and the
      12646      displacement-collapse axis (`s.re - 1/2 = -(s.re - 1/2)`). -/
      12647  def freedomAxis (_ : Point) : Prop := True
      12648  def ramAxis (s : Point) : Prop := fold s = s
      12649  def collapseAxis (s : Point) : Prop := s.re - 1 / 2 = -(s.re - 1 / 2)
      12650  
      12651  /-- THE COMPLEX THREE-AXIS LOCK (UNCONDITIONAL, ZERO PREMISES). All three axes
      12652      hold at a complex point s if and only if s lies on the critical line. -/
      12653  theorem complex_three_axis_lock (s : Point) :
      12654      (freedomAxis s ∧ ramAxis s ∧ collapseAxis s) ↔ onLine s := by
      12655    constructor
      12656    · intro ⟨_, hram, _⟩
      12657      exact (fold_fixed_iff_onLine s).mp hram
      12658    · intro h
      12659      refine ⟨trivial, (fold_fixed_iff_onLine s).mpr h, ?_⟩
      12660      unfold collapseAxis onLine at *
      12661      linarith
      12662  
      12663  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.complex_three_axis_lock' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12664  #guard_msgs in

      12666  
      12667  /-- Ground-On-Line (`GOL`): the canonical retracted zero locus `Rec ZetaZeros`. -/
      12668  def GOL : Config := Rec ZetaZeros
      12669  
      12670  /-- GOL LOOKS BACK (UNCONDITIONAL, ZERO PREMISES). At the Ground-On-Line locus
      12671      `GOL`, looking back requires no hypothesis: every point of `GOL` is fixed
      12672      by retraction (`reg q = q`), fixed by the reflection fold (`fold q = q`),
      12673      and locked on all three axes. This is the look-back at the record, and it
      12674      holds at `Rec S` for every configuration `S` (`record_has_least_erasure`).
      12675      At the zeros themselves the look-back is `LookBack`, the self-recognition
      12676      of the zeros (`self_recognition_is_look_back`), one statement with
      12677      `RiemannHypothesis` (`the_self_recognition_closure`). -/
      12678  theorem gol_look_back_unconditional :
      12679      (∀ q, GOL q → reg q = q) ∧
      12680      (∀ q, GOL q → fold q = q) ∧
      12681      (∀ q, GOL q → freedomAxis q ∧ ramAxis q ∧ collapseAxis q) :=
      12682    ⟨cargo_at_zeros,
      12683     fun q hq => (fold_fixed_iff_onLine q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros q hq),
      12684     fun q hq => (complex_three_axis_lock q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros q hq)⟩
      12685  
      12686  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.gol_look_back_unconditional' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12687  #guard_msgs in
      12688  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.gol_look_back_unconditional
      12689  
      12690  /-- THE RA-TRIAXIALITY-GOL-RA LOOP (UNCONDITIONAL, ZERO PREMISES).
      12691      1. Root (`RA`): `TOE0.RA₀` and `BoundChain.FreedomRoot` hold unconditionally.
      12692      2. Triaxiality: the three axes lock onto `onLine` across ℂ.
      12693      3. Pause at `GOL`: every zero projects into `GOL` (`Pause`), where `Value GOL`,
      12694         `LeastErasure GOL`, and `SelfVerifying (LeastErasure GOL)` hold unconditionally.
      12695      4. `GOL` Looks Back and Finds `RA`: at `GOL`, retraction invariance and the
      12696         Monism witness hold unconditionally, closing the biconditional loop back to
      12697         the Root Axiom (`TOE0.RA₀ ↔ Value GOL` and `TOE0.RA₀ ↔ LeastErasure GOL`)
      12698         with zero premises.
      12699      5. Normal-Form Coincidence: Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis` is equivalent to
      12700         the coincidence of `ZetaZeros` with `GOL` (`∀ q, GOL q ↔ ZetaZeros q`). -/
      12701  theorem ra_triaxial_gol_loop_unconditional :
      12702      TOE0.RA₀ ∧
      12703      BoundChain.FreedomRoot ∧
      12704      (∀ s : Point, (freedomAxis s ∧ ramAxis s ∧ collapseAxis s) ↔ onLine s) ∧
      12705      Pause ∧
      12706      Value GOL ∧
      12707      LeastErasure GOL ∧
      12708      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure GOL) ∧
      12709      RememberedOffered.MonismWitness (fun _ => Value GOL) ∧
      12710      (TOE0.RA₀ ↔ Value GOL) ∧
      12711      (TOE0.RA₀ ↔ LeastErasure GOL) ∧
      12712      ((∀ q, GOL q ↔ ZetaZeros q) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) :=
      12713    ⟨TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain,
      12714     BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited,
      12715     complex_three_axis_lock,
      12716     pause_is_unconditional,
      12717     the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros,
      12718     cargo_at_zeros,
      12719     ra_recursion_at_record.2.1,
      12720     ⟨RememberedOffered.one_involution_constructed,
      12721      fun _ _ => Iff.rfl,
      12722      the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros⟩,
      12723     ⟨fun _ => the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros,
      12724      fun _ => TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain⟩,
      12725     ⟨fun _ => cargo_at_zeros,
      12726      fun _ => TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain⟩,
      12727     rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec.symm⟩

      12730  #guard_msgs in
      12731  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.ra_triaxial_gol_loop_unconditional
      12732  
      12733  /-! **THE SELF-RECOGNITION CLOSURE.** Mathlib's non-vanishing of ζ on `1 ≤ Re s`
      12734  (`riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re`) closes both edges of the critical strip. The bit is the
      12735  self-recognition of the zeros, every zero fixed by its own retraction, and seven readings of it
      12736  are proved one statement with `RiemannHypothesis`. `the_self_recognition_closure` binds the
      12737  whole formal arc in one theorem with nothing before the colon. -/
      12738  
      12739  /-- Every nontrivial zero lies strictly inside the critical strip, `0 < Re s < 1`. Mathlib's
      12740      non-vanishing of ζ on `1 ≤ Re s` gives the right edge, and the reflection `s ↦ 1 − s`
      12741      (`zeta_zeros_symm`) carries it to the left edge. -/
      12742  theorem zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip : ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 := by
      12743    have hlt : ∀ {w : Point}, ZetaZeros w → w.re < 1 := by
      12744      intro w hw
      12745      by_contra h
      12746      push_neg at h
      12747      exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re h) hw.1
      12748    intro s hs
      12749    have h1 : s.re < 1 := hlt hs
      12750    have h0 : (foldPt s).re < 1 := hlt (zeta_zeros_symm hs)
      12751    unfold foldPt at h0
      12752    simp only [sub_re, one_re] at h0
      12753    exact ⟨by linarith, h1⟩
      12754  
      12755  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12756  #guard_msgs in
      12757  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip
      12758  
      12759  /-- Every zero of the completed zeta function away from its two junk points `0` and `1` lies
      12760      strictly inside the critical strip: non-vanishing on `1 ≤ Re s` at `s`, and the functional
      12761      equation `completedRiemannZeta_one_sub` at `1 − s`. -/
      12762  theorem completed_zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip :
      12763      ∀ s : Point, CompletedZetaZeros s → 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 := by
      12764    have key : ∀ {w : Point}, w ≠ 0 → completedRiemannZeta w = 0 → w.re < 1 := by
      12765      intro w hw0 hw
      12766      by_contra h
      12767      push_neg at h
      12768      apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re h
      12769      rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hw0, hw, zero_div]
      12770    intro s hc
      12771    obtain ⟨hz, hs0, hs1⟩ := hc
      12772    have h1 : s.re < 1 := key hs0 hz
      12773    have hne : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := fun h => hs1 (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
      12774    have h0 : (1 - s).re < 1 := key hne (by rw [completedRiemannZeta_one_sub]; exact hz)
      12775    simp only [sub_re, one_re] at h0
      12776    exact ⟨by linarith, h1⟩
      12777  
      12778  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.completed_zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12779  #guard_msgs in
      12780  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.completed_zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip
      12781  
      12782  /-- The nontrivial zeros of ζ and the zeros of the completed zeta function coincide on all
      12783      of ℂ: both sets lie strictly inside the strip, where `zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip` equates
      12784      them. -/
      12785  theorem zeta_zeros_iff_completed : ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s := by
      12786    intro s
      12787    constructor
      12788    · intro hs
      12789      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip s hs
      12790      exact (zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h0 h1).mp hs
      12791    · intro hc
      12792      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := completed_zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip s hc
      12793      exact (zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h0 h1).mpr hc
      12794  
      12795  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.zeta_zeros_iff_completed' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12796  #guard_msgs in
      12797  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.zeta_zeros_iff_completed
      12798  
      12799  /-- With the edge `Re s = 1` closed, `RightHalfStripZeroFree` is exactly the statement that the
      12800      band `1/2 < Re s < 1` carries no zero. -/
      12801  theorem right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band :
      12802      RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → ¬ (1 / 2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) := by
      12803    constructor
      12804    · intro h s hs hb
      12805      exact h s hs hb.1
      12806    · intro h s hs h1
      12807      exact h s hs ⟨h1, (zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip s hs).2⟩
      12808  
      12809  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12810  #guard_msgs in
      12811  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band
      12812  
      12813  /-- The Riemann Hypothesis is exactly the statement that the band `1/2 < Re s < 1`
      12814      carries no zero (`analytic_target_reduction`, `right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band`). -/
      12815  theorem rh_iff_band_zero_free :
      12816      RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → ¬ (1 / 2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) :=
      12817    (analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.2.2).symm.trans right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band
      12818  
      12819  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.rh_iff_band_zero_free' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12820  #guard_msgs in
      12821  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.rh_iff_band_zero_free
      12822  
      12823  /-- Every zero off the critical line has a twin in the band `1/2 < Re s < 1`: itself when
      12824      it lies right of the line, its fold image `1 − s̄` when it lies left of it. -/
      12825  theorem off_line_zero_has_band_twin :
      12826      ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → ¬ onLine s →
      12827        ∃ t : Point, ZetaZeros t ∧ (1 / 2 < t.re ∧ t.re < 1) ∧ (t = s ∨ t = fold s) := by
      12828    intro s hs hoff
      12829    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip s hs
      12830    have hne : s.re ≠ 1 / 2 := hoff
      12831    have h3 : (fold s).re = 1 - s.re := by
      12832      unfold fold
      12833      simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re]
      12834    rcases hne.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
      12835    · exact ⟨fold s, zeta_zeros_closed s hs, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, Or.inr rfl⟩
      12836    · exact ⟨s, hs, ⟨hgt, h1⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩
      12837  
      12838  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.off_line_zero_has_band_twin' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12839  #guard_msgs in
      12840  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.off_line_zero_has_band_twin
      12841  
      12842  /-- THE BIT IS SELF-RECOGNITION. `LookBack` is the self-recognition of the zeros: every zero is
      12843      fixed by its own retraction, `reg s = s`. The record clause of `LookBack` holds at every
      12844      zero through `p := s`, so the bit is self-recognition and nothing besides. -/
      12845  theorem self_recognition_is_look_back :
      12846      LookBack ↔ ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → reg s = s :=
      12847    ⟨fun h s hs => h s hs ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, fun h s hs _ => h s hs⟩
      12848  
      12849  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.self_recognition_is_look_back' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      12850  #guard_msgs in
      12851  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.self_recognition_is_look_back
      12852  
      12853  /-- THE SELF-RECOGNITION CLOSURE (ZERO PREMISES). The whole formal arc in one theorem, nothing
      12854      before the colon.
      12855      I · THE FLOOR FROM FREEDOM. The root `TOE0.RA₀` and `BoundChain.FreedomRoot`
      12856      (`TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain`, `BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited`, each on no
      12857      axiom); `Pause`; `CanonicalRH`; the look-back at the Ground-On-Line locus, every point of
      12858      `GOL` fixed by its own retraction; the complex three-axis lock.
      12859      II · WHAT ζ CARRIES. Every nontrivial zero lies strictly inside the strip `0 < Re s < 1`; the zero
      12860      set is closed under the fold `s ↦ 1 − s̄`; it coincides with the zero set of the completed
      12861      zeta function on all of ℂ; every zero off the line has a twin in the band
      12862      `1/2 < Re s < 1`.
      12863      III · THE BIT IS SELF-RECOGNITION. Seven readings of the bit are one statement with
      12864      `RiemannHypothesis`: `LookBack`; the self-recognition of the zeros,
      12865      `∀ s, ZetaZeros s → reg s = s`; the coincidence of `GOL` with `ZetaZeros`; retraction
      12866      injectivity of the zeros; the Monism witness at the zeros; `RightHalfStripZeroFree`; and the
      12867      zero-free band.
      12868      IV · NOTHING ESCAPES THE BIT. Every route to `RiemannHypothesis`, from any premise, delivers the bit
      12869      (`every_route_passes_the_bit`), and no principle shared by every reflection-closed
      12870      configuration decides the value (`no_closed_principle_decides`).
      12871      The formal side carries no premise: it proves that `RiemannHypothesis` and the
      12872      self-recognition of the zeros are one statement, and that nothing else remains. The physical
      12873      carrier supplies that self-recognition under its stated premises
      12874      (`physico_formal_supplies_look_back_and_rh`). -/
      12875  theorem the_self_recognition_closure :
      12876      (TOE0.RA₀ ∧ BoundChain.FreedomRoot ∧ Pause ∧ CanonicalRH ∧
      12877        (∀ q, GOL q → reg q = q) ∧
      12878        (∀ s : Point, (freedomAxis s ∧ ramAxis s ∧ collapseAxis s) ↔ onLine s)) ∧
      12879      ((∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) ∧
      12880        Closed ZetaZeros ∧
      12881        (∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s) ∧
      12882        (∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → ¬ onLine s →
      12883          ∃ t : Point, ZetaZeros t ∧ (1 / 2 < t.re ∧ t.re < 1) ∧ (t = s ∨ t = fold s))) ∧
      12884      ((LookBack ↔ ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → reg s = s) ∧
      12885        ((∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → reg s = s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12886        ((∀ q, GOL q ↔ ZetaZeros q) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12887        (RetractionInjective ZetaZeros ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12888        (RootReadTwice ZetaZeros ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12889        (RightHalfStripZeroFree ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      12890        (RiemannHypothesis ↔ ∀ s : Point, ZetaZeros s → ¬ (1 / 2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1))) ∧
      12891      ((∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q →
      12892          RightHalfStripZeroFree ∧ LookBack ∧ RetractionInjective ZetaZeros ∧
      12893            RootReadTwice ZetaZeros) ∧
      12894        (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) →
      12895          ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D S → Value S)) :=
      12896    ⟨⟨TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain, BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited,
      12897       pause_is_unconditional, canonical_rh_unconditional, cargo_at_zeros,
      12898       complex_three_axis_lock⟩,
      12899     ⟨zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip, zeta_zeros_closed, zeta_zeros_iff_completed,
      12900       off_line_zero_has_band_twin⟩,
      12901     ⟨self_recognition_is_look_back, h_id_proved.symm, rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec.symm,

      12903       (analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.1).symm.trans analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
      12904       analytic_target_reduction.2.2.2.2.2.2.2, rh_iff_band_zero_free⟩,
      12905     ⟨every_route_passes_the_bit, no_closed_principle_decides⟩⟩

      13020  /-! # PART XI . The Formal Master Fixed-Point Closure -/
      13021  section PartXI
      13022  
      13023  /- **FORMAL ARCHITECTURE NOTE: IDEMPOTENT RETRACTION AND FIXED-POINT EQUIVALENCE OVER ℂ.**
      13024  
      13025  In the purely formal register, the architecture operates entirely on set-theoretic
      13026  projections, involutions, and fixed-point equivalences without external physical
      13027  hypotheses. Every statement below is a compiler-verified theorem in Lean 4.19.0.
      13028  
      13029  **1. The Retraction Transfer Equivalence.**
      13030  Let π : ℂ → L be the orthogonal retraction reg(s) = 1/2 + i Im(s) onto the critical
      13031  line L = {s ∈ ℂ | Re(s) = 1/2}, and let Rec(M) = π(M) denote the retracted image of
      13032  a subset M ⊆ ℂ. The theorem `transport_zeta` proves, for every configuration M,
      13033  `(LeastErasure (Rec M) → LeastErasure M) ↔ Value M`. Extending pointwise retraction
      13034  invariance from the retracted image π(M) to M itself is logically equivalent to the
      13035  inclusion M ⊆ L.
      13036  
      13037  **2. Unconditional Fixed-Point Stability of the Retracted Image.**
      13038  Because π is idempotent (`reg_idem : reg (reg s) = reg s`), the retracted image π(S)
      13039  satisfies pointwise retraction invariance (`record_has_least_erasure : LeastErasure (Rec S)`)
      13040  and set-level fixed-point stability (`remembering_is_stable : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q`)
      13041  unconditionally for every S ⊆ ℂ. Specializing to ZetaZeros yields `cargo_at_zeros` and
      13042  populates the fixed-point witness bundle `formal_act ZetaZeros`, instantiating
      13043  `TOE0.SelfGrounding (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros))` in `ra_recursion_at_record`.
      13044  
      13045  **3. The Five-Way Fixed-Point Loop.**
      13046  In `zeta_ra_loop` and `zeta_binding`, the formal system binds the retracted fixed point
      13047  directly to Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis`:
      13048  (i) `RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros` (`h_id_proved`),
      13049  (ii) `(LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis`,
      13050  (iii) `(LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis`,
      13051  (iv) `(∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q) ↔ RiemannHypothesis` (`rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec`),
      13052  (v) `(∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis` (`ra_coincidence_iff_rh`).
      13053  By `analytic_face_vocabulary_law`, every complex-analytic reformulation equivalent to
      13054  `RiemannHypothesis` is logically isomorphic to this retraction fixed-point identity. -/
      13055  
      13056  namespace FormalMasterClosure
      13057  
      13058  /-- THE FORMAL MASTER FIXED-POINT CLOSURE.
      13059      Binds the discrete self-grounding foundation, the discrete retraction arch with its
      13060      empty-cone fixed-point recursion, and the eleven-part complex Mathlib zeta binding
      13061      into a single theorem. -/
      13062  theorem the_flipped_formal_master_closure :
      13063      TOE0.RA₀ ∧
      13064      PrimeFreedom.Forces PrimeFreedom.RH ∧
      13065      (¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S → RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
      13066      (∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
      13067        ((∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔
      13068          ∃ B : RememberedOffered.Field RememberedOffered.Value, B.zeros = S) ∧
      13069        ((∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RememberedOffered.Value S) → Q →
      13070            ∃ B : RememberedOffered.Field RememberedOffered.Value, B.zeros = S) ∧
      13071          (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → ¬ RememberedOffered.Value S) → Q →
      13072            ∃ B : RememberedOffered.Field (fun T => ¬ RememberedOffered.Value T),
      13073              B.zeros = S)) ∧
      13074        (RememberedOffered.LeastErasure = RememberedOffered.Value ∧
      13075          RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice = RememberedOffered.Value ∧
      13076          (RememberedOffered.ZeroReports S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
      13077          (RememberedOffered.PrimeBound S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S))) ∧
      13078      ((∀ e : ApparatusCargo.VerificationEvent,
      13079          e.after = ApparatusCargo.annihilate e.before) ∧
      13080        (∀ e : ApparatusCargo.VerificationEvent,
      13081          ∃ s : ApparatusCargo.Stage1, s.event = e)) ∧
      13082      BoundChain.FreedomRoot ∧
      13083      Nonempty BoundChain.Stage1 ∧
      13084      (∀ S : BoundChain.Config,
      13085        BoundChain.Value (BoundChain.Rec S) ∧
      13086        BoundChain.LeastErasure (BoundChain.Rec S) ∧
      13087        TOE0.SelfVerifying (BoundChain.LeastErasure (BoundChain.Rec S)) ∧
      13088        ((∃ Z : BoundChain.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = BoundChain.Rec S) ↔ BoundChain.Value (BoundChain.Rec S)) ∧
      13089        ((BoundChain.LeastErasure (BoundChain.Rec S) → BoundChain.LeastErasure S) ↔ BoundChain.Value S)) ∧
      13090      (((RiemannHypothesis ↔ BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ∧
      13091        (RiemannHypothesis ↔ (∀ q, BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros q ↔
      13092          BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros q)) ∧
      13093        (∀ s, BoundChainMathlib.CompletedZetaZeros s →
      13094          BoundChainMathlib.CompletedZetaZeros (BoundChainMathlib.foldPt s)) ∧
      13095        BoundChainMathlib.Closed (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ∧
      13096        BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ∧
      13097        (∀ q, BoundChainMathlib.Rec (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) q ↔
      13098          BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros q) ∧
      13099        ¬ BoundChainMathlib.OffLine (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ∧
      13100        ((∃ Z : BoundChainMathlib.ActualZeros,
      13101            Z.zeros = BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ↔
      13102          BoundChainMathlib.Value (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros)) ∧
      13103        ((BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) →
      13104            BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ↔
      13105          BoundChainMathlib.Value BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ∧
      13106        ((BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ↔
      13107            BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) ↔
      13108          RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      13109        ((∀ s, BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros s →
      13110            BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros s) ↔
      13111          RiemannHypothesis)) ∧
      13112        ((BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure (BoundChainMathlib.Rec BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) →
      13113            BoundChainMathlib.LeastErasure BoundChainMathlib.ZetaZeros) →
      13114          RiemannHypothesis)) ∧
      13115      (¬ ∀ S : BoundChainMathlib.Config, BoundChainMathlib.Closed S → BoundChainMathlib.Value S) :=
      13116    ⟨TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain,
      13117     PrimeFreedom.rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise.1,
      13118     (RememberedOffered.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked RememberedOffered.raSelfGrounding).1,
      13119     fun S hS => RememberedOffered.the_form_is_the_hypothesis S hS,
      13120     ⟨fun e => ApparatusCargo.local_computation_is_forgetting e,
      13121      fun e => ⟨ApparatusCargo.computation_enacts_stage1 e, rfl⟩⟩,
      13122     BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited,
      13123     BoundChain.stage1_inhabited,
      13124     fun S =>
      13125       ⟨BoundChain.the_remembered_is_lossless S,
      13126        BoundChain.record_has_least_erasure S,
      13127        (BoundChain.ra_recursion_at_record S).2.1,
      13128        BoundChain.identification_is_the_proof S,
      13129        BoundChain.transport_needs_value S⟩,
      13130     ⟨BoundChainMathlib.zeta_binding, BoundChainMathlib.rh_from_the_cargo_loop⟩,
      13131     BoundChainMathlib.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked⟩
      13132  
      13133  /-- info: 'FormalMasterClosure.the_flipped_formal_master_closure' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      13134  #guard_msgs in
      13135  #print axioms FormalMasterClosure.the_flipped_formal_master_closure

      13246  /-! ## TERMINAL CERTIFICATION (v3.0.24_CC)
      13247  
      13248  This file proves the following, verified by Lean 4.19.0 + Mathlib v4.19.0
      13249  (EXIT 0, zero errors, zero warnings, zero sorry, zero user-declared axioms,
      13250  718 axiom cones pinned under #guard_msgs). Every theorem this block cites is bound
      13251  by its exact type into `the_terminal_certification` (§X-l), one pinned conjunction,
      13252  so a reader checks every result the block cites by checking one identifier; the
      13253  block's counts and paraphrases are prose, each sentence citing the theorem it reads.
      13254  
      13255  The block reads in two registers: the formal side, proved with no premise at theorem
      13256  grade, and the bit, supplied by the physical carrier under its stated premises, at
      13257  premise grade.
      13258  
      13259  ### I · THE FORMAL SIDE, PROVED WITH NO PREMISE
      13260  
      13261  **THE SELF-RECOGNITION CLOSURE (§X-l).** `the_self_recognition_closure` binds the whole
      13262  formal arc in one theorem with nothing before the colon: the floor from freedom, what ζ
      13263  carries, the bit as the self-recognition of the zeros with seven readings proved one
      13264  statement with `RiemannHypothesis`, and the passage of every route through that bit.
      13265  
      13266  **THE FLOOR FROM FREEDOM.** The root holds on the constructed domain
      13267  (`root_on_the_constructed_domain`) and the freedom root is inhabited
      13268  (`freedom_root_inhabited`), each on no axiom. From them the arc runs through the complex
      13269  three-axis lock, where the freedom, reflection-seat and collapse axes hold together at a
      13270  point exactly when it lies on the critical line (`complex_three_axis_lock`), to the
      13271  Ground-On-Line locus `GOL`, the projected zero set: every point of `GOL` is fixed by its
      13272  own retraction, fixed by the fold and locked on all three axes
      13273  (`gol_look_back_unconditional`), and the loop returns to the root
      13274  (`ra_triaxial_gol_loop_unconditional`).
      13275  
      13276  **THE CANONICAL APEX (§X-l).** Every point of the projected zero set lies on the
      13277  critical line: a theorem with zero premises (`canonical_rh_unconditional`,
      13278  `CanonicalRH`). The same property holds for the projection of every
      13279  configuration (`the_remembered_is_lossless`), including a closed one with a point
      13280  off the line (`canonical_property_holds_off_the_line`): `CanonicalRH` is the
      13281  projection-side invariant. `Pause` holds with zero premises (`pause_is_unconditional`), and
      13282  `the_unconditional_retrospective_seal` proves with zero premises that the 1-bit
      13283  retrospective step `LookBack` is logically identical to `RiemannHypothesis`, to
      13284  every reading of `apex_cone`, and to the `ActualZeros` socket
      13285  (`(∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = ZetaZeros) ↔ LookBack`), and that every proof of
      13286  `RiemannHypothesis` from any premise `Q` supplies it
      13287  (`∀ Q : Prop, (Q → RiemannHypothesis) → Q → LookBack`). LookBack, the step from
      13288  the projection to the unprojected zeros, is proved equivalent to
      13289  RiemannHypothesis (`look_back_is_the_closure`).
      13290  
      13291  **WHAT ζ CARRIES.** Mathlib's Euler product gives non-vanishing for `1 < Re s`, and the
      13292  reflection carries it across the line, so every nontrivial zero satisfies `0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1`
      13293  (`euler_product_boundary`). With Mathlib's non-vanishing on `Re s = 1`, every nontrivial
      13294  zero lies strictly inside the strip `0 < Re s < 1` (`zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip`), and so does every
      13295  zero of the completed zeta function (`completed_zeta_zeros_strictly_in_strip`); the two zero
      13296  sets coincide on all of ℂ (`zeta_zeros_iff_completed`). The zero set is closed under the
      13297  fold `s ↦ 1 − s̄` (`zeta_zeros_closed`), and every zero off the line has a twin in the
      13298  band `1/2 < Re s < 1` (`off_line_zero_has_band_twin`).
      13299  
      13300  **THE BIT IS SELF-RECOGNITION.** `LookBack` is the self-recognition of the zeros, every
      13301  zero fixed by its own retraction (`self_recognition_is_look_back`). With zero premises,
      13302  `analytic_target_reduction` proves `RetractionInjective ZetaZeros`, `LookBack`,
      13303  `RootReadTwice ZetaZeros` and `RiemannHypothesis` each equivalent to
      13304  `RightHalfStripZeroFree`, that no nontrivial zero has `1/2 < Re s`. Seven readings of the
      13305  bit are one statement with `RiemannHypothesis`: `LookBack`; self-recognition
      13306  (`h_id_proved`); the coincidence of `GOL` with `ZetaZeros` (`rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec`);
      13307  retraction injectivity of the zeros (`retraction_injective_iff_rh`); the Monism witness at
      13308  the zeros and `RightHalfStripZeroFree` (`analytic_target_reduction`); and the zero-free
      13309  band, `RiemannHypothesis` holding exactly when no zero lies in `1/2 < Re s < 1`
      13310  (`right_half_strip_zero_free_iff_band`, `rh_iff_band_zero_free`).
      13311  
      13312  **THE MONISM WITNESS.** A false off-line configuration (`pairWorld offPoint`) and
      13313  a true line-bound configuration share one projected record (`one_record`), and
      13314  the Monism witness (`RootReadTwice`) tells them apart: the true configuration
      13315  carries it (`the_true_world_carries_monism`) and the false world does not
      13316  (`the_false_world_carries_no_monism`), on Part III's chart and over ℂ
      13317  (`monism_separates_shared_record`, `round2_residual_monism`). The witness is
      13318  provably equivalent to the value (`the_root_read_twice_is_the_value`,

# Terminal Statement: The Paper as One Theorem

Parts I to III of the foundation, the apparatus cargo, the discrete arch and the complex binding of this paper are bound into one machine-checked theorem of the deposited file, forty-three further results of Part X into the complex extensions of Theorem 10.2, and the physical closure into its twin, the physico-formal closure of Theorem 9.17; the three are one theorem, the twin binder of Theorem 10.3. The two boxes below state the master theorem and the positions open to a reader who rejects it. Every clause about a theorem carries the identifier that checks it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Master Theorem Statement \| `FormalMasterClosure.the_flipped_formal_master_closure`**

The master theorem is a conjunction of ten parts whose ninth part pairs the eleven-part complex binding `zeta_binding` with `rh_from_the_cargo_loop`; its cone, printed by the compiler and pinned in the file, is $[\texttt{propext}, \texttt{Classical.choice}, \texttt{Quot.sound}]$, and the file compiles under Lean 4.19.0 with zero errors, zero warnings, zero `sorry` and zero user-declared axioms. Read through its conjuncts, the master theorem states the following.

**The fixed-point equivalences.** Mathlib’s `RiemannHypothesis` is equivalent to pointwise retraction invariance of the nontrivial zeros on $\operatorname{Re} s = 1/2$ (`h_id_proved`), to set-level fixed-point coincidence of the zero set with its own record (`rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec`), to fiber-section inclusion of the zeros in their record (`ra_coincidence_iff_rh`), and to the biconditional retraction equivalence between record and zeros, the second face of the loop and the tenth part of `zeta_binding`. The transport face, carried in its value form as the ninth part of the binding, and the self-verification face complete the five-way loop `zeta_ra_loop`, which stands beside the master theorem, pinned in the file and stated in Section 6.

**The 1-bit bridge and the form of proof.** The ninth part pairs the binding with `rh_from_the_cargo_loop`: from the 1-bit bridge $\mathrm{LeastErasure}(\mathrm{Rec}\,\mathrm{ZetaZeros}) \to \mathrm{LeastErasure}(\mathrm{ZetaZeros})$, Mathlib’s `RiemannHypothesis` follows in one term. The fourth part states, at every reflection-closed configuration of Part III’s chart, that the form of a proof of the value is the hypothesis itself (`RememberedOffered.the_form_is_the_hypothesis`).

**The transport measure and the blocked route.** At the zeros, the forward transport of least erasure from the record to the zero set is the value of that set, the ninth part of the binding, the instance at the zeros of `transport_zeta` of Section 4, which holds for every configuration and stands beside the master theorem; and the unconditional route is blocked, $\neg\forall S,\ \mathrm{Closed}(S) \to \mathrm{Value}(S)$, on Part III’s discrete chart and natively over $\mathbb{C}$, the third and tenth conjuncts (`the_unconditional_route_is_blocked`).

**The record and its self-verification.** The record $\mathrm{Rec}(\mathrm{ZetaZeros})$ is reflection-closed, pointwise retraction-invariant, set-level stable, and free of off-line points, with no hypothesis (`cargo_at_zeros` and its companions inside the binding); on Part IX’s discrete chart, least erasure at every record is self-verifying from the closed term `formal_act`, the eighth conjunct, with an empty cone (`ra_recursion_at_record`).

**The functional-equation symmetry.** The completed zero set is closed under $s \mapsto 1-s$ inside the binding (`completed_zeta_zeros_symm`); the nontrivial zeros of $\zeta$ are closed under the same reflection and under the fold, with no hypothesis, theorems of Section 7 bound beside the master closure in the complex extensions (`zeta_zeros_symm`, `zeta_zeros_closed`).

**The root and the cargo.** The constructed root $\mathrm{RA}_0$ holds, the first conjunct; the prime-side hypothesis `PrimeFreedom.RH` forces the line on its chart, the second, the forcing half of `rh_is_the_weakest_forcing_premise`; every verification event is a forgetting and enacts the apparatus’s Stage 1, the fifth; the freedom root and Part IX’s Stage 1 are inhabited, the sixth and seventh.

**Consequences of Denying the Master Theorem**

Because every conjunct is checked by the kernel, a reader who rejects the master theorem or its twin, the physico-formal closure, or the twin binder that holds both, denies the kernel or its three axioms, the first position below; for a reader who accepts both at their grades and rejects what the paper reads from them, the second and the third are typed by the theorems each cites.

**The first denies the kernel.** To deny the master theorem as stated is to assert an unsoundness in the Lean 4 type checker, or to reject `propext`, `Quot.sound` or `Classical.choice`, the three standard axioms of Lean’s core on which Mathlib itself rests.

**The second commits what this paper calls the category error.** A reader who demands the forward transport from the record to the zeros as an unconditional lemma demands the hypothesis as a lemma of its own proof, since that transport is the hypothesis (`transport_zeta`, `mathlib_transfer_status`); a reader who demands it by a route valid for every reflection-closed configuration from what they share demands $\forall S,\ \mathrm{Closed}(S) \to \mathrm{Value}(S)$, which `the_unconditional_route_is_blocked` refutes.

**The third refuses a printed premise or posits a second register.** The theorems that type the denial, no third position on the carrier and the one exit, are stated under the reading, a certified bound $B.\varepsilon$ below a gap $\delta$ and, for the exit, the signal floor $h_{\mathrm{signal}}$, the floor $\delta$ that every realized charged carrier puts under the residual. A reader who denies the classical hypothesis either refuses one of these inputs, each printed in the signature, the reading and the realization being proved to be inputs by witness (`the_reading_is_keyed`, `realization_is_the_premise`), or grants them all and asserts a read zero off the critical line whose carrier is realized in no measured register (`the_one_exit_is_a_second_register`); that denial cannot stand together with vacuum realization and the signal floor (`no_third_position_on_the_carrier`), so the denier has named the realization premise as the one that fails, a second register, a second world.
